articles.title: Can Learning to Answer Spatial Questions Improve Novel-View Generation?
articles.content: Generating novel views from limited observations requires preserving both the appearance and spatial structure of a scene. Although recent approaches exploit fine-grained geometric cues, they do not explicitly model high-level semantic and spatial properties such as object identity, attributes, and inter-object relationships. In this work, we investigate whether 3D language understanding can provide complementary supervision for novel-view generation. We introduce Ask4NV, built on a pretrained unified multimodal model with a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture. Our model incorporates camera geometry into both VAE and ViT representations and leverages understanding features during generation through joint self-attention with a modality-aware attention masking strategy. Experiments demonstrate strong image quality and geometric consistency in novel-view generation, alongside competitive 3D language understanding. Further analysis shows that joint training improves cross-view correspondence in VAE representations and similarity in a 3D-aware feature space.

articles.title_zh: 学习如何回答空间问题能改善小说-视频的生成吗?
articles.content_zh: 从有限的观测中产生新的观点,需要同时保留一个场景的外观和空间结构. 虽然最近的方法利用了精细的几何提示,但没有明确地模拟高级语义和空间特性,如物体身份、属性和物体间关系。 在这部作品中,我们调查3D语言理解能否为小说视角生成提供互补监督. 我们引入了Ask4NV,它基于一种经过预先训练的统一多式联运模式,并带有一种转换器的混合结构。 我们的模型将相机几何学结合到VAE和ViT的表示中,并通过共同的自觉和模式感知的注意力遮掩策略,在生成过程中利用对特征的理解. 实验在小说-视觉生成中展现出强烈的图像质量和几何一致性,同时具有竞争性的3D语言理解. 进一步的分析表明,联合培训改善了VAE表述中的交叉视图通信,以及3D-意识特征空间中的相似性.

articles.title: Representation Conditioning for Generation
articles.content: Representation-alignment methods effectively accelerate the diffusion transformer training. REPA, for example, uses a pretrained vision encoder to supervise an intermediate layer through an MLP projection head which is discarded after training. It aims to import semantics from the vision encoder to the diffusion backbone. While this objective is achieved at early layers by back-propagating the alignment loss, there is no guarantee that later layers, supervised by the velocity prediction loss alone, can well access such semantics. We propose a simple solution, representation conditioning (RECON), to improve semantics in later layers. During training, we feed the pretrained vision encoder tokens into later layers; during inference, because we no longer have the clean image, we reuse the MLP head (as a proxy to the vision encoder) and project its output tokens to the later layers. Our method adds no parameters and leads to much faster convergence: RECON is $63\times$ faster than SiT and $25\times$ faster than REPA. Code is available at https://github.com/saeidrazavi/RECON
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 代际代表条件
articles.content_zh: 代表配位方法有效加快推广变压器培训. 例如,REPA使用预先训练的视觉编码器,通过MLP投影头监督中间层,在训练后丢弃。 它旨在从视觉编码器导入语义学到扩散骨干. 虽然这一目标是通过背向传播对齐损失在早期层实现的,但不能保证以后层仅由速度预测损失监督,就能很好地访问这种语义学. 我们提出一个简单的解决方案,代表条件(RECON),来改进后层的语义. 在训练期间,我们将预先训练的视觉编码器符号输入后层;在推论期间,因为我们不再有干净的图像,我们重新使用MLP头(作为视觉编码器的代用),并将其输出符号投射到后层. 我们的方法没有增加参数,并导致更快的趋同:RECON比SiT快63美元,比REPA快25美元。 代码见https://github.com/saeidrazavi/RECON。

articles.title: VITAL: From Visual Motion to Precise Action
articles.content: World-action models aim to turn visual anticipation into driving decisions, yet typically train action experts on trajectory representations defined independently of visual dynamics. This motivates deriving action targets directly from visual motion. We first examine a simpler setting in which trajectories are reconstructed from recorded future images. Even without the need for future prediction, reconstruction captures the dominant maneuver but leaves centimeter-scale errors. We therefore introduce VITAL (Vision-Induced Tokens for Action Learning), an action tokenizer that couples a visually derived motion scaffold with a compact residual encoding the trajectory error left by that scaffold. This representation makes visual motion the principal prediction target and gives small metric corrections a separate, normalized learning scale. Using flow matching, the action expert jointly predicts both components from the current image, ego state, and navigation command, without generating future images at inference. The same residual coordinates support bounded reinforcement post-training that refines execution while keeping the predicted visual scaffold fixed. With only one action denoising step, VITAL achieves 90.8 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 navtest, within 0.13 points of its ten-step score at 3.29x the end-to-end inference speed. Without retraining, it achieves 91.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 navtest and 38.6 on navhard. Project page: https://worldbench.github.io/vital

articles.title_zh: VITAL: 从视觉动作到精准动作
articles.content_zh: 世界行动模式旨在将视觉预测转化为驱动决策,但通常对行动专家进行独立于视觉动态的轨道表现方面的培训。 这促使人们直接从视觉运动中得出行动目标。 我们首先检查一个更简单的设置,从记录的未来图像中重建轨迹。 即使不需要未来的预测,重建也抓住了主导策略,但留下了厘米尺度的错误。 因此,我们引入了VITAL(Vision-Induced Tokens for Action Learning),这是一种动作标语器,将一个视觉衍生运动脚手架与该脚手架留下的轨迹错误进行紧凑的剩余编码结合在一起。 这种表述方式使视觉运动成为主要预测目标,并给小的度量校正一个单独的正常学习尺度. 利用流匹配,动作专家联合从当前图像,自负状态,和导航指令中预测两个组件,而不在推论中生成未来的图像. 同样的剩余坐标支持 捆绑的强化 后训练 精炼执行 同时保持 预测的视觉脚手架固定。 仅用一个动作解诺步骤,VITAL在NAVSIM v1导航测试上实现了90.8 PDMS,在它的十步分数的0.13分范围内,以3.29x的终到推断速度. 不进行再培训,它在NAVSIM v2导航测试上实现了91.1 EPDMS,在Navhard上实现了38.6. 项目网页:https://worldbench.github.io/vital

articles.title: CommerceGen-Studio: An End-to-End Framework for Commercial-Grade Main-Image Generation
articles.content: We present CommerceGen-Studio, an end-to-end framework for generating commercial-grade main images for e-commerce Stock Keeping Units (SKUs). Our framework is organized along a three-stage pipeline of information extraction, semantic rewriting, and multi-condition generation: Prompt-Eval-Refine-Loop Agent (PERL-Agent) distills heterogeneous SKU metadata into concise selling-point text lists through an iterative closed loop of VLM and LLM roles scored by a reference-free rubric. Layout Thinker Optimization (LTO) aligns the rewriter with both caption and rendered-image quality via alternating domain-specific policy optimization. SKU-DiT, trained under Reinforce-Distill-Reinforce (RDR) progressive training, conditions jointly on the white-background product image, the trademark crop, and the structured layout to hold subject fidelity, trademark integrity, and character-level text accuracy together. The framework runs in production at a scale of millions of main images per day with a latency of a few seconds per image, which we believe makes it among the first systems of this kind to operate at commercial scale. We also release CommerceGen-Bench, a benchmark of hard cases collected from live traffic across all product categories. On it, our framework achieves the highest overall scores among the evaluated open-source baselines on both editing tracks, with and without prompt enhancement. It also matches much larger closed-source models, and beats several of them at Instruction Following and Product Integration - the two properties that determine whether an image can be published.

articles.title_zh: 商务Gen-Studio: 商业 -- -- 主要形象生成的终到终期框架
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍CommerceGen-Studio,这是为电子商务股生成商业级主要图像的端到端框架。 我们的框架是按照信息提取、语义重写和多条件生成的三阶段管道组成的:即时-Eval-Refine-Loop Agent(PERL-Agent)通过一个无参考值的VLM和LLM角色的迭接闭环,将各种SKU元数据提炼成简明的销售点文本列表。 布局思维器优化(LTO)通过交替的域特定政策优化,使重写与标题和渲染图像质量一致. SKU-DIT,在强化-Distill-Reinforce(RDR)进步培训下培训,共同具备白底产品形象,商标作物等条件,结构化布局,以保持主体忠诚,商标完整性,以及字符级文本精准性. 这个框架每天以数百万个主要图像的规模在生产中运行,每个图像的延迟时间为几秒钟,我们认为,这使它成为最早在商业规模上运作的这类系统之一。 我们还发布了CommercialGen-Bench,这是从所有产品类别现场流量中收集的硬病例的基准. 就此而言,我们的框架在两个编辑轨道上,无论是否迅速改进,在评估的开源基线中,总得分最高。 它还匹配了更大的闭源模型,并在"指令跟随"和"产品集成"中击败了其中的几个——这两个属性决定一个图像是否可以发布.

articles.title: DynThinker: Unifying Static 3D and Dynamic 4D Spatial Reasoning
articles.content: Achieving general spatial intelligence requires a unified understanding of both static 3D and dynamic 4D. However, we find that existing models struggle to excel at both: 3D post-training can weaken dynamic understanding, while 4D-specialized models often lack strong static 3D reasoning. Our analysis reveals that this spatial--dynamic interference is highly non-uniform across parameter groups, with the balance between static and dynamic capabilities particularly sensitive to changes in late-layer MLPs. To address this interference, we propose DynThinker, a unified framework for jointly strengthening static and dynamic spatial reasoning. Decoupled Exponential Moving Average (D-EMA) applies configurable group-wise averaging to constrain drift in interference-sensitive pretrained parameters while preserving flexibility for capability enhancement. Spatial-Dynamic Fusion (SDF) complements D-EMA by selectively integrating spatial and temporal priors from a dynamic geometry encoder into intermediate VLM representations under semantic guidance. Across ten metrics spanning nine static 3D and dynamic 4D benchmarks, DynThinker achieves the highest average score among all evaluated models. Notably, DynThinker achieves 56.0 on ReVSI, 67.2 on DSR-Bench, and 51.2 and 40.1 under the sample-wise and group-wise evaluation protocols of DSI-Bench, respectively, setting new state-of-the-art results among the compared open-source models across all four evaluations within a unified model.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DynThinker:统一静态3D和动态4D空间理性
articles.content_zh: 实现一般空间智能需要统一理解静止的3D和动态的4D. 然而,我们发现,现有的模型在这两方面都很难做到卓越:3D后训练可以削弱动态理解,而4D专业模型往往缺乏强大的静态3D推理. 我们的分析表明,这种空间-动力干扰在参数组之间高度不统一,静态和动态能力之间的平衡对后期的MLP变化特别敏感。 为了解决这种干扰,我们提出DynThinker,一个联合加强静态和动态空间推理的统一框架. 脱钩指数移动平均值(D-EMA)采用可配置的组位平均值,以限制干扰敏感预先训练参数中的漂移,同时保持增强能力的灵活性。 空间-动态融合(SDF)通过有选择地将动态几何编码器的空间和时间前兆整合到语义引导下的中间VLM表达中,来补充D-EMA. 在跨越9个静态3D和动态4D基准的10个度量中,DynThinker在所有被评价模型中实现了最高平均分. 值得注意的是,DynThinker在ReVSI、DSR-Bench以及DSI-Bench的抽样和小组评价协议下分别取得了56.0、67.2和40.1项成果,在统一模式内所有四项评价的比较开源模型中确定了最新结果。

articles.title: GeoThinker-$F$: Endogenous Predictive World Representations for Fast Spatial Intelligence
articles.content: Existing geometry-aware Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) increasingly rely on external 3D encoders to provide structural priors, but executing these additional encoder paths at inference introduces substantial latency and computational overhead. We propose GeoThinker-$F$, an efficient framework that internalizes spatiotemporal perception by transforming causal MLLM hidden states into predictive latent world representations. Our key insight is that intermediate semantic representations contain sufficient information to predict useful representations of current geometry and future semantics, without requiring an exact reproduction of features from a dedicated 3D encoder. To realize this idea, GeoThinker-$F$ adopts a decoupled two-stage training strategy. In the first stage, the MLLM backbone is frozen while lightweight Latent Frame Prediction (LFP) heads learn from an offline 3D geometry expert and next-frame semantic targets. In the second stage, the external expert is removed, and the model is jointly optimized to generate and selectively integrate its self-predicted priors through a specialized Spatial-Grounded Temporal (SGT) Fusion module. Extensive evaluations show that GeoThinker-$F$ eliminates runtime dependence on external 3D geometry encoders while maintaining competitive performance across diverse spatial intelligence benchmarks. It achieves up to a $3.6\times$ inference speedup, reducing latency from $1.45\,\mathrm{s}$ to $0.40\,\mathrm{s}$ while retaining strong spatial reasoning performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GeoThinker-$F$: 快速空间情报世界内在预测性代表
articles.content_zh: 现有的几何-意识到的多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)越来越依赖外部的3D编码器来提供结构前缀,但是在推论中执行这些额外的编码器路径会引入相当的耐久性和计算上浮. 我们提出GeoThinker-$F$,这是一个有效的框架,通过将MLLM隐蔽的因果状态转化为预测性潜在世界表现,将瞬间感内化。 我们的关键见解是,中间语义表述包含足够的信息,可以预测当前几何和未来语义的有用表述,而不需要从专用的3D编码器中精确复制特征. 为了实现这一想法,GeoThinker-$F采取了脱钩的两阶段培训战略。 在第一阶段,MLLM主干线被冻结,而轻量级Latent Frame President(LFP)头部则从离线的3D几何专家和下帧语义目标学习. 在第二阶段,外部专家被移除,该模型被联合优化,通过一个专门的空间-环绕时间(SGT)融合模块生成并选择性地整合其自预前科. 广泛的评价表明,GeoThinker-$F$消除了对外部3D几何编码器的运行时间依赖,同时保持不同空间情报基准的竞争性性能. 其实现的推论速度可达3.6\times$,将空闲时间从1.45\,\mathrm{s}美元降至0.40\,\mathrm{s}美元,同时保留强大的空间推理性能.

articles.title: Feed-Forward Multi-View Feature Coding for 3D Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods enable efficient reconstruction of 3D scenes from sparse multi-view images in a single forward pass, without scene-specific optimization. However, existing feed-forward scene-coding pipelines first generate a complete Gaussian representation and then encode its geometry and appearance attributes separately, often involving non-differentiable operations. The resulting 'generate-then-compress' pipeline requires complex attribute-specific codec designs and limits rate-distortion performance by restricting the exploitation of cross-attribute redundancy. We propose multi-view feature coding for Gaussian splatting (MFGS), an end-to-end feed-forward framework for scene coding. Instead of compressing an explicit Gaussian representation, MFGS extracts multi-view features from the input images and encodes them into a compact bitstream. Through end-to-end rate-distortion training, MFGS learns compact multi-view features that jointly represent geometry and appearance, enabling the receiver to predict Gaussian attributes from the decoded features. We further introduce importance-guided Gaussian selection to accommodate different rendering budgets, allowing the receiver to adjust the number of Gaussians used for rendering from the same bitstream. Across RE10K, ACID, and DL3DV, MFGS achieves 99.76-99.86% bitrate savings over the generate-then-compress pipeline, as measured by BD-rate, while reducing total GMACs by 52-55% and providing an approximately 12 times end-to-end speedup.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 用于 3D 高斯电镀的 Feed-Forward 多维特性编码
articles.content_zh: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splating(3DGS)方法使得3D场景能够从一个单一的前进通道中从稀少的多视图图像中高效重建,而无需对场景进行特定优化. 然而,现有的向前进的场景编码管道首先会产生完整的高斯代表,然后将其几何和外观属性分别编码,经常涉及无差别的操作. 由此产生的"基因-当时压缩"管道需要复杂的属性特定编码设计,并通过限制跨属性冗余的利用来限制速率扭曲性能. 我们提出高斯电镀(MFGS)的多视图特性编码,这是场景编码的端到端的feed-forward框架. MFGS没有压缩明确的高斯代表,而是从输入图像中提取多视图特征,并将其编码为紧凑的位流. 通过端到端速率扭曲训练,MFGS学习了能共同代表几何和外观的紧凑的多视图特性,使接收器能够从解码特性中预测高斯属性. 我们进一步引入了重要性引导高斯选择,以适应不同的渲染预算,允许接收器调整用于从同一位流渲染的高斯人数量. 通过RE10K,ACID,以及DL3DV,MFGS在生成-当时压缩管道上实现了99.76-99.86%的比特率节约,以BD-速率衡量,同时将GMAC总量减少52-55%,提供大约12倍的端到端速度.

articles.title: Learnable Hodge-Laplacian Driven Mixture of Experts for Steady-PDE Surrogates on Coarse Unstructured Meshes
articles.content: Current approaches for steady partial differential equations surrogate models on unstructured meshes apply a single mixing mechanism to the whole solution. This paper proposes an architecture that partitions the solution among vanilla transformer experts, each focused on a different spectral scale. The partition is built from a discrete Hodge Laplacian $L_0=\star_0^{-1} d_0^{\top}\star_1 d_0$, that serves as a fitting layer measuring high-frequency content. A gating mechanism takes the mesh as input and produces the per-vertex weights that recombine the expert outputs. AirFRANS is a steady Reynolds-averaged Navier--Stokes (RANS) airfoil benchmark. We evaluate our approach in a reduced remeshed version of the benchmark with each unstructured mesh counting 9.6K faces and 4.9K vertices. We compare our approach with the Transolver on the same dataset and dataset slit. Our approach reduces relative $L_2$ error by 31\% and interior mean squared error by 47\%.

articles.title: Player-1: Learning to Play from Synthetic Experience
articles.content: Computer-use agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in interpreting screens and executing keyboard and mouse actions. However, games, with their visually rich worlds and diverse mechanics, remain challenging and offer a demanding next step toward general digital control. Current game-agent learning pipelines often rely on large-scale demonstrations with limited coverage of dynamic game states, while scalable environments for interactive training remain difficult to obtain. We introduce Player-1, a post-training framework for learning game control beyond demonstrations through synthetic experience. We extend the computer-use action space with relative pointer motion, sustained inputs, and composite actions. For supervised initialization, we fine-tune computer-use models on 6,044 curated gameplay trajectories that pair recorded actions with task instructions and visual reasoning. We construct Player-1-Gym, sixteen synthetic 2D and 3D environments designed around control demands shared across games. Programmatically verifiable rewards and randomized observations and control dynamics support multi-environment reinforcement learning with PPO. The resulting Player-1-9B and Player-1-35B-A3B improve MineDojo-300 success over their SFT policies by 27.8 and 17.7 percentage points, respectively. Player-1-9B reaches 38.33% success compared with 12.63% for the strongest evaluated baseline, with further gains over SFT on ViZDoom-10 and GameWorld. Further analyses show that broader synthetic environment coverage improves transfer, while the use of composite actions that combine multiple keyboard and mouse inputs increases during RL. We demonstrate that learning from synthetic experience substantially improves game control beyond supervised initialization, with gains that generalize beyond the RL training suite.

articles.title_zh: 玩家-1:从合成经验学习游戏
articles.content_zh: 计算机使用代理人在解释屏幕和执行键盘和鼠标动作方面表现出了强大的能力. 然而,游戏凭借其视觉丰富的世界和多样的力学,仍然具有挑战性,为全面数字控制提供了要求很高的下一步。 目前的游戏代理学习管道往往依赖于对动态游戏状态覆盖面有限的大规模演示,而互动培训的可扩展环境仍然难以获得. 我们引入了Player-1,一个通过合成经验学习超越演示的游戏控制的训练后框架. 我们以相对的指向运动、持续的投入和综合行动扩大了计算机使用行动空间。 为了监督初始化,我们微调了6,044个精准游戏播放轨迹上的计算机使用模型,将记录动作与任务指令和视觉推理对齐. 我们构建Player-1-Gym,16个合成的2D和3D环境,设计围绕游戏间共享的控制需求. 方案可核查的奖励和随机观察及控制动态支持与PPO的多环境强化学习. 由此产生的Player-1-9B和Player-1-35B-A3B分别将MineDojo-300成功率提升到27.8%和17.7个百分点. Player-1-9B成功率达到38.33%,而最强评价基线为12.63%,在ViZDoom-10和GameWorld上比SFT进一步增高. 进一步的分析表明,更广泛的合成环境覆盖面可以改善转移,而结合多种键盘和鼠标输入的复合动作在RL期间会增加. 我们表明,从合成经验中学习,大大改善了游戏控制,超出了监督初始化的范围,其收益超越了RL培训套件。

articles.title: Any Time, Any Space: A World-State-Centric Framework for Agentic Video Generation
articles.content: Long-form agentic video generation must turn a screenplay into shots that remain spatially and temporally consistent across nonconsecutive requests. Passing prompts or recent frames between shots does not provide a shared spatial frame for revisiting a scene or a time-indexed record for replaying an earlier event. We present Any Time, Any Space (ATAS), which compiles a screenplay into shot requests with explicit location, camera, and event-time references. Before generation, it retrieves relevant evidence from a scene memory of registered static geometry and an event memory of dynamic observations indexed by scene, event, and time. After generation, ATAS reconstructs and registers the clip. It updates memory only when review and state checks accept the observation, while film delivery remains independent of memory admission. Across four video generators, ATAS improves all reported cross-shot consistency measures and achieves the highest aggregate benchmark score for each backbone. It also outperforms the compared agents and 3D-guided methods on target-image spatial revisit, leads three event-recapture criteria, and receives the highest human ratings on all six criteria. The video results and code are available on our project page: https://lhmd.top/atas/.

articles.title_zh: 任何时间,任何空间:代理视频生成的世界-状态-儿童框架
articles.content_zh: 长式代理视频生成必须把剧本变成在空间和时间上始终一致的不连续请求的镜头. 在镜头间传递提示或最近的帧不能为重访一个场景提供共享空间框架,也不能为重播一个更早的事件提供时间索引记录. 我们呈现任何时间,任何空间(ATAS),它将一个剧本编译成有明确位置,相机和事件时间参考的拍摄请求. 在生成前,它从已注册的静态几何的场景内存和按场景,事件,时间索引的动态观测事件内存中获取相关证据. 一代后,ATAS重建并注册剪辑. 它仅在审查及状态检查接受观察时更新内存,而电影的交付仍然独立于内存的承认. 在四台录像发电机中,ATAS改进了所有报告的交叉射击一致性措施,并实现了每个主干单位的最高总基准分数。 在目标图像空间重访上,它也超越了对比剂和3D制导方法,领先三个事件恢复标准,并在所有六个标准上获得人类最高的评分. 视频结果和代码见我们的项目网页:https://lhmd.top/atas/。

articles.title: A$^3$PreCore: Robust Rigid Registration for Native FLAIR-Space Brain-Mask Transfer
articles.content: Reliable brain-mask transfer into native fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR) space can fail when T1-to-FLAIR rigid registration is unstable. We developed A$^3$PreCore, a six-degree-of-freedom rigid-registration strategy that aligns the full bias-corrected T1-weighted image to native FLAIR using normalized mutual information while preserving the established T1-space anatomical mask. We also introduced extended quantitative quality control (E-QC), which characterizes mask extent, field-of-view-relative position, FLAIR intensity support, boundary support, inferior morphology, and pairwise geometric disagreement. In 78 participants with paired T1-weighted and FLAIR imaging, A$^3$PreCore was compared with fsl_anat and the Brain Extraction Tool (BET). Gross rigid-body misregistration occurred in 21/78 fsl_anat outputs (26.9%) and 0/78 A$^3$PreCore outputs (exact two-sided McNemar p=9.54 x 10^-7). Among 57 participants without gross fsl_anat misregistration, A$^3$PreCore preserved close agreement (median Dice=0.993; median paired Delta NMI=-0.00007, p=0.429). A$^3$PreCore remained broadly concordant with BET (median Dice=0.955), with less inferior and extracranial extension in representative comparisons. Method-blinded neuroscientists ranked A$^3$PreCore first in 35/40 participants (87.5%). E-QC additionally exposed severe orientation-related disagreement not evident from global descriptors or centroid displacement alone. These findings support A$^3$PreCore as a robust native-FLAIR brain-mask transfer strategy and E-QC as a complementary framework for multidimensional mask characterization and participant-specific geometric quality control.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: A$^3$PreCore: 本地FLAIR-空间脑罩传输的强力硬化注册
articles.content_zh: 当T1到FLAIR刚性注册不稳定时,可靠的脑浆转移到原生流体增压倒置回收(FLAIR)空间可能会失败. 我们开发了A^3$PreCore,这是一种六度自由僵硬的注册策略,利用正常的相互信息,将完全偏差修正的T1加权图像与本地FLAIR联系起来,同时保留既定的T1-空间解剖面具。 我们还引入了扩大的定量质量控制(E-QC),其特征是遮盖范围、视野相对位置、FLAIR强度支持、边界支持、劣质形态以及对等几何差异。 在78名配对的T1加权成像和FLAIR成像的参与者中,A^3$PreCore被比作fsl_anat和脑提取工具(BET). 21/78 Fsl_anat产出(26.9%)和0/78 A^3 A$PreCore产出(确切的说是双面的McNemar p=9.54 x 10^-7)中出现粗刚体错误登记。 在57名没有粗略错误注册的参与者中,A^3美元PreCore保留了近距离协议(中间点为Dice=0.993;中间对数的Delta NMI=-0.00007,p=0.429)。 A$3PreCore与BET(中间点=0.955)大致一致,在代表性比较中,低级和外延性较低。 方法盲神经科学家在35/40名参与者中排名A^3$PreCore第一(87.5%). 此外,E-QC还暴露了仅从全球描述或百分数迁移中看不出的与定向有关的严重分歧。 这些结论支持A^3$PreCore作为强大的本土-FLAIR脑罩传输战略,支持E-QC作为多层面面具特征和参与者特定几何质量控制的补充框架.

articles.title: PhySGA: A Physics-Space Grounded Agentic Framework for Generalizable and Interactive 3D Composition
articles.content: 3D object composition is pivotal to digital content creation and robot simulation, while also serving as a critical testbed for physical intelligence in foundation models. Previous methods either leverage large language models to directly predict object coordinates, or utilize generative diffusion priors to synthesize composite images for visual alignment, both of which rely on static priors in digital spaces. However, these methods consistently struggle with complex compositions such as precise hanging, gravity-driven settling and hidden containment, as these tasks require interactive construction processes involving global planning, fine-grained alignment, and physical simulation. To address these challenges, we propose PhySGA, a Physics-Space Grounded Agentic Framework for 3D composition via agent exploration and physical simulation, enabling the universal interactive assembly of rigid, articulated, and deformable objects. Directly applying vanilla LLMs or VLMs to this task proves insufficient, as current models inherently lack grounded physical understanding and interactive construction experience. To overcome this limitation, we design a collaborative feedforward-feedback architecture: an Assembly Agent focuses on geometric and kinematic reasoning for global step planning and coarse adjustment, while a Critic Agent reasons over contact dynamics for simulator state diagnosis and fine-grained closed-loop correction. Furthermore, Action Routers map semantic planning and analysis onto executable physical primitives within the simulator, while a task-specific Self-Evolving Skill Library distills historical trial-and-error feedback into reusable experiences, boosting success rates and minimizing exploration attempts. Extensive experiments within Isaac Sim demonstrate that PhySGA significantly surpasses existing methods in relation fidelity, physical plausibility, and visual quality.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PhySGA:可通用和交互式三维构成的物理-空间基物剂框架
articles.content_zh: 3D对象组成对于数字内容创建和机器人模拟至关重要,同时也是基础模型中物理智能的关键测试台. 以前的方法要么利用大型语言模型直接预测对象坐标,要么利用基因扩散前期合成复合图像进行视觉对齐,两者都依赖于数字空间的静态前期. 然而,这些方法与诸如精确悬挂、重力驱动的安放和隐蔽等复杂成分相冲突,因为这些任务需要互动的建造过程,包括全球规划、精细调整和物理模拟。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议通过物剂勘探和物理模拟,为3D组成建立一个物理-空间地面物剂框架,使刚性、清晰和可变形的物体能够普遍交互组装。 事实证明,在这项工作中直接应用香草有限责任公司(vanilla LLMs)或VLM(VLMs)是不够的,因为目前的模型本身缺乏基于实体的理解和互动的构建经验。 为了克服这一局限性,我们设计了一个合作的向导反馈架构:一个大会代理侧重于全球步骤规划和粗细调整的几何学和动因推理,而一个批评代理则针对模拟状态诊断和精细的闭路修正的接触动态提出批评。 此外,行动路由器将语义规划和分析映射到模拟器内可执行的物理原始物上,而任务特定的自演技能库将历史的试验和反射反馈反馈到可重复使用的经验中,提高成功率,尽量减少探索尝试。 在艾萨克·西姆(Isaac Sim)内部的广泛实验表明,PhySGA在亲和性,物理可信性和视觉质量方面大大超过了现有的方法.

articles.title: Speculative Sampling in Interactive Video Generation
articles.content: Interactive video generation commonly relies on small bidirectional chunks to reduce response latency. Yet our preliminary experiments show that larger chunks improve video quality and better utilize GPU parallelism, allowing more latents to be sampled with only a modest increase in sampling time. Motivated by these observations, we propose Speculative Sampling, a strategy that combines the modeling power of large bidirectional windows with the low-latency interaction of small ones. It expands the modeling window by appending noise latents as padding and caches the resulting predictions for reuse when the condition remains unchanged. Predictions are delivered incrementally, while the uncommitted future remains replaceable. Our latency analysis shows that this removes the waiting-time lower bound imposed by chunk boundaries, shifting the optimization focus from reducing chunk size to accelerating per-chunk sampling. Bidirectional window size thus becomes a decision variable for jointly optimizing visual quality and sampling time, rather than a necessary constraint on low-latency interaction. This opens a path to serving large bidirectional models in interactive streaming systems without complex streaming post-training.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 互动视频生成中的样本
articles.content_zh: 互动视频生成通常依靠小的双向块来降低响应延迟. 然而,我们的初步实验表明,更大的块提高了视频质量,并更好地利用了GPU的平行性,使得更多的潜伏物能够取样,而采样时间却略有增加。 基于这些观察,我们提出分镜抽样,这个策略将大型双向窗口的建模功率与小型窗口的低相关性相互作用结合起来. 它通过附加噪声潜伏物来扩展建模窗口,作为粘贴,并缓存由此产生的预测,以便在条件保持不变时再利用。 预测是逐步提供的,而未承诺的未来仍然可以取代。 我们的耐久性分析显示,这消除了块边界造成的等待时间下限,将优化重点从缩小块大小转移到加速每块取样。 因此,双向窗口大小成为共同优化视觉质量和取样时间的决定变量,而不是对低相关性互动的必要限制。 这开启了一条在互动流式系统中服务大型双向模型而无需复杂的流式后培训的道路.

articles.title: Reliability-Aware Multimodal Sentiment Prediction Under Local Modality Missingness
articles.content: Multimodal sentiment models are usually evaluated on complete utterances, yet streams often lose a contiguous span of text, audio, or video. We study local missingness on aligned CMU-MOSEI features. Our reliability-aware network (RM-Net) keeps the original temporal positions, represents unobserved positions with a learned token, outputs bounded per-modality intensity contributions gated by observation quality, and is trained with dual-view masking of contiguous segments. We fuse five RM-Net seeds with a LoRA-adapted BERT text expert, using a fusion weight that depends only on the visible fraction of content tokens. Architecture, checkpoint, and fusion choices were made on the validation split. On the held-out split, the fused model reaches a macro-F1 of 0.655 on clean inputs and 0.634 under 40\% mixed missingness; its two-view average exceeds the auxiliary-head baseline by 0.024 (95\% video-cluster bootstrap interval [0.003, 0.045]). Because this split was inspected during development, these numbers are not a blind test. For explanations, exact Shapley attributions over the eight modality subsets and position-level occlusion show that top-ranked positions reduce the predicted-class probability faster than random positions (AUC gap 0.113 on validation). We also describe an auditable word-level alignment pipeline for raw clips; its outputs do not feed the predictive models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 本地模式下可靠- 知情的多模式惩罚预测缺失
articles.content_zh: 多式联运情绪模型通常用完整的语句来评价,但流往往会失去文本、音频或视频的毗连范围。 我们研究本地的缺失 与CMU-MOSEI的特征一致。 我们的可靠性意识网络(RM-Net)保持原有的时空位置,代表着不观察的位置,具有学识的标志,产出以观察质量为限制的每模式强度贡献,并接受以毗连部分的双视掩码培训。 我们把五个RM-Net种子与一个经过LORA调整的BERT文本专家结合,使用一个仅依赖于内容符号的可见分量的聚变重量. 进行了建筑、检查站和核聚变方面的选择。 在被搁置的拆分中,引信型号在清洁投入上达到0.655的宏F1,在40QQ混合缺失下达到0.634;其双视平均值超过辅助头基线0.024(95QQ视频-集群靴夹间隔[0.003,0.045]). 由于这种分裂是在开发过程中被检查的,这些数字并不是盲目测试. 为了解释,在8个模式子集和位置层封存上准确的Shapley属性显示,排名最高的位置比随机位置(AUC ship 0.113 on existance)更快地降低了预测级概率. 我们还描述了对原始剪辑可审计的字级调整管道;其产出没有为预测模型提供素材。

articles.title: PrismaCoder: Pushing the Boundaries of Open Multimodal Code Intelligence through Decomposed Rubric Synthesis
articles.content: Multimodal code intelligence connects the symbolic world of programs with the visual world their execution creates. Interest in this capability is burgeoning, as models are increasingly asked to produce charts, webpages, animations, and semi-structured documents. Recently, proprietary models have pushed far ahead, producing interactive artifacts even from a text description or a screenshot alone. Yet their data and training remain closed, and open progress is held back by the quantity and quality of available data and by the pipelines and methods for producing it. Quality is the harder of the two, since a sample must be correct as a program, well built, and above all visually right once rendered. No existing signal covers all three. Execution often returns just a pass or fail, code similarity does not map to the visual output, and task-specific verifiers do not generalize. To push open progress further, we start from the data side with PrismaForge, a hierarchical data pipeline centered on a synthesized rubric that decomposes these factors into checkable criteria. The same rubric serves as both filter and reward: it curates the supervised corpus, then drives reinforcement learning on visual-coding tasks. Leveraging PrismaForge for data synthesis and filtering, we build PrismaCoder-2M, the most diverse open dataset for multimodal code intelligence and the largest to date. On the model side, we train PrismaCoder-9B and PrismaCoder-35B on this data and release both. They lead the open state of the art by a wide margin and rival leading proprietary systems. Our analyses further show that the proposed rubric-based pipeline improves multimodal coding performance across model backbones. We release our code and data at https://qiushisun.github.io/PrismaCoder-Home/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PrismaCoder:通过分解的Rubric合成来推进开放式多式联运代码智能的边界
articles.content_zh: 多式联运代码智能将程序的象征世界与它们的执行所创造的视觉世界联系起来. 对这种能力的兴趣正在增长,因为人们越来越多地要求模型制作图表、网页、动画和半结构文件。 最近,专有模型推进了很远的一步,甚至从文本描述或截图中产生交互式文物. 然而,他们的数据和培训仍然关闭,现有数据的数量和质量以及生产数据的管道和方法阻碍了开放的进展。 质量是两者中最难的,因为一个样本必须作为一个程序正确,构建良好,最重要的是,一旦被渲染出来,就具有视觉权利。 没有现有的信号覆盖所有三个. 执行通常只返回一个通过或失败,代码相似性不映射到视觉输出,任务特定核查者不概括. 为了进一步推进开放进展,我们从数据侧面开始与PrismaForge(英语:PrismaForge),一个分级的数据管道,其中心是一个将这些因素分解成可核查标准的合成标题. 同一标题既可以过滤,又可以奖励:它可以校准被监管人,然后推动在视觉编码任务方面的强化学习。 利用普里斯玛 Forge用于数据合成和过滤,我们建造了Prisma Coder-2M,这是用于多式联运代码智能的最多样化开放数据集,也是迄今为止最大的数据集. 在模型方面,我们在此数据上训练Prisma Coder-9B和Prisma Coder-35B,并同时发布两者. 它们以广阔的优势领导着开放的艺术状态,并竞争着领先的专有系统. 我们的分析进一步表明,拟议的基于标题的管道改进了示范骨干之间的多式联运编码工作。 我们在https://qiushisun.github.io/PrismaCoder-Home/上发布了我们的代码和数据。

articles.title: Generative Representation Learning for Scalable Latent Tokenization
articles.content: We introduce an approach for self-supervised representation learning designed to be used as a tokenizer for generative modeling. Our objective supervises a representation loss by factorizing the pointwise mutual information of the data, which we estimate by taking information differences between conditional predictions from a learned generative model. We justify our algorithm theoretically and empirically, demonstrating that our generative approach to representation learning avoids dimensional collapse and feature suppression in cases where commonly used methods like DINO and LeJEPA fail. Moreover, we show our representation learning technique is scalable; expending more compute leads to predictably better latent tokenization. For the first time, we perform a careful analysis of the combined flop efficiency of tokenizer and generative model and demonstrate that our approach is a compute-optimal improvement over direct diffusion for pixel-space generation, obtaining an FID-50K of 2.18 with JiT-L. Applied to ImageNet and the text-to-image dataset GPIC, we show tokenizer encoder scaling laws for diffusability, where extrapolating our approach achieves representations in 7x fewer FLOPs than DINOv2 on ImageNet and 8x fewer FLOPs than WebSSL on GPIC.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 为可伸缩的后进化学习基因代表
articles.content_zh: 我们采用了一种自我监督的代表性学习方法,用来作为基因模型的象征。 我们的目标通过将数据的点性相互信息纳入系数来监督一种表示损失,我们通过从一个学到的基因模型中提取有条件预测之间的信息差异来估计这些数据。 我们从理论和经验角度证明我们的算法是正确的,表明在DINO和LeJEPA等常用方法失败的情况下,我们对代表性学习的基因方法避免了维度崩溃和特征抑制。 此外,我们显示,我们的代表学习技术是可扩展的;花费更多的计算方法可以预测到更好的潜在标志化。 我们首次对标致剂和基因模型的综合浮动效率进行了认真分析,并表明我们的方法是比直接扩散像素空间生成的计算-优化改进,获得了FID-50K的2.18,与JiT-L. 应用到ImageNet和文本到图像数据集GPIC,我们展示了标致剂编码器缩放法用于易散性,在图像网的FLOP比DINOv2少7x,FLOP比GPIC的WebSSL少8x.

articles.title: ActiveEvidence: Decision-Focused Evidence Graphs with Verifiable Acquisition Gaps
articles.content: A multimodal agent must decide whether visual evidence is worth acquiring, which candidate or resolution to query, and when further interaction can no longer change its decision. We study this problem under a strict free-metadata/paid-observation boundary, stochastic vector costs, and a frozen execution trace, and treat it as decision-certifiable active evidence acquisition. A Counterfactual Evidence Interaction Graph (CEIG) represents unary evidence value, signed second-order interaction, and directed conditional harm while maintaining explicit score enclosures for unresolved interactions; a decision-weighted enclosure objective tightens the bounds that can change action identity. Gap-directed refinement evaluates only interactions that can displace the incumbent acquisition and stops once an $ε$-decision certificate shows that unresolved terms cannot change the selected action beyond a declared tolerance. The certificate is model-relative: it verifies policy-consistent optimality under the pinned learned score, and semantic quality is measured separately through post-freeze labels. Paired continuation rollouts learn the downstream value of paid previews, an online operational cost filter is separated from independent finite-policy-family trajectory certification, and an acquisition monitor with an independently implemented verifier binds every certificate to the frozen trace. On 640 cases split into 384/128/128 training, validation, and test cases, the controller reaches task score 0.842, grounding F1 0.816, evidence recall 0.873, 1.74 accepted calls, 286.5K visual tokens, and 742ms p95 latency. Dense replay of issued certificates shows 0.992 action agreement and a 0.988 certificate rate while evaluating 19.6 instead of 191.4 expensive interaction terms per decision.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 活性证据:具有可核实获取差距的有决定针对性证据图表
articles.content_zh: 多式联运代理商必须决定视觉证据是否值得获取,哪些候选证据或解答问题,以及何时进一步互动不能再改变其决定。 我们在严格的自由元数据/付费观察界限、分层矢量成本和冻结的行刑追踪下研究这一问题,并将其作为可裁定核证的有效证据获取处理。 反事实证据交互图(CEIG)代表非事实证据值,签名二阶交互,并指示有条件伤害,同时对未解决的相互作用保持明确的分数封存;一个决定加权的封存目标收紧了可以改变动作身份的界限. 以差距为导向的完善只评估可以取代现有获取的相互作用,一旦一个美元决定证书显示未解决的术语不能改变选定的行动,而不能改变所宣布的容忍度,就停止。 证书是模型相对的:在标注的学习分数下验证政策一致的最佳性,语义质量通过后冻结标签单独测量. Paired continual rolled expression 了解付费预览的下游价值,从独立的有限政策-家庭轨迹认证中分离出一个在线运行成本过滤器,一个独立执行的验证器的获取显示器将每个证书绑定在被冻结的痕迹上. 在640起案件中,控制员分为384/128/128培训、鉴定和测试案件,达到任务分数0.842,F1/0.816,证据召回0.873,1.74接受电话,286.5K视觉信号,742ms p95 latency。 已发行证书的ense replay显示0.992动作协议和0.988证书率,同时评价每个决定的19.6而不是191.4昂贵的交互条件.

articles.title: VascuSR: Iterative Anatomy-Aware Diffusion for CT Super-Resolution
articles.content: Generative super-resolution (SR) can recover sharp detail in computed tomography (CT) images from severely downsampled observations, but the missing high-frequency content is not uniquely determined by the low-resolution input. Consequently, visually plausible reconstructions may contain anatomically unsupported vascular detail, such as missing, spurious, or incorrectly connected vessels. To overcome this challenge, we introduce VascuSR, an iterative anatomy-aware diffusion framework that combines image reconstruction with explicit 3D vascular guidance. First, to provide richer anatomical guidance, we use an explicit 3D vascular representation that captures structural information beyond individual slices. This representation also simplifies vascular refinement by allowing a lightweight 3D generative refiner to focus on vascular structure rather than complex CT appearance. Second, to guide slice-wise SR, a lightweight anatomy controller injects the refined structure into the diffusion decoder, while iterative feedback updates this guidance from each new SR volume. On re-annotated MSD Task08 and HVM datasets, VascuSR outperforms interpolation and learning-based SR baselines in segmentation accuracy (Dice and clDice) and 3D vascular structure (connectivity and mean centerline distance), while maintaining image quality comparable to its SR backbone. Compared with learning-based baselines, VascuSR reduces class-averaged connected-component counts by over 20% on both datasets and mean centerline distance by over 10% on MSD.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VascuSR:用于CT超解析的迭代解剖学-软件扩散
articles.content_zh: 基因超分辨率(SR)可以从严重下取样的观测中恢复计算成的直径图(CT)图像中的尖锐细节,但缺失的高频内容并非由低分辨率输入独占决定. 因此,视似合理的重建可能包含解剖学上无根据的血管细节,例如缺失、虚假或连接不正确的血管。 为了克服这个挑战,我们引入了VascuSR,这是一个反复的解剖学-意识传播框架,将图像重建与明确的3D血管导线相结合. 首先,为了提供更丰富的解剖指导,我们使用一种清晰的3D血管表达法来捕捉超越单个切片的结构信息. 这种表现方式也通过允许轻量级的3D基因精炼器专注于血管结构而不是复杂的CT外观来简化血管精炼. 其次,为了引导切片的SR,一个轻量级解剖学控制器将精细的结构注入扩散解码器,同时迭代反馈从每一个新的SR卷中更新这个指导. 在重新附加说明的MSD Task08和HVM数据集上,VascuSR在分区精度(Dice and clDice)和3D血管结构(连接性和平均中线距离)上超越了插值和基于学习的SR基线,同时保持图像质量与其SR骨干相当. 与基于学习的基线相比,VascuSR将两个数据集的类平均连接组件数减少20%以上,将MSD的中线距离减少10%以上。

articles.title: OLiVES: An Outdoor Low-Light Video Benchmark for Enhancement and Segmentation
articles.content: Low-light video processing remains an underexplored problem in computer vision, primarily due to the scarcity of high-quality ground-truth data. Existing public datasets exhibit several limitations, including restricted motion diversity, limited scene coverage, weak degradations, reliance on auxiliary modalities such as event data, and misalignment between low-light inputs and ground truth. Furthermore, current datasets typically address either low-light enhancement or scene understanding, whereas these tasks should be considered jointly. We introduce \textbf{OLiVES}, a benchmark dataset for outdoor low-light videos with dynamic scenes, designed to support both low-light video enhancement (LLVE) and video object segmentation (VOS). The dataset addresses key content gaps by incorporating a diverse range of natural textures, animals, occlusions, dynamic activities, and close-up scenes. To the best of our knowledge, OLiVES is the first outdoor low-light video dataset captured using professional cinema-grade cameras. It provides over 25,000 aligned normal- and low-light frame pairs, along with over 46,000 VOS annotations. We benchmark state-of-the-art LLVE and VOS methods on OLiVES and show that training on it improves performance on both tasks. The OLiVES project page is available at: https://anonymous-OLiVES.github.io/.

articles.title_zh: OLiVES:加强和分化的室外低光视频基准
articles.content_zh: 低光度视频处理仍然是计算机视觉中一个未得到充分探讨的问题,主要原因是缺乏高质量的地面真实数据。 现有的公共数据集呈现出若干局限性,包括运动多样性有限,场景覆盖面有限,退化程度低,依赖事件数据等辅助模式,低光输入和地面真相之间错配. 此外,目前的数据集通常涉及低光度增强或场景理解,而这些任务应共同考虑。 我们引入\textbf{OLiVES},是室外低光视频具有动态场景的基准数据集,旨在同时支持低光视频增强(LLVE)和视频对象分区(VOS). 该数据集通过纳入各种自然纹理、动物、隐蔽物、动态活动和特写场景来解决关键内容差距。 据我们所知,OLiVES是第一个使用专业影院级摄像头捕获的室外低光视频数据集. 它提供超过25,000对对齐的普通和低光框对,以及超过46,000对VOS说明. 我们把最新技术的LLVE和VOS方法作为OLiVES的基准,并表明这方面的培训可以提高这两项任务的业绩。 OLiVES项目网页见:https://anonymous-OLiVES.github.io/。

articles.title: Quantifying privacy risks in foundation model representations of brain MRI
articles.content: Pretrained representations are increasingly used to share and reuse information from medical images without exposing the original scans, but it is unclear how much patient-specific information these representations retain. We investigate this question for brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) by evaluating five frozen pretrained encoders spanning different architectures, pretraining objectives, and training domains on two longitudinal T1-weighted datasets, OASIS-2 and MIRIAD. Under an attacker model with access to released embeddings, the corresponding public encoder, and auxiliary MRI scans, we evaluate patient linkage and sensitive-attribute inference. Across the evaluated representations, we observe substantial subject-specific information: rank-1 patient linkage reaches up to 99\% on MIRIAD and exceeds 90\% on OASIS-2 for the highest-risk representation, despite the absence of an identification objective during encoder training. We further show that the released embeddings retain information about a demographic attribute, with recorded-sex prediction reaching balanced accuracy of 90.9\% on OASIS-2 and 95.5\% on MIRIAD. Overall, our results demonstrate that replacing raw brain MRI with learned embeddings does not, by itself, eliminate patient-linkage or attribute-inference risk, and is therefore insufficient on its own to establish anonymity.

articles.title_zh: 量化大脑核磁共振的基础模型表现中的隐私风险
articles.content_zh: 预先训练的表达方式越来越多地用于分享和再利用来自医疗图像的信息,而不暴露原始扫描,但不清楚这些表达方式保留了多少针对患者的信息. 我们对大脑磁共振成像(MRI)的这个问题进行了调查,评估了5个冷冻的前置编码器,它们跨越了不同的架构、前置训练目标以及两个纵向T1加权数据集(OASIS-2和MIRIAD)的培训领域。 在一个可以访问释放的嵌入物,相应的公共编码器,以及辅助核磁共振扫描的进攻者模型下,我们评价病人的关联和敏感属性推论. 在经过评估的陈述中,我们观察到大量针对特定主题的信息:在MIRIAD上,一等病人的联系达到99+%,在OASIS-2上,风险最高的代表达到90+%,尽管在编码器培训期间没有识别目标。 我们进一步显示,释放的嵌入物保留了有关人口属性的信息,记录的性别预测在OASIS-2和MIRIAD上达到90.9XX的平衡准确度。 总体而言,我们的结果表明,用已学到的嵌入物取代生脑核磁共振本身并不能消除患者-联系或属性-推论风险,因此本身不足以确定匿名性。

articles.title: Equal CER, Unequal Damage: Severity-Weighted Character Error Rate for OCR
articles.content: Character Error Rate (CER), the standard metric for OCR and vision-language models (VLMs), charges a typo as much as a wrong name. We introduce semCER, which keeps CER's alignment and denominator and charges each grapheme edit a severity from an LLM judge, with no word segmentation. Normalized CER keeps the score of a whole transcription, where it tracks readers as well as semCER or better, and semCER breaks that score down into named edits. The charges track readers' ratings edit by edit in English, Vietnamese, and Chinese and put the edits readers rate most severe near the top of a sorted list. On pairs drawn where CER and semCER disagreed, readers side with semCER more often than with normalized CER in English and Chinese, and equally often in Vietnamese. Across 16 languages, the judge charges a wrong diacritic or tone mark almost nothing in Spanish but nearly a wrong letter's severity in Telugu. Where we can count real words, a general VLM's wrong letter forms one far above chance while a classical pipeline's stays near it. We release the 61 million judged edits, the aggregated reader ratings, and the distilled scorer at https://github.com/nguyenx2t/semcer.

articles.title_zh: 相等 CER, 不平等损害: OCR 严重加权字符错误率

articles.title: Infant Fingerprints: Quality Assessment & Recognition
articles.content: Infant fingerprint recognition is hindered by a combination of physiological characteristics, such as small ridge width and spacing, and acquisition challenges that include involuntary motion, skin residue, and uneven fingertip pressure. These factors undermine fingerprint quality standards originally designed for adults, which assume feature distributions that do not hold for infants. To address this gap, this paper evaluates ten fingerprint quality assessment methods on a longitudinal dataset that spans six age groups from newborns to three months, alongside a parameter tuning routine that uncovers age-specific fingerprint characteristics to recalibrate methods with domain-dependent assumptions. Both default and tuned configurations are compared through recognition experiments assessing the effectiveness of quality-guided gallery selection. Template-fusion strategies and latent fingerprint recognition technologies are further examined to identify the best possible matching rates achievable by the top-performing method. Results show that tuned parameter sets outperform default configurations for the majority of methods and age groups, indicating that targeted recalibration of existing frameworks improves gallery utility and contributes to more reliable infant fingerprint recognition.

articles.title_zh: 婴儿指纹:质量评估和鉴定
articles.content_zh: 婴儿指纹的识别受到生理特征(如小脊宽度和间距)和获取挑战(包括非自愿运动、皮肤残留和指尖压力不均衡)的综合影响。 这些因素破坏了原先为成年人设计的指纹质量标准,后者假定特征分布对婴儿没有影响。 为了弥补这一差距,本文在从新生儿到三个月的6个年龄组的纵向数据集上评价了10个指纹质量评估方法,同时还评价了一个参数调整程序,该程序将不同年龄的指纹特征揭示出来,以重新校准方法,并采用依赖域的假设。 默认配置和调制配置均通过评估质量导轨选择的有效性的识别实验进行比较。 进一步审查模板集成战略和潜在指纹识别技术,以确定最佳匹配率,通过最佳方法实现。 结果显示,调制参数为大多数方法和年龄组规定了默认配置,表明有针对性地调整现有框架会改善画廊的效用,有助于更可靠的婴儿指纹识别。

articles.title: Hybrid supervised instance segmentation by learning label noise suppression
articles.content: To reach top accuracy, current fully supervised instance segmentation methods severely rely on large-scale pixel-wise labeled datasets. They are usually expensive and time-consuming to obtain. Though weakly or semi-supervised methods utilize cheap bounding box labeled, image-level labeled or unlabeled samples to save the labeling cost, their performance is largely sacrificed. To save labeling cost without losing much performance, in this paper, we present a pipeline that can utilize economical bounding box labels and accurate pixel-wise labels in a hybrid way. Specifically, we design two ancillary models to learn label noise suppression and obtain accurate pseudo pixel-wise labels from bounding box labels for training. One is designed to suppress mislabeling between foreground and background, and the other is designed to suppress noise from mislabeling of instances. Moreover, we exploit category-aware spatial attention module, category constraint module, instance constraint module, and self-learning training approach to improve the accuracy of pseudo labels. Experiments on the PASCAL VOC 2012 and the Cityscapes datasets show that our method can achieve competitive performance with much less labeling cost.

articles.title_zh: 通过学习标签噪声抑制来混合监督的实例分割
articles.content_zh: 为了达到最高精度,当前完全监督的实例分割方法严重依赖大规模像素类标签数据集. 获得这些设备通常十分昂贵,而且耗费时间。 虽然方法薄弱或半监督,使用贴有标签、图像级别贴有标签或未贴有标签的廉价包装箱样本来节省标签费用,但其性能在很大程度上被牺牲。 为了节省标签成本而不损失很多性能,我们在本文中提出了一个管道,可以使用经济的边框标签和精确的像素级标签。 具体来说,我们设计了两个辅助模型来学习标签噪声抑制,并从边框标签中获取精确的伪像素标签以供训练. 其一旨在抑制前缘和背景之间的错标,其二旨在抑制事件错标产生的噪声. 此外,我们利用了解类别空间的注意模块、类别制约模块、实例制约模块和自学培训方法,提高伪标签的准确性。 有关PASCAL VOC 2012和Cityscapes数据集的实验显示,我们的方法可以实现竞争性的性能,标签成本要低得多.

articles.title: Cortex: Consolidating Context into Parametric Memory
articles.content: Context can improve large language model performance, but these gains may be lost after context removal. Inspired by biological systems consolidation, we formulate Memory Consolidation (MC) as internalizing these gains while preserving non-target capabilities, connecting context-specified editing, skill learning, and behavioral steering under a common objective. We introduce a five-task-family testbed measuring consolidation and retention under single, batch, and sequential updates. We propose Cortex, which generates prospective queries to anticipate uses of context and distills context-conditioned outputs into mergeable low-rank or structural feed-forward network updates. Across 4B--120B dense and mixture-of-experts backbones, including both text-only and multimodal models, Cortex lies on the empirical consolidation--retention Pareto frontier in most evaluated settings. After 50 sequential factual edits on a 14B model, Cortex-Structural recovers 88.9% of the context-induced gain while retaining 99.8% of original non-target performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Cortex: 将上下文合并为参数 内存
articles.content_zh: 上下文可以改善大型语言模型性能,但这些收益可能在上下文删除后丢失. 在生物系统整合的启发下,我们制定了记忆整合(MC),将这些收益内部化,同时保留非目标能力,将特定背景的编辑、技能学习和行为指导在一个共同目标下连接起来。 我们推出一个五个任务家庭测试台,在单一、批量和顺序更新下进行合并和保留。 我们提出Cortex,它产生预期的查询,以预测上下文的用途,并提炼符合上下文的输出物,形成可合并的低等级或结构的向导网络更新。 在整个4B-120B密集和混合的专家骨干中,包括只使用文本和多式联运模式,Cortex位于大多数评价环境中的经验巩固-保留Pareto前沿。 在14B型机车上连续进行50次事实编辑后,Cortex-Structural恢复了上下文引起的收益的88.9%,同时保留了99.8%的原始非目标性能.

articles.title: Where Should the Gaussians Go? Reusable Label-Aware Allocation for Budget-Constrained Gaussian Splatting of Cinematic CT
articles.content: Anatomical labels help 3D Gaussian splatting preserve vessels in cinematic renderings of CT, but the representation is still found by optimising each patient's scene, where densification decides where Gaussians go, while real-time displays cap their number. We address one part of this process: deciding where a fixed budget of B Gaussians should be placed. We propose a reusable, labelaware allocation front end that maps a patient's CT, labels and transfer function to a density over 2mm cells and draws exactly B positions from it without per-patient optimisation; the other Gaussian attributes are still fitted per patient. The front end is learned once from per-patient optimised scenes and implemented as a population-trained neural prior and an interpretable seven-parameter visibility-aware closed form (VACF). With identical attribute fitting on 20 held-out patients at 10K-100K Gaussians, both raise vessel-masked PSNR over uniform allocation by 4.5-7.1dB and over pruning a dense voxel-aligned model by 1.6-3.3dB. The neural prior does not differ significantly from per-patient optimised allocation at any budget, and VACF is within 0.6dB of it on vessels; on 19 external patients the neural prior again matches it on vessels and VACF is within 0.7dB. As an initialisation for position optimisation, VACF allocation beats per-patient densification on vessels at 10K Gaussians and, at 25K, reaches a higher vessel PSNR after 118s of optimisation than densification after 248s. Under altered rendering presets, VACF transfers to new colours and lighting but not to a label-free transfer function, whereas the neural prior shows the opposite pattern.

articles.title_zh: 高斯人该去哪儿? 可重复使用的标签-Aware 预算限制的 Gaussian Cinematic CT 镀层拨款
articles.content_zh: 解剖标签有助于3D高斯滑板在CT的影视渲染中保存器皿,但通过优化每个患者的场景仍然可以找到代表,其中密度决定高斯人去向,而实时显示则封顶他们的数量. 我们处理这一进程的一个部分:决定如何安排B高斯人的固定预算。 我们提出一个可重复使用,标签意识分配的前端,将病人的CT,标签和转移功能映射到密度超过2mm的细胞,并且从中精确地划出B位置,而无需每个病人优化;其他高斯人的属性仍然符合每个病人. 前端从每个患者优化的场景中学习过一次,并作为人口训练的神经前端和可解释的七参数可见度-知觉闭合形式(VACF)执行. 在10K-100K高森岛的20名被扣留的病人身上配有相同的属性,两者都用4.5-7.1dB将船型的PSNR提升到统一分配之上,用1.6-3.3dB将一个密集的Voxel配对模型推开。 神经前科与任何预算中的每名患者优化分配额没有显著差异,VACF在0.6d范围内 B在船上;对19名外科病人来说,之前的神经病再次与船上的神经病吻合,VACF在0.7dB范围内。 作为定位优化的初始化,VACF分配在10K Gaussian在船只上击败每个病人的密度,在25K时,在118次优化后比248次密度后达到更高的PSNR。 在修改的渲染预设下,VACF转录到新的颜色和照明上,但不转录到无标签的传输功能上,而神经前传则显示相反的图案.

articles.title: STP-GUI: Spatially-Aware Token Pruning for Efficient Web-GUI Agents
articles.content: With the rapid development of vision-language models (VLMs), Web-GUI agents have achieved promising performance in interacting with real-world interfaces through screenshot-based grounding. However, high-resolution screenshots and multi-turn histories introduce excessive visual tokens, causing substantial inference overhead. Existing token pruning methods, mainly designed for natural images, often select tokens independently based on importance scores, which can fragment the local visual structures required for recognizing small GUI elements such as buttons, icons, and hyperlinks. In this work, we propose STP-GUI (Spatially-aware Token Pruning for GUI agents), a query-guided token pruning framework that preserves fine-grained instruction-conditioned token scoring while performing spatially coherent window-level selection under aggressive token reduction. A lightweight selector is optimized through policy learning while the VLM backbone remains frozen. Experiments on Online-Mind2Web show that \papername achieves a favorable efficiency-performance tradeoff under low token budgets. At 21% token retention, it preserves 77.7% of full-token performance while reducing inference latency by 31% and FLOPs by 57%. Results on Android in the Wild further suggest that the method transfers to mobile GUI environments.

articles.title_zh: STP-GUI:用于高效网络GUI代理的空间-智能调试
articles.content_zh: 随着视觉语言模型(VLMs)的快速发展,Web-GUI代理商通过基于截图的地面,在与现实世界界面的互动中取得了有希望的性能. 然而,高分辨率截图和多回合历史引入了过多的视觉符号,造成了大量的推论间接. 主要为自然图像而设计的现有令牌刷新方法,经常根据重要性分数独立选择令牌,这可以分割识别按钮,图标,超链接等小型GUI元素所需的局部视觉结构. 在这项工作中,我们提出STP-GUI(Spatial-aware Token Pruning for GUI 代理商),这是一个查询引导的符号推算框架,它保留了精细的教学条件的符号评分,同时在积极的符号减少下进行空间一致的窗口级选择。 轻量级选择器通过政策学习得到优化,而VLM主干线仍然被冻结。 在Online-Mind2Web上的实验显示,\papername在低标价预算下实现了有利的效率性能权衡. 在21%的象征性保留下,它保留了77.7%的全托性能,同时将推断延迟率降低31%,FLOPs降低57%. 荒野中Android的结果进一步表明,该方法向移动GUI环境转移.

articles.title: Look Before You Restore: Learning to Predict Before Acting for Agentic Image Restoration
articles.content: Agents for mixed-degradation image restoration typically learn what a tool does to an image only after running it: failed calls waste computation and harmful outputs go unnoticed until too late. We propose PreActIR, an agentic restoration framework that predicts tool consequences before execution. For each candidate tool, a tool-conditioned world model forecasts changes in residual degradation, image quality, and fidelity, together with the risk of harm and the uncertainty of the prediction. The agent executes the top-ranked candidate, and an independent verifier commits or rolls back its output before the agent replans from the observed state. PreActIR also audits whether performance is limited by the selector or by the candidate space, and studies targeted tool adaptation as a controlled way to expand that space. In a controlled evaluation that fixes the candidate pool, verifier, and budget and employs reference-annotated degradation states, PreActIR uses 42.5% fewer real tool calls and 63.4% fewer rejected calls than reactive, execute-then-evaluate trial and error, while improving Y-PSNR by 0.92 dB.

articles.title_zh: 在您恢复前看: 在代理图像恢复前学习预测
articles.content_zh: 混合降解图像恢复的代理通常只有在运行后才能了解一个工具对一个图像做了什么:失败的调用浪费计算和有害的输出会被忽略直到太迟. 我们提出PreActIR,一个在执行前预测工具后果的代理修复框架. 对每个候选工具而言,一个有工具条件的世界模型预测残余退化、图像质量和忠诚度的变化,以及损害风险和预测的不确定性。 代理人执行排名最高的候选人,独立核查员在代理人从被观察状态重新规划前承诺或回滚其输出. 预设 IR还审计性能是否受选手或候选空间的限制,并研究有针对性的工具改造,以此作为扩大该空间的控制方式. PreActIR使用42.5%的真实工具调用量和63.4%的拒绝调用量比反应性,执行时评价试验和错误少,同时将Y-PSNR改进0.92 dB.

articles.title: ReferFlow: Beyond Final-Target Localization for Complex Referring Expressions
articles.content: Multimodal Large Language Models have made significant progress in referring expression comprehension (REC), yet most REC benchmarks still focus on final-target localization. Complex queries often involve intermediate visual references with different dependencies on prior grounding, but final-only evaluation leaves this process unexamined. To address this gap, we formulate trajectory-level REC, in which models receive an ordered sequence of grounding steps constructed from a single complex query and localize the target regions associated with each step. We instantiate this setting in ReferFlow-Bench, which characterizes structured region transitions through four trajectory types, namely Refinement, Shift, Reset, and Mixture. Experiments show that current models struggle to consistently ground intermediate visual references across successive steps. We further propose ReferFlow, which decouples interleaved text-latent trajectory generation from coordinate decoding. Specifically, Stateful Region Latent Reasoning represents each target region as an object-indexed state composed of continuous latents, with explicit visual and spatial supervision to preserve region information for subsequent grounding. Trajectory-Aware Parallel Decoding then recovers all coordinate blocks in parallel through four geometry-constrained refinement rounds, with each block conditioned on its corresponding trajectory prefix, thereby reducing within-box sequential dependencies and eliminating cross-box autoregression. We further apply Grounding-Aware GRPO to promote consistent grounding across steps and learn adaptive trajectory generation from complex REC queries. ReferFlow achieves leading performance on general REC benchmarks and ReferFlow-Bench.

articles.title_zh: 参考Flow: 超越最终目标定位, 用于复杂的参考表达式
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型在转介表达理解(REC)方面取得了重大进展,但大多数REC基准仍然侧重于最终目标本地化。 复杂的查询往往涉及中间视觉参考,对先前的基础有不同的依赖性,但只有最终的评价使得这一过程没有经过审查. 为了弥补这一差距,我们制定了轨迹级REC,其中模型接收从单一复杂查询中构建的有序的地面步骤顺序,并使与每一步骤相关的目标区域本地化。 我们在ReferenceFlow-Bench中即时分析这个设置,它通过四个轨迹类型,即Finement,Shift,Reset,和Mixture,来描述结构化的区域过渡。 实验表明,目前的模型在连续步骤中坚持不懈地铺设中间视觉参考。 我们进一步建议ReferenceFlow, 脱钩从坐标解码中分离出文本相对的轨迹生成。 具体地说,Stencils Region Latent Reasoning代表着每个目标区域,作为一个由连续潜伏物组成的物体索引状态,并有明确的视觉和空间监督,以保存区域信息,供随后搁浅。 轨迹 - 同步 解码后通过四个几何约束的精制回合平行地回收所有坐标块,每个区块以相应的轨迹前缀为条件,从而减少箱内依次依赖,消除跨箱自旋. 我们进一步采用地面-智能GRPO,以促进跨步骤的一致地面,并从复杂的区域经济委员会查询中学习适应性轨迹生成。 ReferenceFlow在REC一般基准和ReferenceFlow-Bench上取得了领先业绩.

articles.title: InfiniSplat v2: Analyzing and Improving Feed-Forward 3DGS from Any Views
articles.content: Feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction builds 3D scenes directly from input images for novel view rendering, but learning Gaussian attributes from predicted geometry for high-quality rendering under large viewpoint changes remains challenging. We analyze limitations in Gaussian attribute learning and introduce InfiniSplat v2, which improves rendering quality through architectural and training changes. Our method decouples geometry and attribute prediction with a frozen geometry branch, aligns predicted Gaussians using ground-truth camera poses during training, and adopts large-angle target view supervision. Across six datasets, the feed-forward outputs of the same trained model achieve state-of-the-art mean LPIPS and DISTS among the evaluated methods in both pose-conditioned and pose-free settings. In the pose-conditioned setting, mean LPIPS and DISTS decrease by 25.8% and 32.9%, respectively, compared with the strongest evaluated baselines. We further find that opacity learned with only image reconstruction supervision suppresses geometrically inconsistent points. Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/InfiniSplat2/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: InfiniSplat v2: 从任何视图分析并改进 Feed-Forward 3DGS
articles.content_zh: Feed-forward Gaussian重建直接从输入图像中构建3D场景,用于新颖的视图渲染,但从预测几何学来学习高斯的属性,用于大视角变化下的高质量渲染,仍然具有挑战性. 我们分析高斯主义属性学习中的局限性,并引入InfiniSplat v2,通过建筑和培训变化提高渲染质量. 我们的方法将几何学和属性预测与冷冻几何分支脱钩,将预测的高斯人使用地面真实相机在训练时摆放,并采用大角目标视图监督. 在六个数据集中,同一训练有素的模型的反馈输出,在所评价的假设和无假象环境下,在方法中达到最先进的LPIPS和DSTS。 在假设条件下,与最强的评价基线相比,平均最低生活保障指数和最低生活保障指数分别下降了25.8%和32.9%。 我们进一步发现,只有图像重建监督才能发现的不透明现象会抑制几何不一致的点。 项目网页:https://zju3dv.github.io/InfiniSplate2/

articles.title: Read, Parse, Describe: Unified Document Parsing with Visual Element Description Generation
articles.content: Document understanding systems are typically evaluated as separate components via layout analysis, optical text recognition, reading-order prediction, and image captioning. This separation leaves scientific figures, captions, and visual semantics weakly connected, and fails to measure whether a model can produce a single page-level parse that is both structurally faithful and semantically accessible. We introduce Read-Parse-Describe, a unified dataset for document parsing with visual element description generation. Given a page image, models are required to output an ordered list of layout elements containing bounding boxes, semantic labels, reading-order indices, recognized textual content, and alternative text descriptions for visual elements. The benchmark is built from 2,402 documents, comprising 18,163 continuous pages, 125,218 layout elements, and 11,338 visual instances. Besides, we further propose a plug-and-play space-awareness enhancer that reuses multi-layer visual features and injects grid-aware spatial guidance into vision-language tokens for layout-aware generation. Experiments across end-to-end VLMs and pipeline parsers show that existing systems still struggle to jointly recover reading order and visual semantics, while our enhanced model achieves strong joint performance. These results highlight the need to move beyond isolated document parsing modules toward unified models that jointly read, parse, and describe complex documents. The new dataset and code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/yufanchen96/RPD
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 读取, 解析, 描述: 使用视觉元素描述生成的统一文档解析
articles.content_zh: 文件理解系统通常通过布局分析、光学文本识别、读序预测和图像字幕作为单独的组件加以评价。 这种分离使得科学人物,标题和视觉语义连接薄弱,无法衡量一个模型是否能够产生一个既在结构上忠实又能精准获取的单页级剖析. 我们引入 Read-Parse-Description,一个用于文档解析的用视觉元素描述生成的统一数据集. 鉴于一个页面图像,模型需要输出一个有序的布局元素列表,包含边框,语义标签,读序索引,公认的文本内容,以及视觉元素的替代文本描述. 该基准以2 402份文件为基础,包括18 163个连续页、125 218个布局要素和11 338个视觉实例。 此外,我们进一步提出一个插座和游戏空间意识增强器,重新利用多层视觉特征,并将网格感知空间引导注入视觉语言符号,用于布局感知生成. 跨端到端的VLM和管道解析器的实验显示,现有的系统仍然在努力联合恢复读取顺序和视觉语义,而我们增强的模型则实现了强大的联合性能. 这些结果突出表明,需要超越孤立的文档解析模块,转向联合阅读、解析和描述复杂文档的统一模式。 新的数据集和代码将在https://github.com/yufanchen96/RPD上公布。

articles.title: Beyond Static Cues: Unified Dynamic Detection of MLLM Backdoors via Dual-Flow Trajectory Analysis
articles.content: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical domains, yet their susceptibility to backdoor attacks remains a formidable challenge. While existing defenses have evolved from visual-centric patch cues to unsupervised internal attention statistics, they are fundamentally constrained by a reliance on static snapshots and attack-specific heuristics. Given the intricate interplay between dual modalities, the vast design space for multimodal triggers allows diverse threats, such as textual injections, sub-perceptual noises, and coordinated cross-modal triggers, to easily circumvent such rigid priors, particularly when attack types are unknown in real-world applications. In this paper, we rethink backdoor detection by shifting the diagnostic paradigm from static observations to dynamic output evolution. We observe that a successful attack inevitably hijacks the model's decoding trajectory, skewing internal modal contributions during generation while maintaining an abnormal output invariance despite input perturbations. To capture this behavior, we propose EVO-Detect, a unified detection framework that monitors the dynamic evolution of internal signals during early decoding steps through two complementary channels: Attention Flow and Logits Flow. The attention branch measures how image-text attention allocation evolves during early generation, whereas the logits branch quantifies the sensitivity of the output distribution to modal perturbations through interventional ablations. We then convert these trajectories into compact sample-level metrics and normalize them against negative-control signatures so that natural perturbations are less likely to be mistaken for backdoor evidence. Extensive evaluations show that our approach substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines such as BYE and TCAP across diverse attack families.

articles.title_zh: Beyond Static Cues:通过双流轨迹分析对 MLLM 后门进行统一动态检测
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大型语言模型越来越多地部署在安全关键领域,但其易受后门攻击的可能性仍然是一项艰巨的挑战。 虽然现有的防御手段已经从以视觉为中心的补丁提示发展到无监督的内部关注统计,但它们在根本上受到依赖静态快照和攻击特异性heuristic的制约. 鉴于双重模式之间错综复杂的相互作用,多式联运触发器的广阔设计空间允许各种威胁,例如文字注入、次概念噪声以及协调的跨模式触发器,从而容易规避这种僵硬的前兆,特别是在实际世界应用中未知攻击类型时。 在本文中,我们通过将诊断范式从静态观测转向动态输出演化,重新思考后门检测. 我们观察到,成功的攻击不可避免地会劫持模型的解码轨迹,在一代人的时间里窃取内部模式的贡献,同时尽管输入扰动却保持异常的输出变化. 为了抓住这一行为,我们提出EVO-Detect(EVO-Detect),一个统一的检测框架,通过两个互补的渠道来监测早期解码步骤中内部信号的动态演化:注意力流和逻辑流. 注意力分支衡量图像文本注意力分配如何在早期生成过程中演变,而对数分支则通过干预冲洗将输出分布对模式扰动的敏感性量化. 然后将这些轨迹转换成紧凑的样本级度量衡,使其与负控制签名相适应,这样自然扰动就不会被误认为是后门证据. 广泛的评价表明,我们的做法大大超过各种攻击家庭的最新基线,如BYE和TCAP。

articles.title: Event Cameras versus Frame Cameras for Synthetic-Aperture Imaging: A Simulation Study
articles.content: Synthetic-aperture imaging (SAI) removes occluders such as foliage by integrating many views of a scene along a camera path. It has so far been used mainly with frame cameras. We ask whether an event camera has advantages for SAI, and answer the question in simulation, where both sensors see exactly the same scene and the same camera movement. A densely rendered Blender sequence is turned into frames with an EMVA~1288 noise model of an industrial global-shutter camera, and into an event stream with the v2e simulator parameterized like a Sony IMX636. The frames are integrated with the existing airborne optical sectioning renderer. For the events we add a new integration path that projects every single event onto the focal plane at its own interpolated pose, so no events have to be binned into frames. We compare the two sensors in three main runs and an additional dark high-speed test. In a bright scene at 25,m/s the frame camera records only three images on the path and cannot remove the occluder, while the event camera reconstructs the target, even after an event-rate controller drops most of its events to fit the camera link. At the same speed in a 5,lux scene the event camera no longer resolves the target either. In a 5,lux scene at 5,m/s both sensors reconstruct the target at similar quality. We also compare the data one traversal of the aperture costs. At high speed the capped event stream still shows the target at the same data volume as the three frames. At 1,m/s we compare both cameras at two matched data budgets, and there the event camera has no advantage over the frame camera in reconstruction quality. The data rate of the event camera depends on the scene and is highest exactly in the fast bright scenes where it is needed most.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 合成-光圈事件相机与帧相机 成像:模拟研究
articles.content_zh: 合成-孔径成像(SAI)通过整合镜头路径上对一个场景的许多视图来清除叶片等吞噬物. 迄今为止,它主要使用帧摄像头. 我们问一个事件相机是否对SI有优势,并在模拟中回答这个问题,在模拟中,两个传感器都看到完全相同的场景和相同的相机运动. 高密度的Blender序列被用工业全球流线照相机的EMVA~1288噪声模型变成帧,并变成一个像索尼IMX636一样参数化的v2e模拟器的事件流. 框架与现有空载光学剖面渲染器结合。 对于事件,我们添加了一条新的集成路径,将每个事件都以自己的插图形式投射到焦平面上,所以不需要将事件装入帧中. 我们比较了三个主要运行中的两个传感器 和额外的暗高速测试。 在25,m/s的明亮场景中,帧相机只记录路径上的3个图像,无法移除占卜器,而事件相机则重建目标,即使在一个事件速率控制器放下大部分事件以适应相机链接之后. 以同样的速度在5号豪华场景中,事件镜头也不再解决目标. 在5号的豪华场景中,5m/s两种传感器以类似的质量重建目标. 我们还比较了光圈成本的逆向数据。 高速时,封顶事件流仍然以与三帧相同的数据量显示目标. 1,m/s我们比较两个相机 在两个匹配的数据预算, 在那里,事件相机没有优势 比帧相机 在重建质量。 事件相机的数据速率取决于场景,并且恰好在最需要的快速亮度场景中最高.

articles.title: A Valid Watermark Is Not a Valid Identity: Spatial-Spectral Adversarial Face Evasion with Watermark Preservation
articles.content: Facial image watermarking can support traceability and certification in biometric pipelines, but provenance or manipulation detection alone does not guarantee reliable biometric identity. We introduce a watermark-preserving face evasion attack that targets this gap under a black-box watermarking setting, without access to the watermarking components. The proposed PGD-L_2 attack guides adversarial perturbations with spatial and spectral preservation terms to reduce face-recognition similarity while limiting pixel-level distortion and high-frequency changes that may interfere with hidden watermark cues. Evaluated on controlled facial images with two watermarking schemes, two face-recognition models, and two datasets, the attack achieves evasion rates above 92% at operational thresholds while preserving watermark recovery above 93% for StegaFormer and above 99.7% for FaceSigns, with visual quality above 47dB PSNR at epsilon_2=2.0. These results expose a structural gap in watermark-based facial certification: a face image can remain watermark-valid and visually faithful while becoming biometrically unreliable.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 有效水印不是有效身份:空间-特定横向外观与水印保护
articles.content_zh: 面部图像水印可以支持生物鉴别管道的可追踪性和认证,但仅凭来源或操纵检测并不能保证可靠的生物鉴别特征. 我们引入了防水标记的避水面攻击,在黑盒水标记设置下瞄准这个缺口,而不能进入水标记组件. 拟议的PGD-L_2攻击用空间和光谱保存术语指导对抗性扰动,以减少面部识别相似性,同时限制像素水平扭曲和高频变化,这些变化可能干扰隐藏的水印提示. 使用两个水印方案、两个面部识别模型和两个数据集对受控面部图像进行评估,在操作阈值时,攻击的逃逸率超过92%,同时将StegaFormer的水印回收率保持在93%以上,FaceSigns的回收率保持在99.7%以上,在epsilon_2=2.0时,视觉质量高于47dB PSNR。 这些结果暴露了基于水印的面部认证的结构性差距:面部图像可以保持水印和视觉上的忠实,同时变得生物特征不可靠.

articles.title: Resolution Allocation with Learnable Resizing and Spectral Filter Parameterization
articles.content: Learnable downsampling and spectral-domain filter parameterizations have each made convolutional networks more flexible, but their interaction has not been systematically examined. We bridge this gap by examining convolutional kernels learned in the spatial and spectral domains, together with learned downsampling ratios under a cropped resizing implementation. We find that spectral and spatial kernels respond differently to learned resolution allocation, with larger gains for the spectral kernel. We observe this consistently on three datasets (EuroSAT, CIFAR-10 and STL-10) and at two model sizes (differences in accuracy gain of +0.013 to +0.028 on held-out test sets). Part of this difference reflects the greater gain of the spectral kernel from retaining more spatial area, but the difference remains positive when total retained area is matched. This pattern is observed across datasets and model sizes, although its magnitude and dependence on the complexity budget vary with model size and the resizing implementation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 用可学习的调整大小和光谱过滤器分配分辨率
articles.content_zh: 可学习的下采样和光谱域滤波参数化,使演化网络更加灵活,但它们的相互作用并没有被系统审查. 我们通过审查在空间和光谱领域学到的内核,以及根据裁剪后的重新定型执行所学到的下采样比率,来弥补这一差距。 我们发现光谱和空间内核对所学到的分辨率分配的反应不同,光谱内核的增益更大. 我们从三个数据集(EuroSAT、CIFAR-10和STL-10)和两个模型大小(在停机试验中精度增益+0.013至+0.028)上一致观察到这一点。 这一差异的一部分反映了光谱内核从保留更多空间面积中获得更大的收益,但当总保留面积匹配时,差异仍然是正数. 这种模式在数据集和模型规模中都有所观察到,尽管其规模和对复杂预算的依赖程度因模型规模和重新确定实施规模而异。

articles.title: GLoD-LVSM: Learning Geometry-Grounded Continuous-LoD Scene Representations for Large View Synthesis Models
articles.content: Large view synthesis models (LVSMs) reconstruct scenes from sparse views and render novel views quickly, but they incur unnecessary storage and rendering costs due to token redundancy. We present GLoD-LVSM, a compact, geometry-grounded scene representation for LVSMs with continuous levels of detail. First, instead of learning a fixed set of scene anchor initializations, GLoD-LVSM learns a continuous field that initializes a flexible number of anchors to match the desired budget. A condenser then aggregates scene information into these anchors, with both the field and condenser trained end-to-end. Second, the condenser infers reference-token and anchor geometry to guide compression through geometry-grounded attention, improving rendering quality and enabling frustum culling during decoding. Compared with existing LVSM scene-compression baselines, GLoD-LVSM achieves the best trade-off between rendering quality and scene token count. Compared with the uncompressed base model, GLoD-LVSM reduces the scene-token count by 33.4% and accelerates rendering by $1.23\times$ with no quality loss. Under a relaxed quality-loss budget, the reduction increases to 85.5%, with $3.00\times$ rendering speedup. Further analysis reveals that view-synthesis supervision yields emergent scene depth and self-organized anchors that align with surfaces and adapt their density to local texture complexity. Beyond rendering, we further show that our scene representation also supports scene-semantic understanding, highlighting its potential for broader downstream tasks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GLOD- LVSM: 大视图合成模型的学习几何组合连续-LOD场景表现
articles.content_zh: 大视野合成模型(LVSMs)从稀少的视角重建场景,并快速渲染出新颖的视角,但由于象征性的冗余,它们会花费不必要的存储和渲染成本. 我们提出GLOD-LVSM,是一个紧凑的,几何定位的场景代表 LVSM 持续的详细程度. 首先,GLOD-LVSM没有学习固定的一组场景主播初始化,而是学习了一个连续的场景,将一些灵活的主播初始化,以配合理想的预算. 冷凝器然后将场景信息集成到这些锚上,现场和冷凝器都经过了端到端的训练. 第二,冷凝器推断参考基和锚几何,通过几何基的注意来引导压缩,提高渲染质量,并使解码过程中的frustum culling成为可能. 与现有的LVSM场景压缩基线相比,GLOD-LVSM在渲染质量和场景符号计数之间实现了最好的权衡. 与未压缩的基数模型相比,GLOD-LVSM将场景的计数减少33.4%,并加速渲染1.23\times$,没有质量损失. 在宽松的质量损失预算下,削减率增至85.5%,增加3.00\%的美元渲染速度。 进一步的分析表明,视图合成监督会产生场景的深度和自组织锚,与表面一致,使其密度适应当地纹理的复杂性。 除了渲染外,我们进一步表明,我们的场景代表也支持场景语义理解,凸显出其在更广泛的下游任务中的潜力.

articles.title: Contrastive uncertainty learning for robust multi-structure segmentation in lower-pelvic MR
articles.content: Boundary delineation of anatomical structures in prostate MRI is often compromised by regional ambiguity. Automated segmentation methods relying on global overlap loss functions tend to be insensitive to surface deviations, leading to significant errors in ambiguous regions. Most existing uncertainty-aware methods treat uncertainty as a post-hoc quality indicator or prediction filter. We propose Contrastive Uncertainty Learning (CUL), a supervised framework that uses predictive uncertainty to directly guide representation learning. Using Monte Carlo Dropout, CUL identifies voxel-wise uncertainty and structures the embedding geometry accordingly: low-uncertainty, correctly predicted features form stable voxels while high-uncertainty or misclassified features are actively repelled, preventing feature collapse at difficult boundaries. We evaluate CUL on a 589-scan 3D prostate MRI multi-structure segmentation task (8 anatomical structures) using a ViT with UperNet decoder architecture. Average Dice ($83.38\%$) remains comparable to the baseline ($83.35\%$), while surface distance decreases significantly ($p<0.001$) across 6 of 8 anatomical structures. A hard-case analysis reveals a $22{\times}$ asymmetry between significantly improved and degraded cases ($18.8\%$ vs $0.9\%$). Ablation studies show that removing uncertainty-guided sample selection eliminates improvements for the transition zone, while replacing the contrastive objective with a boundary loss additionally removes bladder improvements, demonstrating that both uncertainty-guided sampling and the contrastive objective are essential for the observed gains. These findings demonstrate that the proposed uncertainty-guided representation learning is a useful mechanism for reducing the risk of extreme errors in safety-critical medical segmentation

articles.title_zh: 在下骨盆MR中进行强力多结构分割的对比性不确定性学习
articles.content_zh: 前列腺核磁共振中解剖结构的划界往往受到区域模糊性的影响。 依赖全球重叠损失功能的自动分割方法往往对表面偏差不敏感,导致模糊区域出现重大错误。 大多数现有的不确定性意识方法将不确定性作为热后质量指标或预测过滤器处理. 我们建议采用对比不确定性学习(CulL),这是一个监督框架,利用预测不确定性直接指导代表性学习。 使用Monte Carlo Dropout,CUL识别了voxel-wise的不确定性,并据此构建嵌入几何:低不确定性,正确预测的特征形成稳定的voxel,而高不确定性或错分类的特征则被积极击退,防止特征在困难边界下崩溃. 我们使用带有UperNet解码器架构的ViT,对589扫描3D前列腺核磁共振多结构分解任务(8个解剖结构)进行CUL评价. 平均剂量(83.38美元)仍与基线值(83.35美元)相当,8个解剖结构中的6个结构的表面距离(p<0.001美元)则大幅下降。 硬案例分析显示,在明显改善的病例和退化的病例之间有22美元不对称(18.8美元对0.9美元)。 差异研究显示,消除不确定性引导样本选择消除了过渡带的改善,而以边界损失取代对比目标,进一步消除了膀胱的改善,表明不确定性引导取样和对比目标对观察到的收益至关重要。 这些调查结果表明,拟议的以不确定性为指南的表述方式学习是减少安全关键医疗隔离中极端错误风险的有用机制。

articles.title: PAWA: Panoramic Action-conditioned World Modeling for Multiple Agents
articles.content: A multiplayer world model must predict how the independent actions of several players change a shared environment, including changes outside a player's current field of view. A point-of-view (POV) video captures such changes only after they enter its field of view, whereas panoramic video records the surroundings in every viewing direction and has served as an intermediate representation of the world state in recent world models. Learning this task therefore requires synchronized POV and panoramic videos of interacting players together with their actions, yet no existing dataset provides this combination in Minecraft, an established testbed in which players act independently in a shared, modifiable 3D world. We present PAWA, a dataset and framework for action-conditioned panoramic multiplayer world modeling. The dataset pairs each player's POV video with world-stabilized panoramic video and aligned actions. Its distributed pipeline decouples CPU gameplay capture from GPU rendering, scales beyond 64 simultaneous players, and re-renders each recorded session under new observation configurations without replaying the gameplay. On this dataset, we develop a dual-tower model that jointly predicts POV and panoramic video and couples the two streams through cross-attention that aligns tokens observing the same direction in a shared world frame. We further introduce a quadratic-phase player encoding that provides many more player codes than existing rotary codes at the same embedding dimension. Experiments show that PAWA outperforms state-of-the-art multiplayer world models in POV prediction quality while also producing high-fidelity panoramic predictions. The dataset and collection pipeline are open source to support further research on multiplayer world models.

articles.title_zh: PAWA:具有全景行动条件的多种制剂世界模型制作
articles.content_zh: 一个多人世界模型必须预测几个玩家的独立行动如何改变共享的环境,包括玩家当前视野以外的变化. 央视(POV)视频只有在进入其央视领域后才能捕捉到这些变化,而全景视频则记录了每个央视方向的周边,并充当了近代世界模型中世界状态的中间代表. 因此学习这个任务需要同步的POV和全景视频互动玩家及其动作,然而现有的数据集并没有在Minecraft中提供这种组合,Minecraft是玩家在一个共享的,可修改的3D世界中独立行动的既定测试床. 我们介绍了PAWA,这是一个数据集和框架,用于以行动为条件的全景多人世界建模。 数据集将每个玩家的POV视频与世界稳定全景视频和对齐动作对齐. 其分布的管道脱钩CPU游戏机从GPU渲染中捕获,规模超过64个同时玩家,并在新的观察配置下重新发送每个录制的会话而不重播游戏机. 在这个数据集上,我们开发了一个双塔模型,通过交叉注意力来联合预测POV和全景视频,以及两条流的对接,使符号在共享的世界框架内观测到相同的方向. 我们进一步引入了四相播放器编码,提供比同一嵌入维度上现有的旋转码多得多的播放器编码. 实验显示,PAWA在POV预测质量方面优于最先进的多人世界模型,同时也产生高真实度全景预测. 数据集和收集管道是开源,以支持对多人世界模型的进一步研究.

articles.title: Glance Forcing: Making Bidirectional Diffusion Autoregressive at a Glance
articles.content: Autoregressive generation underlies real-time, causal video synthesis and is the backbone of video world models. Today's dominant approach distills a bidirectional diffusion model into a causal few-step student, but existing pipelines make this conversion prohibitively expensive, requiring offline Probability Flow ODE} (PF-ODE) trajectories that cost tens of thousands of GPU-hours and terabytes of storage. We show it can be made dramatically more efficient. Pushing this efficiency to its extreme, we reduce trajectory supervision to a single sample, the strictest setting possible, and find that it causes severe quality collapse. We trace this to the teacher's trajectory geometry: the high-noise regime, governing semantic layout and motion, and the low-noise regime, governing fine texture exhibit fundamentally different curvature and optimization behavior, so a single monolithic student cannot jointly fit both, causing severe representation interference. Motivated by this, we propose Glance Forcing, a lightweight distillation framework that decouples the denoising trajectory into two complementary slow and fast experts, each guided by a tailored, stage-specific objective, while keeping the pretrained teacher entirely frozen. This decoupling further reveals a general mechanism underlying few-step distillation: PF-ODE distillation mainly straightens the few-step trajectory geometry, while the subsequent distribution-matching stage independently governs distributional quality. Using only one PF-ODE trajectory, Glance Forcing already surpasses the fully-trained state-of-the-art baseline, raising the VBench Total score from 84.04 to 84.22 while cutting trajectory-collection cost from thousands of GPU-hours to about one A100-GPU-hour, with markedly larger gains in dynamic degree, VisionReward, and instruction-following, and consistent preference from human raters over strong baselines.
