articles.title_zh: 外观强化:使双向扩散在外观中自动递减
articles.content_zh: 自动递归生成是实时,因果视频合成的基础,也是视频世界模型的支柱. 今天的主导方法将双向扩散模型蒸馏成一个因果的几步学生,但现有的管道使得这种转换过于昂贵,需要离线概率流(PF-ODE)轨迹,耗资数万GPU小时和兆字节存储. 我们显示,可以大大提高效率。 把这种效率推到极点, 我们把轨迹监督减少到一个单一的样本, 最严格的环境, 并发现它会导致严重的质量崩溃。 我们将此追溯到老师的轨迹几何:高噪声制度,规范语义布局和运动,低噪声制度,规范精细的纹理表现了根本不同的曲率和优化行为,所以单体学生无法共同适应两者,造成严重的表达干扰. 以此为动机,我们提出Glance Forcing, 一种轻量级的蒸馏框架, 将去诺分化的轨迹 分解为两个互补的慢速专家, 各自以一个量身定做的阶段性目标为指导, 同时让预先训练的老师完全冻结。 这种脱钩进一步揭示了一种基本为几步蒸馏的一般机制:PF-ODE蒸馏主要理顺几步轨迹几何,而随后的分布比对阶段则独立地管辖分布质量. 仅使用一个PF-ODE轨迹,Glance Forcing已经超过了训练有素的先进基线,将V Bench总分从84.04提高到84.22,同时将轨迹收集成本从数千GPU小时削减到大约一个A100-GPU小时,在动态度、Visual Reward和教学跟踪方面都取得了明显更大的收益,并且人类测算员始终倾向于强基线。

articles.title: Continual pretraining Prostate MRI ViT Encoder for task alignment
articles.content: Building foundation models for MRI has emerged as a promising direction for advancing medical image analysis and improving accessibility of task specific models. Existing approaches primarily focus on effective pretraining strategies and evaluating their performance across diverse downstream tasks. While these methods show performance gains, limited attention has been given to understanding task alignment between pretraining and downstream objectives. Unlike language models, where the two stages are naturally aligned, such alignment is less evident in vision based applications. Motivated by this gap, we explore continual pretraining. Specifically, continually pretraining a pretrained ViT encoder using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) on a prostate segmentation task to enhance task alignment and downstream performance. We further perform layer-wise representational analysis using Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) to assess representational shifts and their correlation with task outcomes. Our experiments show improved performance in 3 of 6 downstream tasks and comparable results in the others. Our Feature analysis reveals that, for segmentation tasks, continually pretrained encoder features exhibit greater similarity to those of the finetuned encoder than the original pretrained encoder, correlating with observed performance gains.

articles.title_zh: 连续预训 前列腺核磁共振 虚拟 任务对齐的编码器
articles.content_zh: 建立核磁共振的基础模型已成为推进医疗图像分析和改进具体任务模型的可获性的一个有希望的方向。 现有办法主要侧重于有效的培训前战略,并评价这些战略在各种下游任务中的业绩。 虽然这些方法显示出业绩的提高,但对于理解培训前目标和下游目标之间的任务协调重视有限。 与两个阶段自然对齐的语言模型不同,这种对齐在基于视觉的应用中不那么明显. 基于这一差距,我们探索继续预先训练。 具体地说,在前列腺分解任务上,利用低RANK适应(LORA)不断预先训练一个预先训练的ViT编码器,以加强任务对接和下游性能. 我们进一步利用核心核心内核对齐(CKA)进行分层代表分析,以评估代表的变化及其与任务结果的相关性。 我们的实验显示,在6项下游任务中,有3项任务的业绩有所改善,其他任务则有类似的结果。 我们的特性分析显示,对于分解任务来说,持续经过预先训练的编码器特性与经过微调的编码器的特性相比,与原先经过预先训练的编码器更为相似,与观察到的性能增益相关。

articles.title: OneLA: Learning Many Worlds from Latent Actions
articles.content: Learning world models across diverse domains calls for a unified control space, yet ac- tion interfaces vary across domains and action annotations are often scarce. Latent ac- tions learned directly from videos offer a promising way to establish such a space without explicit action supervision. However, learning shared latent actions across domains re- mains challenging, as variations in appearance, embodiment, and dynamics can entangle domain-specific visual cues with transferable transition structure. To this end, we intro- duce OneLA, a simple framework that learns continuous latent actions through a shared orthogonal dictionary and a common predictive objective, without task-specific designs or cross-domain alignment losses during latent action pretraining. These latent actions pro- vide a shared conditioning interface for world models, with lightweight adapters mapping native control commands into the same space. Conditioned on latent actions and the cur- rent visual state, the world model predicts context-dependent transitions for controllable rollout. OneLA improves action readout across domains and reduces action cycle-transfer rotation error by 24.8% over the strongest evaluated baseline. A joint-training comparison further shows a 20.5% improvement in Human Preference Score v3 (HPSv3) for real- scene generation. These results suggest a path toward general-purpose world models that learn from diverse videos and support flexible control through latent action space.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OneLA: 从后期行动中学习许多世界
articles.content_zh: 跨越不同领域的学习世界模型要求有一个统一的控制空间,然而AC-tion接口因域而异,动作说明往往很少. 直接从视频中得知的Latent ac-tions为在没有明确的行动监督下建立这样一个空间提供了一个很有希望的方法. 然而,在各领域学习共同的潜在行动,将具有挑战性,因为外观、表征和动态的变化可以将特定领域的视觉提示与可转移的过渡结构纠缠在一起。 为此,我们Intro-duce OneLA是一个简单的框架,通过共享的正统字典和共同的预测目标来学习持续的潜伏动作,在潜伏动作预训期间没有特定任务的设计或跨域对齐损失. 这些潜在动作有利于为世界模型提供共享的调节接口,轻量级适配器将本土控制指令映射到同一个空间. 以潜在动作和Cur - 租赁视觉状态为条件,世界模型预测了可控推出的依赖上下文的过渡. OneLA改进了跨域的动作读取,并将动作周期转移旋转误差比最强的评价基线减少24.8%. 联合训练比较进一步显示,在真实场景生成方面,人类首选分数v3(HPSv3)提高20.5%. 这些结果显示了通向通用世界模式的道路,从各种视频中学习,并通过潜在行动空间支持灵活控制。

articles.title: Dataset-Level Regularization for Joint-Embedding Self-Supervised Learning
articles.content: Self-supervised joint embedding learning aligns representations of augmented views while regularizing their distribution to prevent collapse. Regularization aims to shape the overall representation distribution, but most joint embedding methods restrict its computation to the active minibatch. We propose out-of-batch regularization, which maintains a dataset-level state in CPU memory and uses globally constructed per-instance targets during minibatch training. Evaluated on natural images and biomedical datasets, these anchors approximate the full-dataset regularization gradient more faithfully than conventional minibatch estimation at small batch sizes. Applications to contrastive (SimCLR) and non-contrastive (SIGReg) approaches show consistent improvement over the corresponding in-batch objectives for image classification, minority-class performance under controlled imbalance, instance retrieval, and continued self-supervised pretraining, with the largest gains at small batch sizes. These results suggest that dataset-level regularization can be decoupled from minibatch optimization, making batch size an optimization choice that does not affect the geometry of the regularizer.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 联合编辑自我监督学习的数据集级规范化
articles.content_zh: 自我监督的联合嵌入式学习将扩大观点的表述结合起来,同时规范其分发,以防止崩溃。 正规化旨在塑造总体代表分布,但大多数联合嵌入方法将其计算限制在活动小批量. 我们提出出舱规范化,在CPU内存中保持数据集级别状态,并在小舱训练中使用全球构建的每舱目标. 在对自然图像和生物医学数据集进行评估后,这些锚与小批量的常规小批量估计相比,更忠实于完整的数据集规范梯度。 对对比性(SimCLR)和非重复性(SIGREG)方法的应用显示,在图像分类、在控制失衡、实例检索和继续自我监督的预训下少数群体阶层的表现以及小批量规模的最大收益方面,相对相应的包中目标而言,持续改进。 这些结果显示,数据集级规范化可以与小批量优化脱钩,使批量大小成为优化选择,不影响规范化几何.

articles.title: Attention-Based Spatio-Temporal Approach for Fire and Smoke Detection
articles.content: In various industries, smoke and fire are two of the most important threats in the workplace. One of the common methods for detecting smoke and fire is the use of infrared thermal and smoke sensors, which cannot be used in outdoor applications. Therefore, the use of vision-based methods seems necessary. The problem of smoke and fire detection is spatiotemporal and requires spatiotemporal solutions. This paper presents a method that uses spatial features along with temporal-based features to detect smoke and fire in the scene. It consists of three main parts; the task of each part is to reduce the error of the previous part so that the final model has a robust performance. This method also uses transformer modules to increase the accuracy of the model. The results of our model show the proper performance of the proposed approach in solving the problem of smoke and fire detection and can be used to increase workplace safety.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 基于关注的火灾和烟雾检测时空方法
articles.content_zh: 在各种行业,烟火是工作场所最重要的两个威胁. 检测烟火的常用方法之一是使用红外热感应器和烟雾感应器,不能用于室外应用. 因此,似乎有必要采用基于远见的方法。 烟雾和火灾探测问题是瞬间性的,需要瞬间的解决办法。 本文介绍了一种利用空间特征以及时间特征探测现场烟火的方法. 它由三个主要部分组成;每个部分的任务是减少前部分的误差,以便最终模型具有强劲的性能. 这种方法还使用变压器模块来提高模型的精度. 我们模式的结果表明,拟议办法在解决烟雾和火灾探测问题方面表现得适当,可用于加强工作场所安全。

articles.title: StreamErase: Towards Ultra-Fast Streaming Video Erasing
articles.content: Current video object removal methods suffer from prohibitive latency (minutes per video) and non-causal processing that prevents real-time interaction. We present StreamErase, enabling sub-second latency with up to 26 FPS streaming generation on a single GPU. Our approach first augments a text-to-video model with mask input to generate high-quality videos that erase target objects and synthesize coherent backgrounds, but does not perform inference on the fly. As such, we progressively transfer the erasing capability from a powerful bidirectional foundation model to an efficient unidirectional streaming eraser, enabling long-horizon erasing without sacrificing visual fidelity. Several key challenges arise when generating videos over long, potentially infinite horizons: (1) bridging the domain gap from training on finite length and extrapolating to long horizons, (2) sustaining high quality by preventing error accumulation, and (3) maintaining fast inference, without increasing computational cost as the context grows. To address these challenges, we carefully designed sliding-window causal attention with attention sinks. By incorporating self-rollout with attention sinks and KV cache rolling during training, we simulate inference-time extrapolations with a fixed context window, enabling constant-speed generation of arbitrarily long videos. Finally, we establish a dedicated benchmark, LongErase, for streaming long-video object removal. Our model achieves strong performance compared to existing video object erasing models and generalizes well to real-world video scenarios, uniquely enabling infinite-length streaming. With StreamErase, users can input a mask and see the erasing results unfold in real-time, delivering a truly interactive experience.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: StreamErase:走向超快流视频删除
articles.content_zh: 目前的视频物品清除方法有令人望而却步的延迟(每段视频分钟)和非因果处理,无法实时互动. 我们介绍StreamErase, 允许在单一的GPU上有最多26个FPS流流层的子秒空。 我们的方法首先用面具输入来扩充一个文本到视频模型,生成高质量的视频,可以抹去目标对象,合成一致的背景,但不会对苍蝇进行推论. 因此,我们逐渐将消除能力从强大的双向基础模型转移到高效的单向流消除器,从而能够在不牺牲视觉忠诚的情况下实现长视距消除。 在制作视频时会出现若干关键挑战,时间跨度长,可能无限:(1) 缩小域间差距,从关于有限长度的培训,推导到长视野;(2) 通过防止错误积累来保持高质量;(3) 保持快速推论,而不会随着环境的增长而增加计算成本。 为了应对这些挑战,我们精心设计了滑窗因果注意和注意吸收。 通过在训练期间将自滚与注意力吸收和KV缓存滚动,我们用固定的上下文窗口模拟推论时间推算,使任意长视频能够恒速生成. 最后,我们建立了一个专门的基准LongErase,用于流动的长视频对象清除. 我们的模型与现有的视频对象消除模型相比,实现了强效的性能,并且对现实世界的视频场景进行了很好的概括,独一无二地实现了无限长的流线化. 使用StreamErase,用户可以输入一个面具,看到擦除结果实时展开,提供真正互动的经验.

articles.title: DreamHMR: From Video Generation to Human Motion Modeling via Structural Focusing
articles.content: Human mesh recovery (HMR) provides a geometric foundation for understanding human motion, but accurately reconstructing both body motion and fine hand articulation from videos remains challenging, especially in real-world scenes where occlusion and partial visibility are common. Video generation pretraining offers rich spatial and temporal priors for this task, but its focus on visual synthesis leaves a gap between these representations and explicit human geometry. We present DreamHMR, a general framework that adapts video generation priors for complete body-and-hand reconstruction. It follows a global-to-local strategy, first grounding video representations in human geometry and then refining body and hand detail with reliable local evidence. Global Body Representation Transfer trains the video backbone to predict complete human renderings, turning its native prediction task into a means of learning surface correspondence and posed geometry. Local Joint Feature Enhancement combines contextual estimates with reliable local evidence to recover fine body and hand detail, while limiting interference from occluders and background. Experiments on five datasets with four video backbones demonstrate strong reconstruction performance across backbone families. Under a unified evaluation protocol, our best model outperforms the best existing methods on all reported metrics of 3DPW, EMDB-1, and RICH, reducing body MPJPE by 4.2%, 4.7%, and 6.1%, respectively. In more challenging occlusion settings on held-out BEDLAM and EgoBody sequences, DreamHMR reduces overall body and hand MPJPE by 7.0% and 10.0%, respectively. Our code will be made publicly available.

articles.title_zh: DreamHMR:通过结构聚焦从视频生成到人类运动模型
articles.content_zh: 人类网状恢复(HMR)为理解人类运动提供了几何基础,但准确重建身体运动和从视频中精细的手语表达仍然具有挑战性,特别是在隔离和部分可见度常见的现实世界场景中. 视频生成预训为这项任务提供了丰富的空间和时间前科,但其对视觉合成的侧重留下了这些表现和明显的人类几何之间的空白. 我们介绍DreamHMR, 一个总体框架 适应视频生成前科 完整的身体和手重建。 它遵循全球到地方的战略,首先将视频表现定位在人类几何中,然后用可靠的当地证据精炼身体和手细节. Global Body Representation Transfer培训视频骨干,以预测完整的人类渲染,将其本土的预测任务转变为学习表面对应的手段,并呈现几何特征. 局部联合特性增强结合了背景估计和可靠的本地证据,以恢复精细的身体和手细,同时限制来自占卜者和背景的干扰. 5个数据集的实验用4个视频骨干显示,各骨干家庭的重建表现强劲. 根据统一的评估协议,我们的最佳模型在所有报告的3DPW、EMDB-1和RICH的度量标准上都超过了最佳的现有方法,将机体MPJPE分别减少4.2%、4.7%和6.1%。 在被搁置的BEDLAM和EgoBody序列上更具挑战性的隔离设置中,DreamHMR将整体躯体和手MPJPE分别减少7.0%和10.0%. 我们的密码会公开

articles.title: RepForcing: Representation-Space Initialization for Autoregressive Video Distillation
articles.content: Distilling pretrained video diffusion models into few-step autoregressive (AR) generators typically combines student initialization with distribution matching distillation (DMD). An intermediate AR teacher can provide causally compatible targets for ODE initialization. However, causally compatible targets alone do not ensure high-quality generation under a short sampling schedule. We analyze the posterior-mean predictions favored by direct latent regression and empirically find that causal ODE initialization alleviates blur but still leaves fine detail unresolved. To address this limitation, we propose Representation Forcing, which learns few-step causal initialization through representation-space supervision rather than intermediate-teacher trajectory regression. The student is trained with teacher forcing by comparing clean predictions and training targets through normalized features of a frozen video diffusion transformer. This phase reuses the synthetic videos generated by a bidirectional model for AR teacher training and replaces both teacher training and causal ODE distillation, without generating additional causal ODE trajectories. The subsequent asymmetric DMD procedure remains unchanged. Empirical results show that, at four sampling steps, RepForcing better preserves generation quality than intermediate-teacher-based initialization before DMD. After DMD, our four-step chunk-wise model improves VBench Total from 84.04 to 84.66 (+0.62 points) and VisionReward from 6.326 to 10.074 (+59.25%) over the reported causal-ODE-based baseline.

articles.title_zh: 取代:自动退缩视频的表示空间初始化
articles.content_zh: 将预先训练的视频传播模型分解为几步自动递归(AR)生成器一般结合学生初始化和配送匹配蒸馏(DMD). 一个中间AR老师可以为ODE初始化提供因果兼容的目标. 然而,仅靠因果相容的目标并不能确保在简短的取样时间表下产生高质量的产品。 我们分析直接潜在回归所偏爱的后期预测,从经验上发现,ODE初始化的因果关系减轻了模糊,但仍留下细微细节未解决. 为了解决这一限制,我们提议通过代表空间监督而不是中级教师轨迹回归来学习很少步骤的因果关系初始化。 学生通过冷冻视频传播变压器的正常功能,通过对比干净的预测和培训目标,接受教师强迫培训. 这一阶段重新使用由双向模型生成的用于AR教师培训的合成视频,并取代师资培训和因果ODE蒸馏,而不产生额外的因果ODE轨迹. 随后的不对称DMD程序保持不变. 经验结果显示,在四个采样步骤中,与DMD之前的基于中级教师的初始化相比,RepForcing更好地维护了生成质量. 在DMD之后,我们的四步块式模型将V Bench Total从84.04改进至84.66(+0.62分)和Visual Reward从6.326改进至10.074(+59.25%),高于报告的基于因果编码的基线。

articles.title: RTAformer: Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer for Video Scene Graph Generation
articles.content: Video scene graph generation (VidSGG) aims to capture objects and their evolving relationships in videos. This requires accounting for both the persistence of object identities and abrupt changes in relationships. Existing methods aggregate information across frames to exploit temporal context, but an emphasis on consistency can obscure these changes. As a result, a model may retain its previous prediction even after the underlying relation has changed. We refer to this failure mode as relational semantic inertia. To address this issue, we propose Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer (RTAformer), a one-stage framework that separately models entity persistence and relation changes. It injects calibrated differences between adjacent-frame relation queries to guide predicate updates, while cross-frame instance alignment during training helps reduce cross-frame representational drift. Experiments on Action Genome show improvements in recall and mean recall over existing methods, with ablation studies supporting the contributions of the proposed components and comparisons using matched backbones showing larger gains on relation-transition frames than on non-transition frames.

articles.title_zh: RTAFOR:视频场景图形生成的关联-转换-软件变换器
articles.content_zh: 视频场景图生成(VidSGG)旨在捕捉视频中的物体及其演变中的关系. 这需要既考虑到物体特性的持久性,又考虑到关系突变。 现有方法汇总跨框架的信息,以利用时间背景,但强调一致性可以掩盖这些变化。 因此,即使在基本关系发生变化之后,一个模型也可能保留其先前的预测. 我们把这种失败模式称为关系语义惯性. 为解决这一问题,我们提议采用 " 关系转换器 " (RTAformer),这是一个将实体持续模式和关系变化分开的阶段框架。 它在相邻方格关系查询之间注入校准差异,以指导上游更新,而跨方格实例在培训期间的调整有助于减少跨方格代表漂移。 行动基因组实验显示,比起现有方法,在召回和平均召回方面有所改进,利用匹配的骨干来支持拟议组成部分的贡献和比较,显示在关系过渡框架方面比在非过渡框架方面收益更大。

articles.title: When Pairwise Preferences Cycle: A Reliability-Anchored Preference Walk for Video GRPO
articles.content: Pairwise preference feedback has become a widely adopted supervision signal for reinforcement learning in video generation models, as pairwise comparisons provide a more reliable alternative than pointwise scalar ratings for evaluating the quality of generated videos. Specifically, we define a preference graph for each GRPO group under a pairwise evaluator, where nodes represent sampled rollouts and edges encode pairwise preferences. Auditing 6,976 on-policy comparison graphs, we find that cyclic preferences are prevalent and persist throughout training. Naive pairwise reward aggregation based on average win rates discards the underlying comparison structures and treats each rollout independently, which may introduce unreliable advantage estimates for certain rollouts and consequently affect reinforcement learning optimization. Therefore, we propose the \emph{Reliability-Anchored Preference Walk} (\ours{}), a graph-aware advantage aggregation method that strengthens the global preference signal from win rates with reliable relational evidence from cyclic preference graphs through a reliability-guided preference walk. Under matched evaluator, comparison protocol, group size, prompt schedule, and query budget, \ours{} requires no additional evaluator queries beyond the observed comparisons within each rollout group and improves over Pairwise-GRPO across controlled comparisons, transfer settings, and blind human evaluations.

articles.title_zh: 当对等首选项循环:视频 GRPO 的可靠性和首选项行走时
articles.content_zh: 对等偏好反馈已成为视频生成模型中广泛采用的强化学习的监督信号,因为对等比较为评价生成的视频的质量提供了比对点的scalar评级更可靠的替代品. 具体地说,我们在一个双向评价器下为每个GRPO组定义一个偏好图,其中节点代表了样本的展开和边缘对双向偏好. 对6 976份政策比较图表进行审计后,我们发现,周期性偏好普遍存在,而且贯穿整个培训过程。 以平均赢率为基础的对等奖励汇总将放弃基本比较结构,独立处理每次推出,这可能为某些推出带来不可靠的优势估计,从而影响强化学习的优化。 因此,我们提议\emph{Reference-Anchored Preference Walk}(\ours{}}),这是一种图觉优势汇总方法,通过可靠性引导的偏好行走,用循环偏好图的可靠关系证据,从赢率强化全球偏好信号. 在匹配的评价员、比较协议、分组大小、及时时间表和查询预算下,\我们不需要在每个推出组内观察到的比较之外增加评价员的查询,并改进Pairwise-GPRO在可控比较、转移设置和盲目人类评价方面的改进。

articles.title: VisualWorldBench: A Fine-Grained Multi-Task Benchmark for Evaluating Visual World Knowledge in MLLMs
articles.content: Visual world knowledge is a core capability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), underpinning knowledge-intensive visual question answering and fine-grained visual reasoning. However, existing benchmarks remain limited in two key respects. First, their category coverage is narrow: most benchmarks span only a small number of categories across a few domains, falling far short of the open-ended scale of real-world visual entities. Second, their task construction is often insufficiently rigorous: models can answer correctly using coarse-grained cues, vague associations, or elimination strategies without truly mastering precise concepts, making it difficult to accurately assess their knowledge of fine-grained entities. We introduce VisualWorldBench, a taxonomy-grounded multi-task benchmark built on a hierarchical taxonomy of 21,291 leaf-node classes across 8 visual domains, with 32,541 evaluation instances whose ground-truth labels cover 15,479 categories across four complementary tasks: closed-set recognition, contrastive selection, precise localization, and open-world naming, covering different directions of knowledge retrieval and varying degrees of answer openness to comprehensively evaluate visual world knowledge. Most questions are constructed from taxonomically proximate categories, forcing precise discrimination among fine-grained entities. Experiments reveal that the strongest closed-source model achieves only 80.4% average accuracy, exposing capability gaps hidden under conventional benchmarks. We further construct VisualWorldBench-50K, a training resource covering 50K+ categories. Fine-tuning on VisualWorldBench-50K yields over 21 percentage points improvement on VisualWorldBench, with consistent transfer to public fine-grained recognition and visual knowledge benchmarks.

articles.title_zh: 视觉世界 教席:在MLLMs中评价视觉世界知识的精细多任务基准
articles.content_zh: 视觉世界知识是多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)的核心能力,支持知识密集型视觉问题回答和精细的视觉推理. 然而,现有基准在两个主要方面仍然有限。 首先,它们的类别覆盖范围很窄:大多数基准只跨越少数领域的少数类别,远远低于现实世界视觉实体的开放式规模。 其次,他们的任务构建往往不够严格:模型可以使用粗糙的提示,模糊的关联,或者消除策略而不真正掌握精确的概念,从而难以准确评估他们对精细的纹理实体的知识. 我们介绍了VisualWorld Bench,这是一个基于分类学的多任务基准,该基准基于8个视觉领域的21,291个叶子-节点类的分级分类,共有32,541个评价实例,其地面-真伪标签涵盖15,479个类别,涉及四个互补任务:闭合识别、对比性选择、精确本地化和开放世界命名,涵盖知识检索的不同方向和不同程度的答案开放,以全面评价视觉世界知识。 多数问题都是从分类学的近似类别中得出的,迫使精细实体之间有确切的歧视。 实验显示,最强的闭源模型只达到80.4%的平均精度,暴露出传统基准下隐藏的能力差距. 我们进一步建造了VisualWorld Bench-50K,这是一个涵盖50K+类的培训资源. 对VisualWorld Bench-50K的精细调整,在VisualWorld Bench上提高了21个百分点以上,始终如一地向公众精细的识别和视觉知识基准转移.

articles.title: Feasibility of a Patient-Specific Digital Twin for Ventriculoperitoneal Shunt Trajectory Planning
articles.content: Catheter obstruction is the commonest cause of shunt failure; freehand insertion at Keen's point leaves the tip free in cerebrospinal fluid in only one case in ten. We built a digital twin that reconstructs skull, scalp, ear and ventricles from preoperative CT by deterministic geometry, searches every entry around Keen's point for the perpendicular trajectory with the longest intraventricular length under safety constraints, and returns the plan as two ruler measurements from the ear and two depths. Executed freehand in 11 consecutive adults (IDEAL Stage 2a), it achieved Hayhurst Grade 1 placement in 10 of 11 against 22 of 213 historically (p = 9 x 10^-9), median entry and angular deviations 2.5 mm and 5.9 degrees, 1.4 cm more intraventricular catheter than Keen's point, and no intraoperative complication. The technique was unchanged; the gain came from choosing entry and depth per patient. Whether it lowers revision is the next stage's hypothesis.

articles.title_zh: 患者特定数字双胞胎在肠道膜上的可行性 Shunt 轨迹规划
articles.content_zh: Catheter阻断是漏出故障的最常见原因;在Keen的点处自由手插入会使尖端在脑脊液中释放出来,只有十分之一的情况. 我们建造了一个数字双胞胎,通过确定几何来从手术前的CT中重建头骨,头皮,耳朵和通风口,搜索基恩所在位置周围的每一个入口,寻找在安全限制下呼吸道长度最长的垂直轨迹,并将计划作为两条标尺从耳朵和两条深处返回. 连续11个成年人(IDEAL Stage 2a)执行自由手术,在11年级的10年级和213年级的22年级中实现了Hayhurst一年级的安置(p=9 x 10^-9),中间进入和角偏差为2.5毫米和5.9度,呼吸道内导管比基恩的点多1.4厘米,没有手术内并发症。 这一技术没有改变;收益来自选择每个病人的进入和深度。 是否降低修订是下一阶段的假设.

articles.title: GDBA-Net: A Gated Dual-Branch Adaptation of SAM2 for Robust Cross-Domain Nuclei Segmentation
articles.content: Accurate nuclei segmentation underpins quantitative computational pathology, yet remains challenging due to morphological variability, weak boundaries, nuclear crowding, and pronounced domain shifts arising from differences in tissue preparation, staining, and acquisition. While deep learning and recent foundation models have improved segmentation performance under matched distributions with the original training data, their generalization across heterogeneous histopathology domains remains limited. We introduce GDBA-Net, a parameter-efficient nuclei segmentation framework built around the proposed Gated Dual-Branch Adapter (GDBA). GDBA-Net adapts a frozen SAM2 encoder by integrating pretrained semantic representations with explicit frequency-derived structural priors. The complementary representations are independently transformed through Grid MLP branches and dynamically integrated using sample-adaptive channel-wise gating, selectively emphasizing structural cues relevant to nuclear delineation. Despite using only 4.3 million trainable parameters, GDBA-Net achieves state-of-the-art in-dataset performance and consistently superior cross-dataset generalization across six diverse nuclei segmentation benchmarks under fully supervised, cross-dataset, and five-shot adaptation protocols, outperforming competing CNN-, transformer-, and foundation model based methods. Comprehensive ablations confirm that these gains arise from the coordinated design of semantic-frequency complementarity and adaptive gating rather than increased model capacity. By uniting transferable semantic representations with explicit structural priors, GDBA-Net provides a robust, annotation-efficient solution to domain variability in nuclei segmentation. https://github.com/biplabpoudel25/GDBA_Net

articles.title_zh: GDBA-Net:用于强力跨域核分裂的SAM2的Gated双板改造
articles.content_zh: 准确的核分裂是定量计算病理的基础,但由于形态变异、边界薄弱、核拥挤,以及组织准备、污渍和获取方面的差异导致的显著域转移,因此仍然具有挑战性。 虽然在与原始培训数据相匹配的分布下,深入学习和最近的基础模型提高了分化性能,但它们在不同的组织病理学领域的概括性仍然有限。 我们介绍了GDBA-Net,这是一个围绕拟议的Gated Dual-Branch适配器(GDBA)构建的参数高效的核分裂框架. GDBA-Net通过将预先训练的语义表达式与明确的频率衍生结构前缀整合,来调整一个冷冻的SAM2编码器. 互补的表示通过Grid MLP分支进行独立转化,并采用采样适应性通道导引法进行动态整合,有选择地强调与核划界相关的结构提示. GDBA-Net尽管只使用了430万个可训练参数,但还是实现了最先进的内数据集性能,并在完全监督的跨数据集和5发的适应协议下,在6个不同的核子分解基准上始终实现了优异的跨数据集通用化,其性能超过了竞争的CNN-、变压器和基于基础模型的方法。 全面分析证实,这些成果来自语义频率互补和适应性定位的协调设计,而不是增强模型能力。 GDBA-Net通过将可转移的语义表述与明确的结构前缀统一起来,为核分裂中的域变异性提供了有力,注解高效的解决方案. https://github.com/biplabpoudel25/GDBA_Net (中文(简体) ).

articles.title: GeoCloak: An Agentic Framework for Semantics-Preserving Geolocation Privacy via Peripheral Clue Manipulation
articles.content: The rapid advancement of large vision language models (LVLMs) has made geolocation inference from images highly accurate and accessible. This poses serious privacy risks: a passive adversary with black-box LVLM access can infer a user's location from a single photo with no metadata. Existing protection methods rely almost exclusively on adversarial perturbation, which introduces perceptible visual artifacts and utility degradation. We identify the visual-geolocation asymmetry: geolocation-decisive clues, such as street signs, tend to be visually peripheral but dominate location inference. Exploiting this asymmetry, we propose GeoCloak, an agentic framework for semantics-preserving geolocation privacy protection. It acts as a clue-aware planner that analyzes each image to identify geolocation-relevant clues, dispatches targeted semantic edits to directly suppress peripheral clues, and autonomously configures adversarial perturbation to further suppress residual geolocation features, all under iterative utility-aware feedback. We evaluate GeoCloak on four diverse datasets spanning 108 countries and 576 cities against five LVLMs and three inference methods. GeoCloak reduces overall city-level accuracy from 41.2% to 9.9%, approximately half of the best-performing baseline, while achieving substantially superior utility preservation both qualitatively and quantitatively. We hope this work takes a meaningful step toward practical, semantics-preserving geolocation privacy protection, giving users greater control over the location information inadvertently embedded in their shared images.

articles.title_zh: GeoCloak: 语义学- 保存地理定位隐私的代理框架
articles.content_zh: 大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)的迅速进步,使得从图像中得出的地理定位推论非常准确,并且可以获取. 这造成了严重的隐私风险:拥有黑盒LVLM访问的被动对手可以从一个没有元数据的照片推断出用户的位置. 现有的保护方法几乎完全依靠对抗性的扰动,这种扰动引入了可感知的视觉文物和效用的退化. 我们识别视觉-地理定位不对称:地理定位-决定性线索,如街道标志,往往为视觉外围但主导位置推断. 利用这种不对称性,我们提出GeoCloak,作为语义学-保存地理定位隐私保护的代理框架. 它发挥线索意识规划者的作用,分析每个图像以识别地理定位相关线索,发送定向语义编辑以直接压制外围线索,自主配置对抗性扰动以进一步压制残余地理定位特征,全部在迭代实用意识反馈下. 我们对照5个LVLM和3个推论方法,对覆盖108个国家和576个城市的4个不同的数据集进行GeoCloak评价。 GeoCloak将城市一级的总体精度从41.2%降至9.9%,约占最佳基线的一半,同时在质量和数量上都实现了相当好的公用事业保护。 我们希望这项工作朝着实用的,语义保存地理定位的隐私保护迈出有意义的一步,让用户对无意中嵌入在他们共享的图像中的位置信息有更大的控制.

articles.title: Why 3D Reconstruction Breaks Down on Under-Ice AUV Video, and How to Predict It
articles.content: Reconstruction of 3D structures using under-ice AUV video footage has been inaccurate, although it is not certain whether this is due to shortcomings in the methods or an inherent deficiency of the capture system. We test four different models for reconstruction on the same Antarctic under-ice AUV video (Icefin, Kamb Ice Stream): classical feature matching SfM, differentiable photometric splatting, volumetric depth fusion, and a pose-free feed-forward foundation model. All four fail, each in a distinct way: near-total registration yielding almost no structure, geometrically broken output despite healthy photometric metrics, a persistent coverage artifact, and unstable cross-chunk scale. We show that all four are consistent with the same capture regime, a small camera-baseline-to-scene-depth ratio. Following our analysis, we propose a detection system that flags this type of failure in minutes, rather than hours of wasted compute.

articles.title_zh: 为何3D重建在低冰AUV视频上中断,
articles.content_zh: 使用摄像头不足的AUV录像重建3D结构是不准确的,尽管不确定这是否是由于方法上的缺陷或捕捉系统的固有缺陷. 我们在同一个南极冰下AUV视频(Icefin, Kamb Ice Stream)上测试四个不同的重建模型: 经典特征匹配SfM, 不同光度电镀, 量子深度聚变, 以及一个无假质的Feed-forward基础模型. 所有四个都以不同的方式失败:几乎完全登记几乎没有产生任何结构,尽管有健康的光度测量指标,但输出几何断裂,持续覆盖的文物,以及不稳定的跨圆形尺度。 我们显示这四个都符合相同的捕捉制度,一个小型的相机-基线-对-场景-深度比. 经过我们的分析,我们提出一种检测系统,在几分钟内标出这种故障,而不是浪费的计算时数。

articles.title: Instruction Mining From Images: Constructing a Synthetic Dataset for Multimodal Learning ILSP DCVLR Competition Submission
articles.content: This work presents a compact and reproducible pipeline for synthesizing and curating image-based instruction-response pairs for DCVLR. We draw from the Cauldron collection and use Magpie-style instruction and response synthesis with Qwen2.5-VL-7B Instruct to create concise, image-conditioned instruction pairs. The pipeline consists of instruction synthesis, conditioned on input images and controlled via a system prompt, sanitization, tagging, and filtering of the instructions based on the score obtained by a reward model (DeBERTa-v3). We retain samples with positive scores to maximize the quality of the generated instructions. We observe that score distributions have a median and mean reward score of ~ 1.53 and ~ 1.75 respectively, indicating that most generated instructions are of good quality. The resulting dataset contains diverse instructions in the math, spatial, and social reasoning domains.

articles.title_zh: 指令从图像中挖掘:为多式联运学习构建一个综合数据集 ILSP DCVLR 竞争申请
articles.content_zh: 这项工作为DCVLR合成和处理基于图像的指令-响应对提供了紧凑和可复制的管道。 我们从Cauldron集合中抽取,使用Magpie风格的指令和反应合成,使用Quen2.5-VL-7B 指令来创建简洁,图像化的指令对. 管道由指令合成组成,以输入图像为条件,并通过系统即时,消毒,标记,以及根据奖励模型(DeBERTa-v3)获得的分数过滤指令进行控制. 我们保留有正分数的样本,以最大限度地提高生成指令的质量。 我们注意到,分数分配的中位数和中位数奖励分数分别为~1.53和~1.75,表明大多数生成的指令质量良好. 由此产生的数据集包含数学、空间和社会推理领域的各种指示。

articles.title: SAM3RL: Memory Control via Reinforcement Learning for Visual Object Tracking
articles.content: Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) is a foundation model for image and video segmentation that sets the state of the art in visual object tracking. Its tracker, inherited from SAM 2, stores information from past frames in a memory bank, managed by a simple First-In-First-Out rule, allowing temporal consistency in complex videos. Several recent methods improve SAM 2 with hand-crafted memory update rules, each targeting a specific failure mode, such as distractors, occlusions, or object motion. However, their gains transfer only partially to the stronger SAM 3 backbone. We instead present a more general, data-driven approach that frames memory control as a sequential decision-making task. SAM3RL is an extension of the SAM 3 tracker with a lightweight memory controller, trained by reinforcement learning, that decides which frames enter the memory bank in order to maximize tracking performance. SAM3RL sets a new state of the art on 10 of 12 tracking and video object segmentation benchmarks, outperforming all hand-crafted rules without any runtime overhead. The same approach applied to SAM 2 gives SAM2RL, which outperforms hand-crafted rules on 9 of the 12 benchmarks, showing the generality of our method across model generations.

articles.title_zh: SAM3RL:通过增强学习实现视觉物体跟踪的内存控制
articles.content_zh: 片段 Anything Model 3 (SAM 3)是图像和视频分割的基础模型,设定视觉物体跟踪中的艺术状态. 它从SAM 2中继承的跟踪器将过去帧中的信息存储在存储库中,由简单的First-In-First-Out规则管理,允许复杂视频的时间一致性. 最近几种方法用手制的内存更新规则改进了SAM 2,每种方法都瞄准特定的故障模式,如分心器,隔离器,或物体运动. 然而,他们的收益只部分转移到更强大的SAM 3主干. 相反,我们提出一种更普遍、数据驱动的办法,将记忆控制作为一项连续决策任务。 SAM3RL是SAM 3跟踪器的扩展,具有轻量级内存控制器,通过强化学习来训练,决定哪个帧进入内存库,以最大限度地实现跟踪性能. SAM3RL在12个跟踪和视频物体分块基准中的10个设定了新的最新技术,在没有任何运行时间高空的情况下,超过了所有手工操作的规则. 适用于SAM 2的同样方法赋予了SAM2RL,它的表现超过了12个基准中的9个的手工制作规则,显示了我们的方法跨模范代的通用性.

articles.title: Quantifying Annotation Agreement in Object Detection with Optimal Transport
articles.content: Reliable validation of machine learning models is a crucial step in designing robust and trustworthy systems. Yet validation relies on annotated test sets treated as ground truth, even though annotations can be noisy or ambiguous. In object detection, sources may disagree on object presence, box location, or class label. Standard agreement metrics usually binarize box overlap before computing a summary score, obscuring the degree and structure of disagreement between annotation sets. Here, we study an Optimal Transport (OT)-based metric for measuring agreement between object detection annotations. Instead of binarizing bounding box overlap, this metric assigns graded costs to matched and unmatched labeled boxes. Through theoretical analysis and experiments on real and synthetically perturbed annotations, we show that OT captures graded changes in agreement and distinguishes annotation pairs that thresholded metrics score identically. Our results suggest that OT provides a richer measure of annotation agreement in object detection, especially for domains with many small or ambiguous objects. Such agreement estimates can support more reliable validation when labels are noisy or conflicting.

articles.title_zh: 以最佳运输方式进行物体探测的定量注释协议
articles.content_zh: 对机器学习模型进行可靠验证是设计可靠和可信赖的系统的关键步骤。 然而,验证依赖于被视作地面真理的附加说明的测试集,尽管说明可能很吵或者模棱两可。 在物体检测中,来源可能对物体的存在,盒子位置,或类标签有分歧. 标准协议衡量标准通常在计算一个汇总分数之前将框重叠二进制,模糊了注释集之间分歧的程度和结构. 在这里,我们研究一个基于最佳运输(OT)的测量指标,用于测量物体探测说明之间的一致。 这个度量法不是将边框重叠二进制,而是将分级成本指定为匹配和未匹配的标签框. 通过对真实和合成扰动说明的理论分析和实验,我们显示OT捕捉到协议中的分级变化,并区分了阈值测量分数相同的注释对. 我们的结果显示,OT在物体探测方面提供了更丰富的注解协议度量,特别是对许多小或模糊物体的域而言。 当标签吵闹或相互冲突时,这种协议估计可以支持更可靠的验证.

articles.title: CARD: Closing the Teacher-Student Loop for Adversarial Robustness Distillation
articles.content: Adversarial robustness distillation typically treats a robust teacher as a fixed knowledge source and transfers robustness to a compact student in a one-way manner. This paradigm terminates teacher-student interaction once the student is distilled, thereby discarding potentially useful feedback from the distilled student. However, exploiting such feedback is nontrivial because indiscriminate weak-to-strong transfer may propagate student errors to the teacher. To address this issue, we propose Cyclic Adversarial Robustness Distillation (CARD), a closed-loop framework that turns the distilled student into a feedback source for refining the robust teacher and subsequently transfers the teacher gains back to the same student. CARD first performs strong-to-weak adversarial distillation and then uses reliability-enhanced student feedback to refine the robust teacher. The refinement combines inverse adversarial student feedback with teacher-student discrepancy maximization, after which the refined teacher is used to continue training the same student under the unchanged base distillation objective. We further establish a sample-level sufficient condition for reliable weak-to-strong feedback transfer and derive a distribution-level upper bound on the refined teacher's risk. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and TinyImageNet-10 across multiple teacher-student architectures and base distillation methods show that CARD improves adversarial robustness in most evaluated settings while generally preserving clean accuracy. These results show that the distilled student can provide useful feedback to the teacher, enabling robustness transfer to proceed beyond the conventional one-way teacher-to-student paradigm.

articles.title_zh: CARD: 关闭教师和学生间循环, 以适应强壮的消化
articles.content_zh: 逆向稳健性蒸馏一般将稳健的教师视为固定的知识来源,并以单向方式将稳健性转移给紧凑的学生. 这种范式在学生被蒸馏后终止了师生之间的相互作用,从而抛弃了蒸馏后学生潜在的有益反馈. 然而,利用这种反馈是非部落性的,因为不分青红皂白的弱到强的转移可能会向教师传播学生的错误。 为了解决这个问题,我们提出Cyclic Adversarial Raverstness Dispiration(CARD),这是一种封闭式框架,将蒸馏后的学生转化为完善强健的教师的反馈来源,随后将教师的收益转回给同一个学生. CARD首先进行强对弱对抗式蒸馏,然后利用可靠性增强的学生反馈来完善强师. 完善后结合了反向对抗的学生反馈和师生差异最大化,之后在不变的基础蒸馏目标下,利用完善后的教师继续培养同一个学生. 我们进一步为可靠的弱到强反馈传输建立一个样本级的充分条件,并从精细教师的风险上得出分布级的上限. 关于CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和TinyImageNet-10的实验跨越了多个师生结构和基底蒸馏方法,表明CARD在大多数评价环境中提高了对抗力,同时总体上保持了干净的准确性。 这些结果显示,被蒸馏的学生可以向老师提供有益的反馈,使得强力转移能够超越传统的单向师生模式.

articles.title: Multimodal Medical Image Parsing with Task-Specific Low-Rank Adapters
articles.content: Adapting a single vision-language model to medical image parsing requires training choices that reflect the demands of each task. We study task-specific adaptation with Qwen3.5-9B for FLARE 2026 Task 3, covering six task families and seven imaging modalities. Our system couples a shared, frozen 4-bit backbone with LoRA adapters selected from the input question. We customize adapter ranks and prompts, rebalance rare classification targets, and supplement regression training with dermatology classification examples. On the fixed internal holdout, the task-specific adapters achieve a dataset-macro balanced accuracy of 0.7791 for classification, a dataset-macro micro-F1 of 0.6286 for multi-label classification, a counting mean absolute error (MAE) of 11.73, a dataset-macro detection F1 of 0.8914, a dataset-macro regression MAE of 9.78, and a report-generation CRIMSON score of 0.8204. On the organizer's 1,703-example hidden-validation set, the submitted system achieves 0.8496 classification balanced accuracy, 0.5338 sample-averaged multi-label F1, and 14.5950 regression MAE. The final 30.1 GB container averages 3.1 seconds per case, including model loading, and produces identical outputs across repeated verification runs. The benefits vary across tasks, supporting the use of task-specific adapter configurations and image budgets within a shared medical vision-language model. Code is available at https://github.com/TahaSabir0/FLARE26-Hexapus.

articles.title_zh: 使用任务特定低亮度适应器进行多模式医学图像解析
articles.content_zh: 使单一的视觉语言模型适应医疗图像剖析需要能够反映每项任务要求的培训选择。 我们用Qwen3.5-9B为FLARE 2026任务3研究特定任务适应,涵盖6个任务家庭和7个成像模式. 我们的系统与LORA适配器 共享,冷冻的4位骨干结合 从输入问题。 我们定制适配器的等级和提示,重新平衡稀有分类目标,并以皮肤学分类实例补充回归训练. 在固定的内部搁置上,任务特定的适配器实现数据集-宏观平衡精度0.7791的分类,数据集-宏观微F1的多标签分类为0.6286,计数平均绝对误差(MAE)为11.73,数据集-宏观检测F1为0.8914,数据集-宏观回归MAE为9.78,报告生成的CRIMSON得分为0.8204. 在组织器的1,703-实例的隐藏-验证集上,提交系统实现了0.8496分类平衡精度,0.5338样本平均多标签F1和14.595回归MAE. 最终的30.1GB集装箱平均每箱3.1秒,包括模型装载,并在多次核查中产生相同的产出。 这些好处因任务而异,支持在共同的医疗视觉语言模式下使用特定任务适配器配置和图像预算. 代码见https://github.com/TahaSabir0/FLARE26-Hexapus。

articles.title: On the Limits of Representation-Based Test-Time Adaptation for Multimodal LLMs
articles.content: Vision-language models suffer significant accuracy drops under common corruptions. While test-time adaptation (TTA) successfully mitigates these shifts in CLIP-like contrastive models, its application to generative multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remains underexplored and uniquely challenging due to their sequential token generation. In this work, we demonstrate that representation-based TTA fails to recover performance in MLLMs. Our experiments reveal that even when violating standard TTA assumptions by leveraging target data offline, sample-blind feature alignment recovers only marginal accuracy. We attribute this failure to the nature of corruption shifts: unlike CLIP-like architectures, which benefit from a shared domain-shift direction within a single pooled classification embedding, MLLM visual token sequence shifts are nearly orthogonal and span the full embedding space.These findings bound what any sample-blind, position-shared correction at a single encoder site can achieve, establishing that representation-space interventions alone might be insufficient to ensure corruption robustness in MLLMs.

articles.title_zh: 多式联运有限责任公司基于代表性的测试-时间适应的限度
articles.content_zh: 在常见的腐败下,愿景语言模型的准确度大幅下降。 虽然测试时间适应(TTA)在类似CLIP的对比模型中成功地缓解了这些转变,但是它对于基因多式大语言模型(MLLMs)的应用由于它们相继生成符号,仍然没有得到充分利用和独特的挑战. 在这项工作中,我们表明,基于代表性的TTA未能在MLLM中恢复性能. 我们的实验显示,即使通过利用离线目标数据来违反标准的TTA假设,样本盲特性对齐也只能恢复边际精度. 我们将此失败归因于腐败转变的性质:与类似CLIP的架构不同,这种架构受益于单一集合分类嵌入内的一个共享域-转移方向,MLLM视觉符号序列转移几乎是正向的,跨越了完整的嵌入空间. 这些结论将单一编码器站点的任何抽样盲点、位置共享校正所能达到的目标联系在一起,确定仅仅代表-空间干预可能不足以确保MLLMs的腐败力度。

articles.title: Latent Compaction with Test-Time Training
articles.content: Long contexts enlarge key--value (KV) caches, increasing memory use and attention costs during generation. Compressing these caches must preserve information for unseen questions. We introduce **Latent Compaction**, which learns a compact document-specific cache through test-time training. We initialize cache entries using reconstruction importance, teacher attention, and key-space diversity. Training first fits attention outputs and log-normalizers to those of the full cache, with reconstruction-selected entries held fixed. It then jointly optimizes the entire cache through end-to-end distillation from the full-cache model. Model weights remain frozen throughout, and training uses only generic prompts about the document, without access to downstream questions or answers. Experiments on RULER, LongBench, and Phonebook Lookup demonstrate substantial gains over budget-matched compression baselines. On a RULER, for example, our method achieves 96.7% accuracy at 32$\times$ compression, compared with 40.0% for KVZip+. The method also transfers across model scales and families, with retrieval gains on both Qwen3 and MiniCPM5. These results show that treating the KV cache as a neural network and optimizing it with test-time training can preserve retrieval accuracy under aggressive compression. The code is released at https://www.github.com/THUNLP/latent-compaction

articles.title_zh: 与试验-时间培训接合
articles.content_zh: 长时间上下文扩大了密钥值(KV)缓存,在生成过程中增加了内存的使用和注意力成本. 压缩这些缓存必须保存信息以进行隐蔽的问题. 我们采用**Latent Concession**,它通过测试时间培训学习一个紧凑的文件特定缓存。 我们利用重建的重要性、老师的注意和密钥空间的多样性来初始化缓存条目。 培训首先使注意力输出和对数常态化与全部缓存输出匹配,并固定了重建选定的条目。 然后通过从全卡切模型的端到端蒸馏来联合优化整个缓存. 模型重量在整个过程中一直处于冻结状态,培训只使用关于文件的通用提示,无法进入下游问答. 对RULAR、Long Bench和Phonebook Lookup的实验表明,在预算匹配的压缩基线方面有相当大的进展。 例如,在RULAR上,我们的方法在32美元/时压缩时达到96.7%的精度,而KVZip+的精度为40.0%。 该方法还跨模型尺度和家庭转移,在Qune3和MiniCPM5上都有检索收益。 这些结果表明,将KV缓存作为神经网络处理,并通过测试时间训练优化它,可以在积极的压缩下保持检索精度. 该代码在https://www.github.com/THUNLP/latent-compaction上发布.

articles.title: One Task, Many Interfaces: Simple Cross-Interface Consistency Training Improves LLM Agent Robustness
articles.content: Post-training binds the competence of an LLM agent to the interface it was trained on. Semantics-preserving perturbations of that interface, such as renaming an action or changing the notation, leave the underlying task unchanged yet make the agent worse at it. Scoring each sample independently means interface randomization only broadens this dependence from a single interface to the training interface distribution, so out-of-distribution perturbations still degrade the agent. We propose Cross-Interface Policy Regularization (CIPR), a self-supervised objective that replaces action names with uninformative identifiers and presents each training sample under two interfaces in which equivalent actions are identified by construction. CIPR penalizes the KL divergence between the action distributions induced under the two interfaces, so the policy behaves consistently across them. We evaluate CIPR in both supervised and reinforcement-learning post-training, where it improves robustness. On agentic function calling, held-out interface perturbations reduce the accuracy of a post-trained agent by nearly 25%, and CIPR recovers 10.5% while leaving accuracy on the unchanged interface intact.

articles.title_zh: 一个任务, 很多 接口 : 简单的交叉一致性培训 强力特工
articles.content_zh: 培训后将LLM代理的能力与其培训的接口挂钩。 语义学-保留对接口的扰动,如重命名动作或改变标记,使基本任务不变,但使代理人更糟糕。 独立分解每个样本意味着接口随机化只能将这种依赖性从一个单一的接口扩大到训练接口分布,因此外分配扰动仍然可以降解代理. 我们提出跨部门政策规范化(CIPR),这是一个自我监督的目标,将行动名称替换为非信息标识符,并在两个接口下介绍每个培训样本,其中通过建筑确定相应的行动。 CIPR惩罚了KL在两个接口下引发的行动分布之间的分歧,因此政策在它们之间表现一致. 我们通过监督和强化后培训,对社区康复中心进行评价,以提高其活力。 在代理函数调用上,悬浮式接口扰动将训练后剂的精度降低近25%,CIPR恢复了10.5%,同时将精度保留在未变的接口上不变.

articles.title: Manacá-1B-Instruct-2: Reproducible Safety Alignment for a Native Brazilian-Portuguese LLM. Negative DPO Results, a Controlled Composition Scan, and a Silent Failure Mode of the LLM Judge
articles.content: Brazilian Portuguese remains underserved by open-source language models, and the few that are safety-aligned rarely document what did not work or validate comparisons with statistical significance. We present Manacá-1B-Instruct-2, the second-generation post-training alignment of Manacá-1B (1.72B parameters, trained from scratch for PT-BR), with an SFT corpus of 291,223 examples. We document three DPO attempts, all negative, including a case where the training reward margin reaches 1.0 while free generation does not change at all, and show that safety came from a dedicated safety-SFT (LLM-jp AnswerCarefully style), refined over three iterations until closing the safety-helpfulness frontier. A controlled scan of the fraction of general data in the safety-SFT mix (10% to 60%) reveals a non-monotonic over-refusal curve with a knee point at 40-50%. The final model is compared against four external PT-BR models on the same items, with Wilson confidence intervals and paired McNemar tests with Holm-Bonferroni correction: the lower bound of its safety interval (94.1%) lies above the upper bound of all four baselines. We also report a methodological finding for LLM-judge evaluation: on two of six safety items in MT-Bench-PT, the judge categorically refuses to assign a score regardless of the evaluated response, silently reducing the effective N of that category in every prior report of the project. We complement this with an n-gram decontamination check and a Chinchilla-anchored compute-budget table that attributes the gap in general capability to pre-training scale rather than alignment methodology. All code, raw data, logs, and scripts that produce every reported number are publicly released.

articles.title_zh: Manacá-1B-Instruct-2:巴西-葡萄牙土著LLM可复制安全配对。 负 DPO 成绩、控制下的组成扫描和LLM 法官的沉默失败模式
articles.content_zh: 巴西葡萄牙语仍然得不到开放源码语言模型的服务,少数安全对应语言很少记录哪些不可行或与统计重要性的比较。 我们提出Manacá-1B-Instruct-2,这是Manacá-1B(1.72B参数,从零开始为PT-BR培训)的第二代培训后调整,其中的SFT包有291 223个实例。 我们记录了三次DPO尝试,都是负面的,包括培训奖励幅度达到1.0,而自由一代却丝毫不改变的情况,并表明安全来自一种专用的安全-SFT(LLM-jp AnswerCacultly style),经过精细的三次迭代,直到关闭安全-帮助前沿。 对安全-SFT组合中一般数据(10%至60%)的分量进行控制扫描后,可发现一个膝盖点为40-50%的非运动过度反射曲线。 最终的型号与相同物品上的4个外部PT-BR型号相比,具有威尔逊置信间隔,并与Holm-Bonferroni校正为麦克内马尔测试配对:其安全间隔的下限(94.1%)位于所有4个基线的上限之上. 我们还报告LLM法官评价的方法调查结果:在MT-Bench-PT的6个安全项目中,法官断然拒绝分配一个分数,而不管评估的答复如何,在该项目的每份前一份报告中,都默默减少该类别的有效N。 我们用n克消毒检查和Chinchilla-Anchored计算预算表来补充这一点,这些预算表将一般能力的差距归结为培训前规模,而不是调整方法。 所有代码,原始数据,日志,以及产生每个报告数字的脚本都公开发布.

articles.title: Scaling Discovery Requires Forgetting
articles.content:
Automated research with LLM agents has shown promising results in various domains. Through iterative refinement and scored verifiers, LLM agents are capable of discovering new ideas. There are different ways to scale automated research: let one agent iterate for longer, run several agents in parallel, or further let the parallel agents communicate and build on one another's candidates. However, we find that all three strategies eventually plateau as the agents accumulate history. Each agent becomes anchored to its own past attempts, making fewer and smaller edits. Beyond this point, additional budget brings little further improvement. In this paper, we show that the key to scaling discovery further is to forget. Periodically discarding the search state, including every agent's session and the candidate history, and restarting from the best candidate found so far, unblocks the search and pushes the same budget further.
  We implement forgetting in a team of agents with communication and evaluate it on four tasks spanning heuristic programming, kernel optimization and model training. The results show up to 15% improvement compared to parallel agents, and up to 39% compared to a single agent. Our results suggest that, for open-ended discovery, what an agent is allowed to remember matters as much as how much compute it is given.

articles.title_zh: 缩小发现需要忘记
articles.content_zh:
与LLM代理商的自动化研究显示,在各个领域都取得了有希望的成果。 通过迭代完善和得分验证器,LLM代理能够发现新的想法. 自动化研究的规模有不同的方法:让一个代理长期地进行迁移,平行地运行几个代理,或者让平行代理进一步进行沟通和在对方候选人的基础上发展. 然而,我们发现,随着代理人积累历史,这三项战略最终都趋于成熟。 每一个代理商都因自己的过去尝试而陷入困境,编辑次数越来越少。 此外,追加预算几乎没有带来任何进一步改进。 在本文中,我们表明,进一步推广发现的关键在于忘记。 定期丢弃搜索状态,包括每一次代理会话和候选人历史,从迄今发现的最佳候选人重新开始搜索,解锁搜索,进一步推进同一预算.
我们用一组具有沟通能力的人员来实施遗忘,并对它进行评价,这四个任务涉及弹性编程、内核优化和模式培训。 结果显示,与平行制剂相比,改进率高达15%,与单一制剂相比,改进率高达39%。 我们的结果表明,对于无限制的发现,允许什么物剂可以像计算多少一样记住多少物剂。

articles.title: PerSo: Investigating Facets of LLMs' Social Intelligence in Real-World Persuasion Scenarios
articles.content: Understanding the social intelligence of large language models (LLMs) is increasingly important for applications involving human-AI interaction and multi-agent environments. Social intelligence comprises two aspects: cognitive intelligence, the ability to infer others' mental states, and behavioral intelligence, the ability to select appropriate social actions based on these inferences to achieve social goals. Persuasion provides a natural testbed in which both aspects are simultaneously at play, yet prior benchmarks typically evaluate them in isolation using synthetic scenarios. We introduce PerSo, a benchmark that evaluates both aspects on real-world persuasion dialogues from Reddit's ChangeMyView community, using an LLM-in-the-loop pipeline to construct the evaluation tasks, validated through human annotation. Our evaluation of diverse LLMs shows that performance generally scales with model size but varies across dimensions. The strongest LLM slightly surpasses the best observed human performance on the behavioral task, while the best human participant remains ahead on the cognitive task.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PerSo:LLMs在现实世界劝导情景中的社会情报调查面貌
articles.content_zh: 了解大语言模型(LLMS)的社会智能对于涉及人与AI互动和多代理环境的应用越来越重要. 社会智能包括两个方面:认知智能,推断他人精神状态的能力,行为智能,根据这些推论选择适当的社会行动以实现社会目标的能力. 劝导提供了一个自然的试验床,在试验床中,两个方面同时发挥作用,然而,先前的基准通常采用合成情景孤立地加以评价。 我们引入了PerSo, 一个从Reddit's ChangeMyView社区来评价现实世界说服对话两方面的基准, 使用LLM-in-to-loop管道构建评估任务, 我们对各种有限责任方案的评价表明,业绩一般都以模型规模为尺度,但不同层面有所不同。 最强的LLM在行为任务上略微超过最受观察的人类表现,而最好的人类参与者在认知任务上仍然领先.

articles.title: PrismaCoder: Pushing the Boundaries of Open Multimodal Code Intelligence through Decomposed Rubric Synthesis
articles.content: Multimodal code intelligence connects the symbolic world of programs with the visual world their execution creates. Interest in this capability is burgeoning, as models are increasingly asked to produce charts, webpages, animations, and semi-structured documents. Recently, proprietary models have pushed far ahead, producing interactive artifacts even from a text description or a screenshot alone. Yet their data and training remain closed, and open progress is held back by the quantity and quality of available data and by the pipelines and methods for producing it. Quality is the harder of the two, since a sample must be correct as a program, well built, and above all visually right once rendered. No existing signal covers all three. Execution often returns just a pass or fail, code similarity does not map to the visual output, and task-specific verifiers do not generalize. To push open progress further, we start from the data side with PrismaForge, a hierarchical data pipeline centered on a synthesized rubric that decomposes these factors into checkable criteria. The same rubric serves as both filter and reward: it curates the supervised corpus, then drives reinforcement learning on visual-coding tasks. Leveraging PrismaForge for data synthesis and filtering, we build PrismaCoder-2M, the most diverse open dataset for multimodal code intelligence and the largest to date. On the model side, we train PrismaCoder-9B and PrismaCoder-35B on this data and release both. They lead the open state of the art by a wide margin and rival leading proprietary systems. Our analyses further show that the proposed rubric-based pipeline improves multimodal coding performance across model backbones. We release our code and data at https://qiushisun.github.io/PrismaCoder-Home/.

articles.title_zh: PrismaCoder:通过分解的Rubric合成来推进开放式多式联运代码智能的边界
articles.content_zh: 多式联运代码智能将程序的象征世界与它们的执行所创造的视觉世界联系起来. 对这种能力的兴趣正在增长,因为人们越来越多地要求模型制作图表、网页、动画和半结构文件。 最近,专有模型推进了很远的一步,甚至从文本描述或截图中产生交互式文物. 然而,他们的数据和培训仍然关闭,现有数据的数量和质量以及生产数据的管道和方法阻碍了开放的进展。 质量是两者中最难的,因为一个样本必须作为一个程序正确,构建良好,最重要的是,一旦被渲染出来,就具有视觉权利。 没有现有的信号覆盖所有三个. 执行通常只返回一个通过或失败,代码相似性不映射到视觉输出,任务特定核查者不概括. 为了进一步推进开放进展,我们从数据侧面开始与PrismaForge(英语:PrismaForge),一个分级的数据管道,其中心是一个将这些因素分解成可核查标准的合成标题. 同一标题既可以过滤,又可以奖励:它可以校准被监管人,然后推动在视觉编码任务方面的强化学习。 利用普里斯玛 Forge用于数据合成和过滤,我们建造了Prisma Coder-2M,这是用于多式联运代码智能的最多样化开放数据集,也是迄今为止最大的数据集. 在模型方面,我们在此数据上训练Prisma Coder-9B和Prisma Coder-35B,并同时发布两者. 它们以广阔的优势领导着开放的艺术状态,并竞争着领先的专有系统. 我们的分析进一步表明,拟议的基于标题的管道改进了示范骨干之间的多式联运编码工作。 我们在https://qiushisun.github.io/PrismaCoder-Home/上发布了我们的代码和数据。

articles.title: VASPO: Self-Distillation with Privileged Value Estimation
articles.content: On-policy self-distillation provides dense supervision for reasoning models via a privileged self-teacher. However, this supervision reflects local token preferences rather than the expected return of an unguided student continuation. Recent methods combine this signal with GRPO. They use GRPO for update directions and the teacher for signal scaling. However, we demonstrate a more effective integration within PPO. Specifically, we identify complementary positional dynamics: privileged information enhances a critic's value-prediction accuracy toward the response's end, whereas self-teacher guidance is strong initially, drops mid-generation, and rebounds finally. These insights motivate Value-Augmented Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (VASPO), wherein a self-teacher and critic evaluate identical privileged information at student-generated prefixes. The critic computes token-level PPO advantages from predicted continuation returns, while the self-teacher modulates selected positive advantages via bounded probability ratios. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, VASPO improves mean accuracy over PPO by 2.59 and 1.81 percentage points on Qwen3-4B and OLMo3-7B variants, respectively, and achieves the highest mean accuracy among evaluated methods on Knights and Knaves. Our code is available at https://github.com/cii030/VASPO.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VASPO: 自我分散与特权 数值估计
articles.content_zh: 政策上的自我消化通过特权的自我教师为推理模型提供了密集的监督. 然而,这种监督反映的是当地象征性的偏好,而不是无指导学生继续学业的预期回报。 最近的方法将这个信号与GRPO结合. 他们使用GRPO来更新方向,而老师则用于信号缩放. 然而,我们表明,在和平组织内部更有效地融入。 具体地说,我们确定了互补的位置动态:特权信息可以提高评论家对反应端的价值预测准确性,而自师指导最初很强,中年下降,最终反弹。 这些见解激发了增强价值的自我分裂政策优化(VASPO),其中一位自我教师和评论家在学生生成的前缀评价相同的特权信息. 评论家从预测的续作回报中计算出符号级的PPO优势,而自导师则通过限值概率比来调制选定的正面优势. 在整个六个数学推理基准中,VASPO在Qune3-4B和OLMo3-7B变体上分别比PPO提高了2.59和1.81个百分点的平均值精度,在Knights和Knaves的评价方法中实现了最高的平均值精度. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/cii030/VASPO上查阅。

articles.title: ReaDy: Recurrent States as Dynamic Context for Speculative Drafting in Hybrid Linear Attention Large Language Models
articles.content: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by drafting multiple tokens per step, yet feature-based drafters rely on target hidden features whose contextual emphasis may not align with the needs of subsequent draft positions. Hybrid linear attention (HLA) models maintain compact recurrent states that accumulate historical associations, offering an efficient source of complementary context for speculative drafting. We introduce ReaDy, the first speculative decoding method, to the best of our knowledge, to leverage HLA recurrent states for position-specific context retrieval during drafting. ReaDy equips each draft position with a learned query to retrieve supplementary context directly from the target's committed recurrent states. A lightweight state reader integrates this context into draft representations through residual updates, while low-rank state reads and fused operators keep additional computation and I/O overhead low. Building on DSpark's parallel backbone and sequential prediction head, ReaDy employs a lightweight two-stage adaptation strategy, with reader capacity, state sources, and residual placement examined through ablation studies. Across seven benchmarks spanning mathematics, code generation, and dialogue, ReaDy achieves an average $3.16\times$ decoding speedup over autoregressive decoding with Qwen3.8-27B on a single NVIDIA B200 GPU. It outperforms DSpark on every benchmark, improving throughput by 7.97% and acceptance length by 8.50% on average. Our code is available at https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/ReaDy.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ReaDy:经常国家作为混合线性注意力大语言模型的分样起草的动态背景
articles.content_zh: 光谱解码通过每步起草多个令牌来加速自动递归生成,然而基于特征的起草者依赖于目标隐藏特征,其上下文重点可能与后续的草案位置的需要不相符合. 混合线性关注(HLA)模式保持了累积历史关联的紧凑的反复状态,为投机性起草提供了有效的互补背景来源. 我们提出ReaDy,这是第一种推测性的解码方法,就我们所知,利用HLA的反复状态,在起草过程中进行特定位置上下文检索. ReaDy为每个草稿位置配备一个学到的查询,直接从目标承诺的反复状态获取补充上下文. 轻量级状态读取器通过剩余更新将这种上下文纳入草稿表达方式,而低级别状态读取和引信操作员则保持额外的计算,I/O的间接费用低. 在DSpark平行骨干和顺序预测头的基础上,ReaDy采用了轻量级的两阶段适应战略,读者能力,状态来源,剩余位置通过衰减研究进行检查. 在跨越数学,代码生成,和对话框的7个基准中,ReaDy在单NVIDIA B200 GPU上实现了平均3.16\times$的自转解码速度,而不是与Qune3.8-27B的自转解码. 它在每个基准上都超过了DSpark,平均吞吐量提高了7.97%,接受长度提高了8.50%. 我们的代码可以在https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/ReaDy上找到.

articles.title: Lost in Translation: Why Lower Bias Scores Don't Mean Fairer Models
articles.content: Bias audits of multilingual language models usually compare a model's average stereotype score in English with its average in another language and read the difference as a difference in fairness. We ask how much of that difference is noise. Auditing ten open models in eight languages, we measure how far scores move when English test items are merely reworded, test every language shift item by item, and check that the test catches shifts we inject on purpose. In all 70 model-language pairs the stereotype score falls below its English level, and for Hindi, Korean and Swahili the drop clearly exceeds what rewording English produces; most of it comes from StereoSet items. Judging every translation, we find that imperfect ones drop more, but faithful translations alone drop nearly as much. Still, a lower average does not show that a model is fairer. An item's English score predicts its translated score far less well than its reworded score (correlation 0.23, 0.27 on faithful translations, vs. 0.48), while scores stay as far from neutral, models agree on translated items, and within Hindi or Spanish a translated item's score correlates with its own rewording at 0.84 and 0.82. The average cannot distinguish lower bias from a different pattern of item-level scores. We also document three common pipeline errors that silently erase bias signal, and release our code.

articles.title_zh: 在翻译中丢失 : 为什么下比亚斯得分不代表公平模式
articles.content_zh: 对多语种语言模型的偏见审计通常将一个模型在英语中的平均定型分数与其在另一种语言中的平均分数进行比较,并将差异读作公平性的差异. 我们问,这种区别有多大是噪音。 以8种语言对10种开放模式进行审计,我们衡量英语测试项目只是重新填词时的分数移动多远,逐项测试每个语言变换项目,并检查测试是否捕获我们有意注入的变换。 在所有70种模式语言中,定型观念的分数都低于其英语水平,对印地语、韩语和斯瓦希里语来说,这一下降显然超过重新填词的英语产品;其中大部分来自StreoSet项目。 从每一译本来看,我们发现不完美的译本下降得更多,但仅靠忠实的译本就下降得差不多。 然而,较低的平均数并不表明一个模式更公平。 某一项的英语分数预测其翻译分数远不如其重写分数(关于忠实翻译的0.23,0.27, vs.0.48),而分数则远离中性,模型对翻译分数达成一致,在印地语或西班牙语中,一个翻译分数与其自己的重写0.84和0.82相关. 平均值无法区分较低偏差与不同项目级分数模式. 我们还记录了三个常见的管道错误,这些错误悄悄地抹去了偏见信号,并释放了我们的代码.

articles.title: AdaRSI: On-Demand Recursive Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents
articles.content: Pretrained vision-language-action models (VLAs) often fail midway through unseen long-horizon tasks. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a remedy, but embodied RSI methods either refine the harness around a frozen executor and so cannot add a missing motion, or train the executor on persistent failures without asking whether a failure lies in how the executor is called or in what it can do. We ask when a self-improving embodied system should change the weights of its executor, and propose AdaRSI, an on-demand RSI framework for embodied agents. A coding agent first improves its skills and harness, then attributes persistent failures by retrying failing sub-steps from saved states, and fine-tunes only the sub-steps that remain unreliable, with demonstrations it collects itself and experience carried over from earlier tasks. On all 50 target tasks of RoboCasa365, with GR00T N1.5 as the executor and no human demonstrations, AdaRSI improves the VLA on all three suites and raises its success on unseen composite tasks from 4.6% to 13.8%. Compared with fine-tuning every sub-step, it reaches slightly higher success while using only 28% of the GPU time and 22% of the self-collected demonstrations, and fine-tuning without a harness trains more yet gains far less.

articles.title_zh: AdaRSI:身体健康人员自检
articles.content_zh: 预先训练的视觉语言行动模式(VLAs)往往在未见的长视野任务中落空。 递归自我改进(RSI)提供了一种补救办法,但包含的RSI方法要么在被冻结的执行人周围细化绑带,因此不能增加缺失的动作,要么对执行人进行关于持续失败的训练,而不问失败在于如何称呼执行人还是它能做什么. 我们问,自我改进的体现体系何时应改变其执行者的权重,并提出AdaRSI, 即一个针对体现的代理人的按需RSI框架。 一个编码代理首先提高自己的技能和利用,然后通过重试来自被保存状态的失败子步骤来属性持续的失败,并且对仍然不可靠的子步骤进行微调,其中的演示会收集自己和以往任务中结转的经验. 在RoboCasa365的所有50项目标任务中,以GR00T N1.5为执行者,没有人类示威,AdaRSI改进了所有三个套房的VLA,并将其在隐形复合任务上的成功率从4.6%提高到13.8%. 与每个子步骤的微调相比,它取得了略高的成功,同时只使用了28%的GPU时间和22%的自收集演示,没有牵引列车的微调则收益更小得多.

articles.title: ChronoCulture: Evaluating Cultural Awareness Across Time in Large Language Models
articles.content: Cultural attitudes and social norms evolve over time, yet most cultural benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) treat culture as a static attribute of a country or region. We introduce ChronoCulture, a benchmark of 10,360 temporal pairs built from longitudinal survey data across 72 countries. Each pair contains the same survey question asked in the same country in an older and a newer year, with full population response distributions as ground truth. Across six LLMs, we find that models can often predict a country's attitudes at one point in time but do not reliably capture how those attitudes change. Their predictions for different years tend to stay close together, failing to capture much of the observed change. Specifying the intended year in the prompt also offers little overall improvement in alignment with survey responses. These findings suggest that models often present a largely static picture of cultural attitudes, highlighting the need to evaluate cultural awareness across time.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CronoCulture:在大语言模型中评价整个时代的文化意识
articles.content_zh: 文化态度和社会规范随时间演变,但大多数大语言模型(LLMS)的文化基准将文化视为一个国家或区域的静态属性. 我们介绍了ChronoCurture,这是根据72个国家的纵向调查数据制定的10,360对时间基准。 每对调查都包含同一国家中在较老和较新年份提出的相同调查问题,人口答复分布全面,作为地面真相。 我们发现,在六个法学硕士课程中,模型往往能够预测一个国家在某一时刻的态度,但却不能可靠地反映这些态度是如何改变的。 他们对不同年份的预测往往保持紧密的距离,无法捕捉到观察到的许多变化. 及时指明预定年份,在与调查答复保持一致方面也没有多少总体改进。 这些调查结果表明,模型往往呈现出文化态度的大致静态图景,突出表明有必要对文化意识进行长期评价。

articles.title: Equal CER, Unequal Damage: Severity-Weighted Character Error Rate for OCR
articles.content: Character Error Rate (CER), the standard metric for OCR and vision-language models (VLMs), charges a typo as much as a wrong name. We introduce semCER, which keeps CER's alignment and denominator and charges each grapheme edit a severity from an LLM judge, with no word segmentation. Normalized CER keeps the score of a whole transcription, where it tracks readers as well as semCER or better, and semCER breaks that score down into named edits. The charges track readers' ratings edit by edit in English, Vietnamese, and Chinese and put the edits readers rate most severe near the top of a sorted list. On pairs drawn where CER and semCER disagreed, readers side with semCER more often than with normalized CER in English and Chinese, and equally often in Vietnamese. Across 16 languages, the judge charges a wrong diacritic or tone mark almost nothing in Spanish but nearly a wrong letter's severity in Telugu. Where we can count real words, a general VLM's wrong letter forms one far above chance while a classical pipeline's stays near it. We release the 61 million judged edits, the aggregated reader ratings, and the distilled scorer at https://github.com/nguyenx2t/semcer.

articles.title_zh: 相等 CER, 不平等损害: OCR 严重加权字符错误率

articles.title: MolLean: A Process-Verifiable Language for Chemical Reasoning
articles.content: Chemical chain-of-thought can contain hallucinated structural and property claims. We thereby introduce MolLean, a process-verifiable language that grounds chemical reasoning in an explicit molecular state. A layered Lean-based kernel checks state transitions and assertions over molecular readouts, from primitive graph edits to compound transformations. Meanwhile, a typed witness protocol separates native structural checks from externally supplied measurements. We further introduce MolLean-MCP, a stateful tool interface that exposes these transitions, checks, and readouts during generation: the model receives feedback to decide its next action, and rejected actions leave the state unchanged. MolLean supports one-pass trace execution, whole-trace refinement, and interactive reasoning through MolLean-MCP. We evaluate these three modes with direct chain-of-thought on 8,800 matched examples across 12 tasks spanning molecular generation, editing, optimization, and reactions. With Qwen3.6-27B, whole-trace refinement outperforms direct chain-of-thought on all 12 tasks. MolLean-MCP complements whole-trace refinement with stepwise verification feedback, reaching better performance in reaction tasks. Together, these results highlight an executable foundation for chemical reasoning, in which explicit chemical commitments can be checked and revised rather than remaining solely in free-form explanations.

articles.title_zh: Molean:一种用于化学理由的可验证工艺语言
articles.content_zh: 化学思维链可以包含幻觉结构和财产索赔. 我们由此引入了Molean,一种过程可验证的语言,它使化学推理具有明显的分子状态. 一个分层的基于Lean的内核检查状态过渡和断言超过分子读取,从原始图编辑到复合变换. 同时,一个打字的证人协议将本地结构检查与外部提供的测量区分开来. 我们进一步引入了Mollean-MCP,这是一种状态化的工具界面,它暴露了这些转换,检查,和生成过程中的读取:模型收到反馈来决定其下一步行动,拒绝的行动则让状态保持不变. Molean支持单路跟踪执行,全轨修饰,并通过Molean-MCP进行交互推理. 我们用8,800个对应的例子来评估这三种模式, 包括分子生成、编辑、优化和反应。 随着Quen3.6-27B,全轨完善在所有12项任务上都超越了直接的思维链. Molean-MCP通过逐步的核查反馈来补充整个跟踪的完善,在反应任务中达到更好的性能. 这些结果共同突出了化学推理的可执行基础,其中可以检查和修订明确的化学承诺,而不是仅仅停留在自由形式的解释中。

articles.title: Same Claim, Different Interpretations: How LLM Agents Resolve Ambiguity in Scientific Claims
articles.content: Co-scientists and agentic scientific claim verifiers are increasingly used to assess claims across the sciences. Natural-language scientific claims, written for human experts, are often underspecified and so admit several defensible interpretations. Such verifiers usually pick one, often tacitly, and benchmarks score their verdicts against expert labels without recording the expert's interpretation or the verifier's in a comparable form. This leads to disagreements with expert labels that cannot be traced to the evidence or the interpretation, and to compute spent on unchecked interpretations. We introduce Claim Cards to make such interpretations explicit in the reasoning itself. A Claim Card records a verifier's interpretation as nine fields before evidence gathering, each marked stated, inferred, or default. To test whether an agent's interpretation can change its verdict, we ran a GPT-5.4 agent five times on each of 60 expert-labeled materials-science and biomedical claims with a card, without one, and with one card frozen across runs (900 runs). Over 40% of card fields were not marked stated, and a card added about a tenth to a run's GPT-5.4 tokens and time without measurably changing agreement with expert labels. The agent's own interpretations varied between runs, although within a claim this variation did not measurably track the verdict. A deliberate change to one field of the frozen card, however, making the quantifier universal or the threshold for support stricter, changed the verdict on about a third of the claims, against about one in seven expected by chance (p < 0.001 for each edit). On 24 materials-science claims run with computational tools, the stricter threshold also changed what the agent asked those tools to compute. We therefore argue that verdicts should be reported with their interpretations and that benchmarks could publish the interpretation behind each label.

articles.title_zh: 同一索赔,不同的解释:LLM代理如何解决科学索赔中的模糊性
articles.content_zh: 联合科学家和代理科学权利主张核查人越来越多地用于评估各科学权利主张。 为人类专家撰写的自然语言科学主张往往不够明确,因此认可了几种可辩驳的解释. 这种核查者通常会选择一种,往往是默认的,基准根据专家的标签来评分,而不记录专家或核查者的解释。 这导致与专家标签的分歧,这些标签无法追溯到证据或解释,并计算用于不加限制的解释。 我们采用索赔卡来明确解释理由本身。 一份索赔卡将核查人的解释记录为证据收集前的九个字段,每个字段注明、推断或缺省。 为了测试一个特工的解释是否能够改变其判决,我们用一张卡对60个专家标注的材料科学及生物医学索赔进行5次GPT-5.4代理,没有一张卡,并用1张被冻结的跨行(900跑). 超过40%的卡片字段没有被标记,一张卡片在运行的GPT-5.4信物和时间上加了大约十分之一,而没有与专家标签的明显改变协议. 代理商自己的解释各不相同,虽然在一项索赔中,这种不同之处无法衡量裁决。 然而,故意修改冻结卡的一个字段,使限定词具有普遍性或支持门槛更加严格,改变了对约三分之一索赔要求的裁决,而每七份索赔要求中预计有一份是偶然的(每份编辑一份,p < 0.001)。 关于24项使用计算工具的材料科学索赔,更严格的门槛也改变了代理人要求这些工具计算的内容。 因此,我们主张,判决应连同其解释一起报告,基准可以公布每个标签背后的解释。

articles.title: The COUNT: Counting N-grams Unlocks Scaling on Host Memory and Training-Free Adaptation
articles.content: The scaling relationship of compute and performance for language models (LMs) has been extensively studied; more recently, models are being designed to scale memory use, as well. In particular, adding embeddings for n-grams scales memory separately from compute use, because each pass only processes individual embedding rows, which are much smaller than the storage used for the whole embedding table. However, existing methods train embeddings from scratch, which needs expensive GPU memory for fast reading and writing. Meanwhile, the ordinary memory of the host system is cheap and underutilized by these training methods. To scale on host memory, we introduce COUNT (Counting Offline Unlocks N-gram Transformers), which builds n-gram embeddings without adding learned parameters by storing precomputed n-gram counts on host. We use the corpus frequencies to weight together the LM's own unembeddings of the next tokens most often following the current n-gram history. At a fixed compute budget, COUNT can be added as an additional input embedding for pretraining 1B-parameter LMs to improve validation loss as much as an LM with 57% more compute. If GPU memory is limited, using COUNT to let backbone parameters fill GPU memory gives better performance than splitting memory with additional learned n-gram embeddings. Beyond efficiency, COUNT allows switching in a different table of n-gram counts from a domain-specific corpus at inference time to adapt to a new task without any training.

articles.title_zh: COUNT:在主机记忆和免费培训上解锁
articles.content_zh: 对语言模型(LM)的计算和性能的缩放关系进行了广泛的研究;最近还在设计模型,以扩大内存的使用。 特别是,为n-grams刻度内存添加嵌入与计算使用分开,因为每个通过只处理单个嵌入行,这比整个嵌入表所用的存储要小得多. 然而,现有的方法从零开始训练嵌入,这需要昂贵的GPU内存来进行快速读写. 同时,主机系统的普通记忆成本低廉,被这些训练方法利用不足. 要在主机内存上缩放,我们引入了COUNT(Counting Outline Unlocks N-gram Transformers),它通过存储主机上的预计算n-gm计数来构建n-gm嵌入,而不添加学到的参数. 我们用血清频率来测量 LM本身的未嵌入物 最常见的是随着当前的n-gm历史。 在固定的计算预算中,可添加COUNT,作为预先训练1B参数LMs的额外输入嵌入,以改善验证损失,其LM比计算多57%. 如果GPU内存是有限的,使用COUNT让骨干参数填充GPU内存比用额外的已学到的n-gm嵌入来拆分内存能产生更好的性能. 除了效率之外,COUNT允许在推论时间从一个特定域的目录中切换到一个不同的n-g计数表,以适应新的任务而无需经过任何训练.

articles.title: SwarmRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Scientific Agent Swarm
articles.content: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) in scientific research aims to improve agents' research capabilities through their own experimental experience. Scientific agent swarms can combine evidence and implementations from different research directions to guide their agents' subsequent experiments. However, poor experimental results can leave unclear whether to revise a hypothesis or its implementation, while overall program scores can hide components useful to other agents. To address these challenges, we introduce SwarmRSI, a framework that evolves scientific agent swarms for recursive self-improvement. We devise Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation to refine hypotheses and their implementations using experimental feedback from other agents. We also propose Complementary Swarm Recombination to reuse retained hypotheses and complementary program components across agents, allowing partial results to support new research. Recursive Swarm Evolution integrates both mechanisms into a feedback loop, using new experimental evidence to guide subsequent research. Experiments on OpenProblems, NatureBench and MLE-Bench Lite demonstrate SwarmRSI's state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance. Further evaluations show that accumulated research experience improves performance on held-out tasks. Biologists also reproduce its programs for follow-up biological analyses.

articles.title_zh: SWARMRSI:通过演化的科学代理人SWARM进行递增自我改进
articles.content_zh: 科学研究中的递归自我改进(RSI)旨在通过自身的实验经验提高代理的研究能力. 科学代理人群可以结合不同研究方向的证据和实施,指导其代理人随后的实验. 然而,糟糕的实验结果可能使假说是否修改或其实施变得不明确,而总体程序分数可以隐藏对其他代理人有用的组件. 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了SwarmRSI,这个框架将科学物剂群演变为递归自我改进. 我们设计了以反馈为指南的Swarm Mutation,以利用其他代理人的实验反馈来完善假设及其执行。 我们还提议进行补充性Swarm重组,以重复利用所保留的假说和跨剂的补充程序组件,使部分结果能够支持新的研究。 递归性Swarm Evolution将两种机制融合到反馈循环中,利用新的实验证据来指导后续的研究. 关于OpenProblems,Nature Bench和MLE-Bench Lite的实验展示了SwarmRSI的先进性能(SOTA). 进一步的评价表明,积累的研究经验改善了被搁置任务的业绩。 生物学家还复制其后续生物分析方案。

articles.title: Analyzing performance of Retrieval Augmented Generation models for Question Answering Tasks
articles.content: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models have become almost a cornerstone of open-domain question answering tasks; in which the quality of answers generated in the process, greatly relies on the effectiveness of retrieval mechanisms. In the realm of LLM, the last two years have seen tremendous progress in RAG architectures, with many models reporting to have improved performance through various design innovations. The cultural question and answering systems of South Asia, in particular, present a specific challenge since the region is home to the vast number of languages and traditions, which are closely interrelated. Along with these deeply intertwined historical narratives increase the need for culturally grounded and context-aware interpretation. Despite major architectural advances in LLMs, claiming significant improvements, challenges remain when answering these region specific questions in native languages. In this study, we aim to extract high-performing factors to guide the development of optimized hybrid RAG systems. We further explore whether the integration of RAG changes performance differently for culturally grounded and non-cultural questions in a South Asian multilingual setup, and whether RAG produces a higher overall percentage of correct answers than contexted answering. We also examine how LLM performance changes when RAG methods are integrated into the question-answering pipeline in comparison with non-contexted and contexted answering and, evaluate whether the introduction of RAG benefits popular or non-popular culturally grounded questions more. Not only does our work evaluate the current methods but also carves a path for future designs of more accurate and efficient question-answering pipelines.

articles.title_zh: 分析回答问题任务的检索增强生成模型的性能
articles.content_zh: 检索-增强生成(RAG)模型几乎已经成为开放域问题解答任务的基石;其中在过程中生成的解答质量在很大程度上取决于检索机制的有效性. 在LLM领域,过去两年在RAG架构方面取得了巨大进展,许多模型报告通过各种设计创新提高了性能. 特别是南亚的文化问题和回答系统是一个具体的挑战,因为该区域拥有大量密切相关的语言和传统。 除了这些相互交织的历史叙事之外,更需要基于文化和了解背景的解释。 尽管LLMS在建筑方面取得重大进展,但用当地语言回答这些区域的具体问题仍然面临挑战。 在这项研究中,我们的目标是提取高性能因素,以指导优化混合RAG系统的发展. 我们进一步探讨,在南亚多语种结构中,区域一体化小组的整合是否对基于文化和非文化问题的表现有不同的改变,区域一体化小组的正确答案总体百分比是否高于背景答案。 我们还审查与非文字和背景回答相比,在将RAG方法纳入问答程序时,LLM的性能如何变化,并评价采用RAG是否有利于大众或非大众文化问题。 我们的工作不仅评估了目前的方法,而且为今后设计更准确、更高效的问答管道开辟了道路。

articles.title: From Unreliable to Usable: Decomposing Failure Modes and Confidence Signals in LLM Entity Extraction - Evidence from Cyber Threat Intelligence
articles.content: Audits of large language model (LLM) extraction from full-length documents report severe unreliability, leaving two questions open: what the failures actually consist of, and whether confidence signals can turn unreliable output into usable output. We run a preregistered, fully frozen evaluation of two new-generation low-cost LLMs (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GLM-5.3-Flash) with a flagship-tier control (GPT-6.1-Sol) on a public corpus of 354 incident campaigns (315 unique reports, 630 model-report evaluations), scoring extraction quality against gold, confidence calibration, and robustness to single-sentence perturbations. Three findings emerge. (1) Unreliability persists across tiers: micro precision is 0.03-0.34 and verbalized calibration error (ECE) 0.53-0.94 across both splits; the gap does not close at the flagship tier. (2) The dominant failure is not hallucination: a full mention census plus a three-tier annotation of 360 sampled candidates (two independent LLM annotators from vendors outside the evaluated set, Cohen's kappa = 0.79 on the preregistered acceptance line, fully disclosed) back-projects to 65.6% background mentions and 19.9% gold-scope gaps, with only 1.2% unsupported candidates. (3) Confidence ranks but does not verify: zero-cost self-consistency-frequency tiering passes a preregistered top-30% precision-gain bar in all six test-split model-type cells (4/6 on train), the zero-cost text-frequency x SC frequency combination wins 3, ties 2, loses 1 across cells, yet relation-level counterfactuals on all 45 targets show that a single misattribution sentence flips high-confidence judgments in 95.6-100% of cases, and even a background sentence explicitly marked as unrelated still binds a fake vulnerability in up to 26.7% of them. We conclude with a deployment boundary: confidence tiering may set review priorities, never truth.

articles.title: Cortex: Consolidating Context into Parametric Memory
articles.content: Context can improve large language model performance, but these gains may be lost after context removal. Inspired by biological systems consolidation, we formulate Memory Consolidation (MC) as internalizing these gains while preserving non-target capabilities, connecting context-specified editing, skill learning, and behavioral steering under a common objective. We introduce a five-task-family testbed measuring consolidation and retention under single, batch, and sequential updates. We propose Cortex, which generates prospective queries to anticipate uses of context and distills context-conditioned outputs into mergeable low-rank or structural feed-forward network updates. Across 4B--120B dense and mixture-of-experts backbones, including both text-only and multimodal models, Cortex lies on the empirical consolidation--retention Pareto frontier in most evaluated settings. After 50 sequential factual edits on a 14B model, Cortex-Structural recovers 88.9% of the context-induced gain while retaining 99.8% of original non-target performance.
