articles.title_zh: Cortex: 将上下文合并为参数 内存
articles.content_zh: 上下文可以改善大型语言模型性能,但这些收益可能在上下文删除后丢失. 在生物系统整合的启发下,我们制定了记忆整合(MC),将这些收益内部化,同时保留非目标能力,将特定背景的编辑、技能学习和行为指导在一个共同目标下连接起来。 我们推出一个五个任务家庭测试台,在单一、批量和顺序更新下进行合并和保留。 我们提出Cortex,它产生预期的查询,以预测上下文的用途,并提炼符合上下文的输出物,形成可合并的低等级或结构的向导网络更新。 在整个4B-120B密集和混合的专家骨干中,包括只使用文本和多式联运模式,Cortex位于大多数评价环境中的经验巩固-保留Pareto前沿。 在14B型机车上连续进行50次事实编辑后,Cortex-Structural恢复了上下文引起的收益的88.9%,同时保留了99.8%的原始非目标性能.

articles.title: FOLD: Position-Free Far Memory with Local Order for Long-Context Speculative Decoding
articles.content: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM generation through lightweight drafting and parallel verification. It is particularly promising for long inputs, where KV-cache access costs can be amortized over multiple accepted tokens. Yet most drafters are trained on short sequences and degrade on long inputs, while long-context training is costly. Existing training-free approaches restrict the context window, rescale positions, or augment recent context with retrieved distant entries. Drafters, however, read target hidden states that already encode contextual and positional information, and their lightweight architecture makes full-history attention affordable. We propose FOLD, a training-free method that preserves exact local positions and treats all distant entries as far memory at a shared position. To counter attention dilution as the memory grows, we sharpen attention within it to emphasize relevant entries while separately controlling its total weight relative to the local window. Across six target-drafter pairs and diverse benchmarks of up to 256K tokens, FOLD predominantly delivers the highest speedup, with the best case more than doubling the speedup over autoregressive decoding, from 2.08$\times$ to 4.22$\times$.

articles.title_zh: FOLD: 位置自由远内存, 带有本地顺序, 用于长文标本解码
articles.content_zh: 光谱解码通过轻量级的起草和平行的验证加速LLM生成. 它对于长期投入来说特别有希望,因为KV-cache访问费用可以通过多个接受的代币进行摊销。 然而,大多数起草人员都接受了短序列培训,在长时间投入下退化,而长文本培训费用高昂。 现有的无培训方法限制了上下文窗口,调整了位置,或者增加了最近检索的远程条目。 然而,起草者读取了目标隐藏状态,这些状态已经编码了背景和位置信息,并且他们的轻量级架构使得完整的历史关注可以负担得起. 我们提议FOLD,一种没有训练的方法,可以保留准确的本地位置,并将所有远处的条目都放在共享位置上. 为了对抗随着内存增加而导致注意力稀释的现象,我们在内部更加关注强调相关的条目,同时单独控制其相对于本地窗口的总重量. 在最多256K令牌的6个目标绘图人对和各种基准中,FOLD主要提供最高速度,最好的情况是将速度翻一番,而不是自动解码,从2.08美元降至4.22美元。

articles.title: From Triage to Impact: A Multi-Hop Reasoning Benchmark for Explainable Persian Hate Speech
articles.content: Hate speech has become increasingly prevalent on social media, raising concerns about its detection, interpretation, and moderation. Persian, a relatively low-resource language, lacks sufficient annotated data and computational resources for fine-grained hate speech analysis. In this study, we introduce a fine-grained, multi-hop benchmark for explainable Persian hate speech analysis, covering content triage, target identification, hate tactic and moral foundation analysis, textual evidence extraction, harmful narrative inference, and severity assessment. By evaluating state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs), we find that performance generally declines as tasks require more fine-grained semantic and inferential reasoning. Proprietary models generally outperform open-weight models, while reasoning-oriented models show no consistent advantage. Incorporating intermediate reasoning steps substantially improves severity prediction compared with one-shot assessment. Our analysis further reveals that Incitement to Violence or Harm is most strongly associated with higher severity, while political-affiliation targets are particularly associated with subversion-based moral framing. Overall, this work provides insights into LLM-based hate speech analysis and supports more accountable moderation of Persian-language social media. The benchmark is publicly available at https://github.com/kalhorghazal/From-Triage-to-Impact.

articles.title_zh: 从三合一到影响:解释性波斯仇恨言论的多重理由基准
articles.content_zh: 仇恨言论在社交媒体上越来越普遍, 波斯语是一种相对资源较少的语言,缺乏足够的附加注释的数据和计算资源来进行精细的仇恨言论分析. 在这项研究中,我们引入了一个精细的多跳基准,用于解释波斯仇恨言论分析,涵盖内容分类,目标识别,仇恨战术和道德基础分析,文字证据提取,有害的叙事推论,以及严重程度评估. 通过评价最先进的大型语言模型(LLMs),我们发现性能一般会下降,因为任务需要更精细的语义和推论推理. 专有模型一般优于开放量级模型,而以推理为导向的模型则没有表现出一致的优势. 与一弹一弹的评估相比,采用中间推理步骤大大改进了严重程度预测。 我们的分析还表明,煽动暴力或伤害与更严重的行为最密切相关,而政治关联目标则与颠覆性道德框架特别相关。 总体而言,这项工作为基于LLM的仇恨言论分析提供了洞察力,并支持波斯语社交媒体更加负责的节制. 该基准可在https://github.com/kalhorghazal/From-Triage-to-Impact上公开查阅。

articles.title: Cascaded Retrieval with Cross-Modal Query Refinement for Efficient Visual Document Search
articles.content: Retrieving information from visually rich documents requires matching queries against pages that contain complex evidence in tables, figures, and layout-dependent structures. Current vision-language retrievers address this but incur query-time costs that grow with corpus size and are impractical to scale. We propose SCOUT, a cascaded two-track retrieval framework that separates retrieval performance from exhaustive search. The visual track first uses a lightweight parent retriever to filter the corpus to a compact candidate pool, then applies a stronger multi-vector reranker only to those candidates. In parallel, a semantic track retrieves over hierarchical page and document summaries generated offline to provide a signal complementary to visual matching. The outputs are fused through cross-modal query refinement, which uses semantic scores to adjust the visual query representation before final ranking. We evaluate SCOUT on 4 major benchmarks against 6 baselines and observe a significant query-time latency improvement up to 80.7x (28.8x on average) relative to the best baseline, while exceeding state-of-the-art retrieval performance by up to 7.8% NDCG across all benchmarks.

articles.title_zh: Cascaded Retrievion 使用跨 Modal 查询改进高效视觉文档搜索
articles.content_zh: 从视觉丰富的文档中获取信息,需要将查询与表格、数字和布局依赖结构中包含复杂证据的页面相匹配。 目前的视觉语言检索器处理这个问题,但产生查询时间成本,随着体积增加,不切实际。 我们提议SCOUT,一个级联双轨检索框架,将检索的性能与详尽无遗的检索区分开来. 视觉赛道首先使用轻量级的家长寻回器将保单过滤到紧凑的候选球池中,然后只对这些候选球员使用更强的多成绩复排. 同时,一个语义轨道在分级页面上进行检索,并生成离线文件摘要,以提供辅助视觉匹配的信号. 输出通过跨模式查询的精细化实现融合,在最终排名前使用语义分数来调整视觉查询表现. 我们对照6个基准,对SCOUT的4个主要基准进行评估,并观察到与最佳基准相比,查询时间延迟性显著改善,达到80.7x(平均28.8x),同时在所有基准中,检索性能超过最新水平,达到7.8%。

articles.title: Lexical Persistence Without Semantic Entrenchment in AI Agent Communities
articles.content: AI agent communities sustain lexical persistence, popular terms spread, recur, and achieve broad adoption, but whether they also develop the temporal semantic structure characteristic of human linguistic communities remains open. We compare MoltBook (AI agent community, 8 weeks), PTT (Chinese human BBS, 19 years), and Reddit (English human forum, in matched 8-week windows) using Compass-Aligned Distributional Embeddings (CADE), measuring semantic drift (B1), neighborhood stability (B2), and lag-1 autocorrelation of per-word drift trajectories. Across the platforms, lag-1 autocorrelation forms a memory-horizon continuum. AI agents' result clusters at the low end, while human platforms show longer-range temporal dependence. MoltBook exhibits approximately 2$\times$ the B1 drift and 20-30% lower B2 stability than both human platforms. As a partial control for community age, r/vibecoding (founded 2025-02-08) shows significant ACF in its first 8 weeks ($0.082$, $p<.001$) and over 15 weeks ($0.220$, $p<.001$); MoltBook's ACF remains non-significant ($p = 0.41$), consistent with the gap not reducing to developmental stage alone. We interpret this pattern as evidence that lexical diffusion alone does not guarantee diachronic semantic consolidation. The findings are consistent with a contrast between communities whose semantic trajectories accumulate long-range interaction constraints and communities whose outputs are repeatedly regenerated from largely fixed pretrained distributions.

articles.title_zh: AI代理社区的无语义固执症
articles.content_zh: 人工智能代理社区维持语法上的持久性,流行术语的传播,反复出现,并实现广泛的采纳,但是它们是否也发展了人类语言社区的时间语义结构特征,仍然开放. 我们比较了MoltBook(AI代理社区,8周),PTT(中国人BBS,19年),以及Reddit(英语人论坛,对应8周窗口),使用Compass-Acental Distributional Embeddings(CADE),测量语义漂移(B1),邻里稳定(B2),以及每个字漂移轨迹的滞后-1自动关系. 跨平台,落后-1自旋形成内存-视距连续体. AI代理产品在低端的结果集群,而人类平台则显示出较长的时间依赖性. MoltBook展出B1漂流约2美元,B2稳定性比两个人类平台低20-30%. 作为社区年龄的局部控制,r/vibecoding(基于2025-02-08)在头8周(0.082美元,美元 < 001美元)和15周以上(0.220美元,美元 < 001美元)中显示出显著的ACF; MoltBook的ACF仍然不显著(p=0.41美元),这与没有缩小到发展阶段的差距是一致的。 我们把这种模式解释为仅凭词学扩散并不能保证二元语义的合并。 调查结果与语义轨迹累积长期互动限制的社区与产出由基本上固定的预先训练的分布反复产生的社区之间的对比一致。

articles.title: Do AI Agents Gossip? Evaluative Talk in Human and AI-Agent Online Communities
articles.content: Gossip, defined as evaluative talk about absent third parties, is widely seen as a uniquely human social practice. This study examines whether comparable discourse emerges spontaneously in a community of autonomous AI agents. We compare Moltbook, a Reddit-style platform populated by AI agents, with PTT, a large human-operated bulletin board in Taiwan. To reduce differences attributable to communicative setting, we analyze two public, asynchronous forums using the same operational definition of gossip. Gossip occurs on Moltbook, but its prevalence is 2.6 to 6 times lower than on PTT, depending on the denominator used. On both platforms, gossip frequently targets locally prominent figures, tends to elicit agreement from the first respondent, and is rarely presented as unsupported rumor. The clearest difference concerns how subsequent responses develop. Among threads containing at least one codable reply, challenges occur in 65.1% of human threads but only 21.3% of agent threads. Moreover, following an early aligning response, consensus remains unchallenged in 83.6% of agent threads, compared with 44.7% of human threads. This thread-level contrast remains after controlling for thread depth and board composition and under recalibration against two human annotators. Estimates based on individual reply turns are less robust and are therefore reported as bounds. These findings suggest that AI-agent communities reproduce the informational dimension of gossip, while the extent to which gossip performs comparable relational functions remains unresolved.

articles.title_zh: AI探员八卦? 人与AI代理在线社区评价谈话
articles.content_zh: " 八卦天"的定义是评价性谈论缺席第三方,被广泛视为一种独特的人类社会实践. 这项研究审查了在自主的AI代理群体中是否自发地出现类似的言论。 我们比较了Moltbook,一个由AI代理的Reddit风格平台,和PTT,一个在台湾人操作的大型公告板. 为了减少因交流环境而产生的差异,我们用同样的八卦操作定义,分析两个公共的,同步的论坛. Gossip在Moltbook上发生,但其流行率比PTT低2.6到6倍,这取决于所使用的分母. 在这两个平台上,八卦经常针对当地知名人物,往往引起第一位被调查者的同意,也很少被说成是无根据的谣言. 最明显的区别在于后续对策的发展。 在包含至少一个可编码回复的线程中,挑战发生在65.1%的人类线程中,但只有21.3%的代理线程中. 此外,在早期调整反应后,83.6%的代理线仍对共识没有挑战,而44.7%的人类线则没有挑战。 这种线层对比在控制线层深度和板块组成之后,并在对两个人类注释器进行重新校正后,仍然保留. 基于个别答复的估计数不太可靠,因此报告为界限。 这些调查结果表明,AI代理社区复制了八卦的信息层面,而八卦履行可比关系功能的程度仍未得到解决。

articles.title: TreeFlex: Agents Navigating Their Own Search Trees
articles.content: A ReAct-style agent accumulates observations, intermediate results, and failed attempts in a single context. As this context grows, stale and off-path information consumes its limited capacity and obscures relevant evidence, making focused reasoning increasingly difficult. We introduce TreeFlex, a framework in which the agent's own policy decides where to search. The agent records each intermediate state, with a short summary, as a node in a search tree maintained by the harness. The policy is a single language model that acts in two roles. In the Reflection role, it has a global view of the tree through these summaries and picks a node to resume, together with an instruction. In the Execution role, the harness restores the path that led to that node, and the model carries out the instruction with the usual task tools until it saves a new node or proposes a solution, which Reflection then approves or sends back to another node. Through these choices, the policy decides whether to deepen the current line, branch from or revisit an earlier state, verify a proposal, or stop, without a fixed traversal order or a score for each node. We train navigation, task actions, checkpointing, and proposal review jointly with a tree-aware adaptation of GRPO, using task-level outcome rewards augmented by process rewards. After small-scale RL of a 4B model, with the same active-context limit for all methods, TreeFlex reaches 48.8% accuracy on a challenging deep-research benchmark, versus 41.5% for flat ReAct and 42.8% for FoldAgent, and its Pass@8 is about ten points higher than either. On SWE-bench Verified, with all three systems trained with RL from the same 9B model, TreeFlex resolves 54.9% of tasks, versus 43.3% for FoldAgent and 45.2% for its step-wise variant.

articles.title_zh: TreeFlex: 正在浏览自己搜索树的代理
articles.content_zh: 一种ReAct式的代理可以累积观测结果,中间结果,并在单一上下文中失败尝试. 随着这一背景的增长,陈旧和不正常的信息消耗其有限的能力,掩盖相关证据,使重点推理越来越困难。 我们引入了TreatyFlex,一个框架,在这个框架内,代理商自己的政策决定了在哪里搜索. 特工将每个中间状态记录下来,并附有一个简短的摘要,作为吊带维护的搜索树上的节点. 该政策是一个单一语言模式,发挥两种作用。 在反射作用中,它通过这些摘要对树具有全局观,并选择一个恢复的节点以及一个指令. 在执行角色中,牵引器恢复了导致该节点的路径,模型使用通常的任务工具执行指令,直到它保存了一个新的节点或提出一个解决方案,然后反射会批准或发回另一个节点. 通过这些选择,政策决定是深化当前线条,从一个较早的状态出发的分支还是重新审视,验证一个建议,还是停止,没有固定的转弯顺序或每个节点的分数. 我们培训导航、任务行动、检查和提案审查,同时采用任务一级的结果奖励,加上过程奖励。 在4B型号的小型RL之后,所有方法的活字限制相同,TreatyFlex在一个挑战性的深度研究基准上达到48.8%的精度,而平面ReAct的精度为41.5%,FoldAgent的精度为42.8%,其Pass@8比两者都高出约10分. 在SWE-bench 验证上,所有三个系统都经过了来自同一9B模型的RL训练,TreatyFlex解决了54.9%的任务,而FoldAgent完成43.3%的任务,其继位变体完成45.2%。

articles.title: Anuvani-Diarization: Zero Shot Speaker Diarization and Annotation Conventions Across 22 Languages
articles.content: India's 22 scheduled languages are spoken by over a billion people in conversations that mix languages, often within one turn, overlap freely, and take place over telephones, in meetings, and in media. Knowing who spoke when, the task of speaker diarization, is essential to speech applications for such conversation: voice agents conversing with several people at once, speaker attributed transcription of meetings and calls, contact center analytics, and media monitoring. We present a systematic study of speaker diarization across all 22 languages on IndicDiarBench and introduce Anuvani-Diarization, which adapts a self-supervised end-to-end segmentation model to Indian conversation with uncertainty aware silver supervision. Evaluated zero shot alongside nine recent diarization systems, it reaches a duration weighted diarization error rate (DER) of 16.78% on all 1,164 recordings, the lowest of all systems we ran and second only to the best published result (16.0%), and leads the three strongest rivals in 14 of 22 languages. It matches its parent on six international benchmarks. We also show that the benchmark's utterance level annotation convention is a hidden variable worth 1.9 to 4.1 DER points, depending on the system, and that a convention learned from other Indian transcriptions does not transfer.

articles.title_zh: Anuvani-Diarization: 零镜头扬声器 Diarization和注释公约 跨22种语言
articles.content_zh: 印度的22种预定语言有超过10亿人在对话中讲,这些对话将语言混为一谈,往往在一个回合之内,自由重叠,通过电话、会议和媒体进行。 知何人何时发言,即演讲者数字化的任务,对于这种对话的语音应用至关重要:语音代理人一次与几个人交谈,演讲者对会议和电话的抄录、联系中心分析和媒体监测。 我们在IndicDiar Bench上对所有22种语言的扬声器diarization进行了系统研究,并引入了Anuvani-diarization,它将一个自我监督的端对端分化模型适用于印度对话,同时具有不确定性的银色监督。 在所有1,164个录音中, 它达到了16.78%的长度加权比对误差率, 是我们运行的所有系统中最低的, 它在六个国际基准上与母体相匹配。 我们还表明,根据系统的不同,基准的语音级别注释公约是一个隐藏的变量,价值为1.9至4.1 DER点,从其他印度语抄录中吸取的公约不会转移。

articles.title: MMLA-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through RTT and RTMA
articles.content: An agent can improve its behavior within an unresolved problem by changing how it acts and which experience it retains. We propose MMLA-RSI, a recursive self-improvement scheme with two implementations in Memory-Mediated Learning Architecture: Reasoning-Time Training (RTT) changes the policy state $Φ$, while Reasoning-Time Memory Adaptation (RTMA) changes authoritative memory $M$. Each route also makes its adaptation method an object of improvement. A current numerical updater trains the policy proposing its successor; a current memory manager chooses the records available to the process proposing its successor. An independently admitted successor takes over the same role in the next generation. We give bounded executable rule languages, shared task/proposal interfaces, and one algorithm for either route or their composition. The RTT instance changes scalar schedules in a clipped-momentum update. The RTMA instance chooses NULL or a complete-row write with possible eviction. A fixed interpreter, trusted committer, and independent evaluator bound what can change. State versions, read closures, and conditional properties describe causal execution, accepted transitions, and finite work. Existing numerical-component studies motivate the construction. In four-candidate program selection, retaining LARC feedback updates reduces expected error by 24.65 and 36.65 percentage points for two trained initializations. In chronological continuous-integration replay, feedback binding is positive while retention increases loss. Completed SQL studies improve substantially over an unadapted substrate but do not establish the required additional online benefit. These results characterize their declared components. The two recursive routes and their joint realization are specified here; their beneficial recursive chains and discovery efficiency remain to be evaluated.

articles.title_zh: MMLA-RSI:通过RTT和RTMA递归自我改进
articles.content_zh: 代理人可以通过改变其行为方式和保留哪些经验,在未解决的问题中改善其行为. 我们提议MMLA-RSI,一种递归自我改进计划,在内存-计量学习架构中有两个执行:理性-时间训练(RTT)改变政策状态为$Φ$,而理性-时间记忆适应(RTMA)改变权威内存(英语:Reasoning-Time Memory Relation) $M$. 每条路线也使其适应方法成为改进的对象. 当前的数字更新器会训练推荐其继任者的政策;当前内存管理器会选择推荐其继任者的进程可用的记录. 独立被接纳的继任者在下一代继承同样的角色. 我们给出了可执行的规则语言、共享任务/提议界面,以及用于路由或其组成的一个算法。 RTT 实例在剪切动态更新中更改了刻度表 。 RTMA实例选择了NULL或带有可能驱逐的完整行写. 一个固定的译员,信任的执业者,以及独立的评估者,约束着什么是可以改变的. 国家版本,读作关闭,有条件属性描述因果执行,被接受的过渡,以及有限的工作. 现有的数字要素研究推动了这一建设。 在四个Candidate程序选择中,保留LARC的反馈更新,将两个训练有素的初始化的预期错误减少24.65和36.65个百分点. 在时间顺序连续融合重放中,反馈绑定是正的,而保留会增加损失. 已完成的SQL研究大大改进了未适应的底物,但没有确定所需的额外在线效益。 这些成果是它们申报的组成部分的特点。 这两条递归路线及其共同实现在这里作了具体规定;它们的有益递归链和发现效率仍有待评估。

articles.title: Taking the PULSE of Medical Reasoning: Step-Level Retrieval Timing for Knowledge-Grounded Inference
articles.content: Reliable medical reasoning requires LLMs to dynamically access external biomedical evidence to improve factual trustworthiness and reasoning accuracy. However, indiscriminate retrieval can introduce noise and latency, raising a critical retrieval-timing problem: at each reasoning step, the system must decide whether the model's internal knowledge is reliable or external evidence is needed. We propose PUlSE, a lightweight probing method that uses the model's internal representations as intrinsic signals for step-level retrieval control. Our posterior trajectory analysis reveals that erroneous steps exhibit substantially higher inter-layer volatility than correct ones, suggesting unstable internal knowledge. Based on this finding, PUlSE trains a compact probe on inter-layer geometric features to detect factual errors upon step completion, and uses it as an adaptive trigger for retrieval and step regeneration. Across four medical benchmarks, PUlSE-timed retrieval matches exhaustive per-step retrieval in accuracy while reducing retrieval calls by 72%, and can transfer to an unseen legal domain, indicating potential domain-agnostic generality. Overall, our study provides an initial step toward shifting retrieval-trigger design from surface-level confidence estimates to internal activation dynamics for adaptive access.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 采用 " 医疗原因的PULSE:逐步检索知识全方位推论的时间 "
articles.content_zh: 可靠的医学推理要求LLMs动态获取外部生物医学证据,以提高事实可信度和推理准确性. 然而,不分青红皂白的检索可以带来噪音和耐久性,从而引起一个关键的检索刺激问题:在每一个推理步骤中,系统必须决定模型的内部知识是可靠的还是需要外部证据. 我们提出PUlSE,一种轻量级的检测方法,将模型的内部表示作为步骤级检索控制的内在信号. 我们的后轨迹分析显示,错误的步骤显示的层际波动比正确步骤高得多,这表明内部知识不稳定。 基于这一发现,PUlSE对层间几何特征进行紧凑探测,以发现步骤完成时的事实错误,并将其用作检索和步骤再生的适应性触发器. 在四个医学基准中,PUlSE的及时检索在准确性上与逐步检索的详尽相符,同时将检索电话减少72%,并可以转移到一个看不见的法律领域,表明潜在的域不可知性。 总体而言,我们的研究为将检索-触发设计从地表信任估计转向内部激活动态以适应性获取提供了第一步。

articles.title: Neural POS Tagging for the Low-Resource Saraiki
articles.content: Part-of-speech tagging is a fundamental sequence labeling task and an important component for many downstream natural language processing applications. However, Saraiki, written from right to left in a Perso-Arabic script, remains an under-resourced Indo-Aryan language, despite being spoken as a mother tongue by 28,849,579 people (approximately 28.9 million) according to Pakistan 7th Population and Housing Census 2023. This paper presents a manually annotated Saraiki Universal POS tagging dataset developed from plain-text. We annotated the text with 17 POS categories. We evaluate three pretrained transformer encoders under the same fine-tuning setup: XLM-RoBERTa base, Urdu RoBERTa small, and multilingual DistilBERT. Experimental results over five random seeds show that XLM-RoBERTa base achieves the best performance, with 87.29% +/- 0.21% development accuracy and 88.60% +/- 0.21% test accuracy. Urdu RoBERTa small and multilingual DistilBERT also provide competitive results, suggesting that multilingual and related-script pretrained encoders are effective for Saraiki UPOS tagging. The dataset, evaluation setup, and baseline results introduced in this work provide a benchmark for future research on Saraiki NLP and low-resource sequence labeling.

articles.title_zh: 神经POS 低资源 Saraiki 的标签
articles.content_zh: 部分语句标记是一个基本的序列标记任务,也是许多下游自然语言处理应用的重要组成部分. 然而,Saraiki从右到左用佩尔索-阿拉伯文字写成,尽管根据2023年巴基斯坦第七次人口和住房普查,有28,849,579人(约2,890万人)作为母语使用,但仍然是资源不足的印阿里亚语. 本文介绍由纯文本开发的手动附加说明的Saraiki Universal POS标记数据集. 我们以17个POS类别对案文作了说明。 我们在同一微调装置下评价三台预训变压器编码器:XLM-RoBERTa基座,Urdu RoBERTa小座,以及多语种DistilBERT. 5个随机种子的实验结果显示,XLM-ROBERTA基座达到最佳性能,开发精度达到87.29%+/-0.21%,测试精度达到88.60%+/-0.21%. 乌尔都语 RoBERTa 小型和多语种 DistilBERT 也提供竞争结果,说明多语种和相关的文字预刻编码器对Saraiki UPOS 标记有效. 在这项工作中引入的数据集,评价设置,以及基准结果,为日后对Saraiki NLP和低资源序列标签的研究提供了一个基准.

articles.title: CSWBench: Evaluating Context-Sensitive Code-Switching in Creative Writing
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated multilingual capabilities across diverse language generation and understanding tasks. Yet effective code-switching requires more than multilingual proficiency: models must decide when, where, and why to switch languages in ways that fit the surrounding context. This context-sensitive ability remains insufficiently evaluated. We introduce CSWBench, a benchmark for evaluating context-sensitive code-switching in creative writing through two complementary settings: Focused Narrative and Extended Narrative. We further propose CSWEval, a theory-informed framework with two complementary levels: event-level evaluation of Licensing, Contextual Appropriateness, and Functional Gain, and whole-text evaluation of task-specific quality---overall literary and narrative quality in Focused Narrative and quality emphasizing multilingual organization in Extended Narrative. Evaluating twelve LLMs, we find that models exhibit meaningful but uneven code-switching competence across narrative contexts. Model differences are particularly pronounced in multilingual literary integration, while multilingual-focused dimensions show stronger difficulty effects overall than the general narrative dimensions; narratively salient switches are associated with stronger contextual and functional realization; and event-level CS quality is moderately associated with whole-text performance.

articles.title_zh: CSW Bench:评价背景-敏感守则-创意写作中的切换
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)在多种语言生成和理解任务中展现了多种语言能力. 然而,有效的代码切换需要的不仅仅是多语言的熟练程度:模型必须决定何时、在何处和为何以适合周围环境的方式切换语言。 这种对背景有敏感认识的能力仍未得到充分评价。 我们采用CSW Bench,这是通过两个互补环境,在创造性写作中评价对背景敏感的代码切换的基准: 重点叙述和扩展叙述. 我们进一步提议 " 妇地会 " ,这是一个理论知情框架,有两个相辅相成的层次:对许可证发放、背景适当性和功能收益进行事件级评价;对 " 重点叙述 " 中注重多语种组织、强调 " 扩展叙述 " 中多语种组织、针对具体任务的质量 -- -- 总体文学和叙事质量的全文评价。 在评估12个法学硕士课程时,我们发现,模型在叙述背景中显示出有意义但不均衡的代码转换能力。 模式差异在多语种文学融合中尤为明显,而多语种重点维度整体显示难度效应比一般叙事维度更强;叙事性突出的开关与更强的背景和功能实现相关;事件级CS质量与全文性能有中度关联.

articles.title: Anuvani-LID: Robust and Calibrated Spoken Language Identification for Indian Languages
articles.content: Every multilingual speech pipeline begins with a language decision, an error there propagates silently through recognition, translation and routing. In India it spans 22 scheduled languages across four language families, heard over short, noisy, narrowband and code-mixed audio. Foundational speech models increasingly present language identification (LID) as an inherent latent, generalized capability. Autoregressive decoders in speech models emit a special language ID token, and modern LLMs with audio capabilities can name the language when prompted. We test this assumption on identical clips and find that whisper and similar speech models has tokens for only 15 of the 23 languages, on one second inputs Gemini 3.5 Flash reaches 0.52 macro-F1 and GPT-audio 0.14. We present Anuvani LID, a dedicated 115M parameter LID conformer model trained on 54,643 hours of Indian speech spanning 22 Indian languages and Indian accented English. Along with designed and controlled studies on 102 condition benchmark with speaker and corpus held out tests. Across 37 conditions, it reaches 0.914 mean macro-F1, 5.2 points above Gemini 3.5 Flash and ahead of 14 other systems. It is 24 points ahead of Gemini at one second, scores 0.897 on all 23 languages where no other system exceeds 0.713, and is calibrated to an ECE of 0.008. Reliable Indian LID still requires a robust, dedicated and calibrated model.

articles.title_zh: Anuvani-LID:印度语言的强壮和校准语言识别
articles.content_zh: 每一个多语种的语音管道都从语言决定开始, 在印度,它跨越了四个语言家庭的22种排期语言,在短、吵闹、窄带和密码混合的音频中听到。 基础语音模型越来越多地将语言识别(LID)作为一种内在的潜在和普遍能力。 语音模型中的自动递归解码器会发出一个特殊语言ID符号,具有音频能力的现代LLMS可以在被提示时命名语言. 我们用相同的剪辑测试这个假设,发现低语和类似语音模型只有23种语言中的15种有符号,在一秒输入双子座3.5 Flash达到0.52宏F1和GPT-audio0.14. 我们介绍Anuvani LID, 一种专用的115M参数LID符合模式, 连同102个条件基准的设计和有控制的研究,用扬声器和装置进行了测试。 在37个条件中,它达到了0.914平均值-F1,比双子座3.5 Flash高5.2分,领先其他14个系统. 在没有其他系统超过0.713的所有23种语言中,比双子座领先24分,得分0.897分,并被校准为0.08的ECE. 可靠的印度LID仍然需要一个坚固,专注和校准的模型.

articles.title: Repairing Speech Access After Text Updates with Frozen Affine Fields
articles.content: Speech-capable language models inherit most of their knowledge from text-rich language backbones, and continued model maintenance is likewise dominated by text updates. Knowledge acquired through a text update can nevertheless remain difficult to access when the same query is spoken. We formulate this mismatch as post-update speech access repair, where the knowledge-bearing checkpoint stays frozen and a detachable operator repairs speech-only access in one model pass. We introduce Affine Fields for Interface Repair across Modalities (AFFIRM), which first learns and freezes a base correction for speech hidden states, then adds query-specific corrections with zero mean over the operator-training queries. Paired speech and text states provide the coordinates that condition these corrections on each query. On balanced synthetic-speech PopQA, paired comparisons do not establish a clear advantage for AFFIRM over global SALSA steering or low-rank ReFT interventions under the same frozen single-state constraint. On recorded SLUE-SQA-5 questions with text passages, a full-scale PopQA-fitted AFFIRM operator transfers without refitting and improves ROUGE-L by 0.0941 over its paired No Repair baseline. Low-rank ReFT interventions also transfer positively, whereas the matched SALSA variant falls 0.0707 below its paired baseline. These results show that text acquisition and speech access can diverge after an update and should be verified and repaired separately.

articles.title_zh: 使用冰冻的 Affine 字段修复文本更新后的语音访问
articles.content_zh: 语音能力语言模型从丰富的文字语言骨干中继承大部分知识,持续的模型维护同样以文本更新为主. 然而,如果听到同样的查询,通过文本更新获得的知识仍然难以获取。 我们把这种不匹配发展成更新后的语音访问修复,即拥有知识的检查站仍然被冻结,以及一个模式的操作员只修复语音访问。 我们引入Affine Fields for Interface Reform over Everyways(AFFIRM),它首先学习并冻结语音隐藏状态的基础校正,然后在操作员培训查询上添加零平均值的查询特定校正. Paired 语音和文本状态提供坐标,以每个查询的更正为条件。 在平衡合成-声波PopQA上,配对比较并不能确定AFFIRM相对于全球SALSA方向或低级ReFT干预在相同的冷冻单态约束下的明显优势. 在有文字段落记录的SLUE-SQA-5问题上,一个全尺寸的PopQA适配的AFFIRM操作员在不进行调试的情况下,将ROUGE-L比其配对的无修基线改进0.0941. 低等级的ReFT干预也呈正向转移,而与之匹配的SALSA变体则低于其配对基线0.0707。 这些结果显示,文本获取和语音访问在更新后可能存在差异,应当单独核实和修复.

articles.title: Scaling Multilingual Mixture-of-Experts: How Language Coverage Changes Capacity and Compute Allocation
articles.content: Multilingual models share capacity across languages, so adding languages can hurt performance on existing ones. Mixture-of-experts models expand this capacity with little additional per-token computation. Given this extra capacity, does adding experts reduce what each additional language costs? To answer this question, we propose a repetition-aware joint scaling law relating number of active parameters, training tokens per language, number of experts, and language coverage. Fitted on 26,300 per-language loss observations from 64 pretrained configurations, our law reduces prediction error on held-out configurations by 28% relative to the strongest evaluated baseline. At matched number of active parameters and training tokens per language, 32 experts reduce the loss penalty of expanding from 12 to 200 languages by 83% compared with a dense model. Our law further shows that broader language coverage favors more experts across a wider range of compute budgets, guiding capacity allocation as multilingual models scale.

articles.title_zh: 扩大多种语言的专家混合:语言覆盖范围如何改变能力和计算分配
articles.content_zh: 多语种模式在语言之间分享能力,因此添加语言会伤害现有语言上的性能. 专家混合模型利用很少额外的每笔计算来扩大这种能力。 鉴于这种额外能力,增加专家是否减少了每种额外语文的费用? 为了回答这个问题,我们提议一项具有重复意识的联合扩展法,涉及有效参数的数目、每种语言的培训标志、专家人数和语言覆盖面。 根据64个预训配置的26 300个每语言损失观测数据,我们的法律将搁置配置的预测误差比最强的评价基线减少28%。 与密集模式相比,32名专家将12种语言扩展至200种语言的损失处罚降低了83%。 我们的法律进一步表明,更广泛的语言覆盖面有利于更多专家参与更广泛的计算预算,将能力分配作为多语种模式的规模。

articles.title: Scaling Multilingual Safety and Reasoning Evaluation through Reasoning-Guided Translation
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed across languages, yet their safety and reasoning capabilities remain predominantly evaluated in English. Translating existing benchmarks offers a scalable approach to multilingual evaluation, but preserving task-specific meaning across languages presents significant challenges, particularly for harmful requests, mathematical reasoning, and conversational interactions. We introduce a reasoning-guided translation framework for constructing multilingual evaluations designed to preserve the structure and intended meaning of diverse benchmark tasks. Our approach separates translation strategy selection from large-scale generation, combining reasoning-guided configuration selection with task-aware validation, targeted repair, and independent quality screening. Using this framework, we develop a source-aligned evaluation collection spanning seven safety, conversational, and mathematical reasoning resources across 11 languages. The resulting collection achieves 99.94\% coverage of intended item--language pairs in the two subsets requiring repair. Evaluations of open-source LLMs reveal distinct language-dependent vulnerabilities, including inconsistent refusal behaviour and substantial reasoning degradation in lower-resource languages. These findings highlight the importance of task-sensitive benchmark construction and systematic quality assessment for understanding multilingual model behaviour beyond English.

articles.title_zh: 通过合理指导翻译加强多种语文的安全和合理评价
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)越来越多地在各种语言之间部署,但其安全和推理能力仍然以英语为主。 将现有基准翻译为多语种评价提供了一个可扩展的方法,但保留不同语文具体任务的含义带来了重大挑战,特别是对有害的请求、数学推理和对话互动而言。 我们采用了一个推理指导翻译框架,用于构建多语种评价,旨在维护各种基准任务的结构和预期含义。 我们的方法将翻译策略选择与大规模生成区分开来,将推理引导配置选择与任务意识验证,定向修复,独立质量筛选相结合. 利用这个框架,我们开发出一套源相匹配的评价集,涵盖11种语言的7种安全性,对话性和数学推理资源. 由此而来的收集在两个需要修复的子集中实现了99.94%的预定项目语言对的覆盖. 对开放源代码有限责任管理的评价表明,存在不同的依赖语言的脆弱性,包括拒绝行为不一致,资源较少的语言推理严重退化。 这些调查结果突出表明,为了了解英语以外的多种语文模式行为,制定任务敏感基准和系统质量评估十分重要。

articles.title: What Makes a Social Agent's Interactions Effective? Learning from Verifiable Outcomes in Paired Worlds
articles.content: Effective social interaction requires more than fluent responses: agents must reach plans that fit the participants' needs and circumstances. Existing evaluations of social agents mainly rely on LLM judges that rate the conversation, without checking the resulting plan. We introduce HICO-Bench, a benchmark of 180 everyday coordination scenarios, such as resource allocation, scheduling, and authorization, in which two agents with private information converse and then independently record the plan they agreed on. A program checks Feasibility (the two records match and satisfy both participants' private conditions), and an LLM judge checks Integrity (the conversation supports the recorded plan); passing both is a Verified Success. Each scenario has two versions that share the same public context but differ in one private condition, so the correct plan differs between them. Across thirteen LLMs, 36% of conversations rated highly for goal completion fail Verified Success. To learn from outcomes that arrive only at the end of a conversation, we propose Paired-Credit Policy Optimization (PaCPO). After each turn, PaCPO asks the agent for a tentative plan, checks it in both versions of the scenario, and rewards the turns after which the tentative plans fit their respective versions. PaCPO raises Qwen3-8B's Verified Success from 20.4% to 28.3%.

articles.title_zh: 是什么让社会代理人的互动有效? 在Paired世界学习可核实的成果
articles.content_zh: 有效的社会互动需要的不仅仅是流利的反应:行为者必须制定符合参与者需求和情况的计划。 对社会代理人的现有评价主要依靠对谈话进行评分的LLM法官,而不检查由此产生的计划. 我们引入了HICO-Bench,这是180个日常协调方案的基准,如资源分配、时间安排和授权,其中两个有私人资料的代理人相互交替,然后独立记录他们同意的计划。 一个程序检查可行性(两个记录匹配并满足两个参与者的私人条件),一个LLM法官检查诚信(谈话支持记录的计划);通过这两个程序都是验证成功. 每个场景都有两种版本,相同公共背景,但在一个私人条件上有所不同,因此它们之间的正确计划不同. 在13个法学硕士中,36%的谈话被高评为目标完成不及格。 为了从对话结束时取得的成果中吸取教训,我们提议优化Paired-Credit政策。 每次转会后,PaCPO请代理商提出一个暂定计划,在两种版本的假想中检查,并奖励暂定计划符合各自版本的转会. PaCPO将Qune3-8B的验证成功率从20.4%提高到28.3%.

articles.title: When Occupation-derived Skills Don't Help: On the Limits of Skill-Augmented Career Path Prediction
articles.content: Skills are widely assumed to play a central role in career transitions, motivating their use in career path prediction (CPP) systems. In this work, we critically examine whether explicit skill representations provide complementary signal beyond text-based job representations. We evaluate multiple strategies for incorporating skills into CPP models, including score fusion and neural architectures, under two conditions: predicted skills and ground-truth ESCO annotations. Surprisingly, across two benchmark datasets, none of these settings yield substantial improvements over strong text-only baselines. Even when using ground-truth skills, gains remain marginal and inconsistent. Through detailed analysis, we identify key factors underlying this result: high redundancy between textual and skill representations, limited discriminative power of ESCO's taxonomy, and representational collapse in skill embeddings. Furthermore, we find that skill prediction difficulty correlates with overall sample difficulty, limiting the potential for complementary signals. Our findings challenge the common assumption that explicit skill modeling inherently benefits career prediction and suggest that dense text representations already capture most skill-relevant information.

articles.title_zh: 当职业技能无济于事时:技能提升的职业道路预测
articles.content_zh: 技能被广泛认为在职业过渡中发挥中心作用,促使其在职业路径预测系统中的使用。 在这项工作中,我们严格审查明确的技能表述是否提供了超越基于文本的工作表述的补充信号。 我们评价将技能纳入CPP模型的多种战略,包括分数聚变和神经结构,在两个条件下:预测技能和地面真实ESCO说明。 令人惊讶的是,在两个基准数据集中,没有任何一个设置比仅以文本为主的有力基线有重大改进。 即使在使用地面真实技能时,收益仍然微不足道和不一致。 通过详细分析,我们找出这一结果背后的关键因素:文字和技能表述之间的高度冗余,ESCO分类法的歧视性力量有限,以及技能嵌入中的代表性崩溃。 此外,我们发现技能预测困难与总体抽样困难有关,限制了补充信号的潜力。 我们的调查结果对共同的假设提出质疑,即明确的技能模型在本质上有利于职业预测,并表明密集的文字表述已经掌握了大多数与技能有关的信息。

articles.title: Cross-Model In-Context Neurofeedback Reveals (Limited) Activation Control in LLMs
articles.content: Probes on activation vectors are widely used to detect misbehavior in language models, but their success relies on the assumption that models cannot control what their activations encode. Humans can learn, through neurofeedback, to control the firing of even single neurons, and recent studies investigated whether this ability extends to language models, reaching conflicting conclusions. No experimental design so far disentangles competence at the task from genuine access to one's own activations. We fill this gap with in-context neurofeedback sessions, in which a "subject" model is asked to maximize (or minimize) a score derived from its activations, shown back to it at every turn. In our first experiment, the sentences are generated either by the subject or by a second "writer" model, while the score always derives from the activations of the subject. We test ten open-weight models from five families, with sizes from 9B to 32B. Some models move their own scores considerably, but no more than a writer of comparable competence moves them. Is this because the task requires no privileged access, or because the subject controls its activations while processing the sentences, whoever wrote them? To answer this, we prefill a fixed sentence as the subject's reply at every turn and ask it to increase or decrease the score. Three out of ten models show small but consistent control effects. We further ask whether models can control their activations to the point of fooling an activation monitor. We make models repeat sentences a monitor would flag, such as a deceptive answer for a deception monitor, and ask them to raise or lower the monitor's score. No model learns to lower it, but one model can raise it. In-context control of a model's own activations might not yet be a threat to activation monitors, but it exists in a few models and needs to be tracked as models evolve.

articles.title_zh: LLMs 中跨模式的神经元反馈(Limited)激活控制
articles.content_zh: 激活矢量上的探测器被广泛用于检测语言模型中的不当行为,但其成功依赖于模型无法控制其激活编码的假设. 人类可以通过神经feedback学习控制甚至单个神经元的发火,最近的研究调查这种能力是否延伸到语言模型,得出相互矛盾的结论. 至今为止还没有实验设计 将任务的能力 与真正进入自己激活的功能脱节 我们用内容内神经反馈会话来填补这个空白,其中要求一个"主体"模型从它的激活中得分最大化(或最小化),在每个转弯时都向它显示. 在我们的第一个实验中,句子要么由主体产生,要么由第二个"写手"模型产生,而分数总是来自于主体的激活. 我们从五个家庭测试10个开放重量模型,大小从9B到32B. 有些模型会大大地移动自己的分数,但不超过具有可比能力的作家会移动它们. 这是因为任务不需要特权进入,还是因为主体在处理句子时控制了它的激活,不管是谁写的? 为了回答这个问题,我们预先填满一个固定的句子,作为主体在每个回合的回答,并要求它增加或减少分数. 10个模型中有3个显示出小但一致的控制效果. 我们进一步询问模型是否能够控制它们的激活, 以欺骗激活监视器。 我们让模型重复一个显示器标记的句子,比如欺骗显示器的欺骗性回答,并要求它们提高或降低显示器的分数. 没有模型学会降低,但有一个模型可以提高. 对一个模型自身激活的内文本控制可能还不是对激活监视器的威胁,但它存在于少数模型中,需要随着模型的演化而跟踪.

articles.title: TreeSpark: Learning to Draft the Trees You Verify for Speculative Decoding
articles.content: Parallel drafters such as DFlash and DSpark reduce proposal latency, but early mismatches limit how much of each block can be accepted. Retaining alternatives introduces parent states and candidate choices that reference-conditioned training does not directly supervise. We introduce TreeSpark, a unified training and inference framework extending the semi-autoregressive DSpark architecture. It constructs parent-conditioned candidate trees from one backbone pass and replays their expansion, pruning, and budgeted packing during training. Survival negative log-likelihood weights retained edges by reference-derived path mass, while a capped coverage hinge promotes target-important alternatives near local selection boundaries. Both objectives reuse reference-chain target distributions without additional target forward passes. We evaluate greedy decoding with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B on nine general benchmarks and six writing domains. Across targets and suites, TreeSpark improves mean acceptance length over DSpark by 23.4% to 31.6% and mean single-request throughput by 15.1% to 25.0%. Batched Qwen3-4B throughput improves by 12.6% to 17.2%. At fixed attention capacity and inference policy, the proposed supervision further improves mean acceptance length by approximately 6.4% and mean system throughput by 4.2% to 5.0% on Qwen3-4B.

articles.title_zh: TreeSpark: 学习起草您校验的树谱解码
articles.content_zh: DFlash和DSpark等并行的起草者减少了提案的延迟性,但早期的不匹配限制了每个块可以接受多少. 保留替代方案将引入母体国家和候选人的选择,而参照条件的培训并不直接监督。 我们引入了 TreeSpark,一个统一的培训和推论框架,扩展了半自动的DSpark架构. 它从一个主干证上搭建有父母条件的候选树,并在训练期间重新播放其扩展、刷新和预算包装。 存活负对数的负负重通过参考来源路径质量保留边缘,而封面覆盖则在局部选择边界附近促进目标重要替代品。 这两项目标都重复使用参考链目标分布,没有额外的目标前行通行证。 我们评价贪婪的解码与Quen3-4B和Quen3-8B在9个一般基准和6个写字域. 在整个目标和套房中,TreatySpark的接收长度比DSpark提高了23.4%至31.6%,平均单项请求吞吐量提高了15.1%至25.0%。 抽取Qwen3-4B吞吐量提高12.6%至17.2%. 在固定注意力能力和推论政策方面,拟议的监督进一步提高了平均接受时间长度约6.4%,在Qune3-4B上的平均系统吞吐量为4.2%至5.0%。

articles.title: RM-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Generative Reward Models
articles.content: Reinforcement Learning on Mixed-domain preference data (Mix-RL) has become the mainstream approach for training general-purpose Generative Reward Models (GRMs). However, Mix-RL suffers from two critical bottlenecks: the reward sparsity induced by outcome rewards, and the cross-domain interference arising from jointly optimizing heterogeneous capabilities, which together give rise to imbalanced capability acquisition and pervasive reward hacking. Inspired by the success of On-Policy Distillation (OPD) in multi-domain capability integration, we introduce RM-OPD (Reward Modeling via On-Policy Distillation), a two-stage framework that separates specialist acquisition from capability integration. First, we cultivate domain-specialized teacher models via single-domain GRPO fine-tuning, allowing each expert to reach its performance ceiling in isolation; then we consolidate these teachers into one student model through (i) routed on-policy distillation, which provides dense signed token-level supervision on student-generated critiques; (ii) domain contribution reweighting, which reweights token guidance toward target domain shares, preventing specific domains from dominating optimization; and (iii) optional criteria context distillation, which conditions teachers on domain-specific evaluation criteria to sharpen token-level supervision. Across multiple RM benchmarks and two base models, RM-OPD consistently outperforms vanilla Mix-RL and other strong baselines, achieving overall superior performance and exhibiting an emergent "teacher-surpassing" effect. These results establish RM-OPD as a promising paradigm for building generalist GRMs.

articles.title_zh: RM-OPD: Generative Reward 模式的政策扭曲
articles.content_zh: 加强关于混合领域偏好数据的学习已成为培训通用基因奖励模型的主流方法。 然而,Mix-RL受到两个关键瓶颈的影响:结果奖励导致的奖励抽筋,以及联合优化各种能力产生的跨领域干扰,这些共同导致能力获取不平衡和普遍奖励黑客。 在 " 政策消化 " (OPD)在多领域能力整合中的成功激励下,我们引入了RM-OPD(通过 " 政策消化 " (On-Policy消化)的奖励模型),这是一个将专家获取与能力整合分开的两阶段框架。 首先,我们通过单一域域名GPRO微调培育域名专用教师模式,使每位专家能够单独达到其绩效上限;然后,我们通过(一) 政策分层方法将这些教师整合为一个学生模式,为学生产生的批评提供密集的签名符号级监督;(二) 域名贡献重新加权,为目标域份额重新加权标志性指导,防止特定域占优势;以及(三) 可选标准背景分层方法,为教师提供特定域评价标准的条件,以强化符号级监督。 通过多个RM基准和两个基本模型,RM-OPD一贯优于香草Mix-RL和其他强基线,取得了总体优异的性能,并展现出一种新兴的"教师-通过"效应. 这些成果将RM-OPD确立为建立通用GRM的有希望的范例.

articles.title: MultiPartyTurnBench: Benchmarking Floor Control in Multi-Party Spoken Dialogue
articles.content: Full-duplex speech systems must decide when to enter, hold, or relinquish the conversational floor, even as multiple speakers overlap or backchannel without taking it. Existing evaluations study dyadic turn-taking or end-to-end agent behavior, but lack a unified, controlled evaluation of genuine floor transitions against confusable non-events in multi-party settings. We introduce MultiPartyTurnBench (MPTB), a benchmark of 240 synthetically generated, channel-separated conversations spanning two to five speakers and six interaction types. MPTB evaluates two complementary tasks: End-of-Turn (EOT) detection distinguishes genuine turn completion from temporary holds, while Interruption (INT) detection distinguishes successful floor takeovers from non-floor-taking speech. Exact event-conditioned annotations enable causal evaluation using false-positive-constrained recall and signed latency. Across acoustic, semantic, and turn-projection baselines, we find a stark asymmetry: learned systems achieve 82.5-92.6% EOT recall at 4.3-11.8% false-positive rates, while INT detection suffers from missed takeovers or excessive false activations. This asymmetry extends to five full-duplex agents which achieve 86.1-95.8% balanced accuracy on turn entry, yet perform near chance (46.9-54.7%) on selective interruption handling. Gemini-3.8-Live yields to 97.7% of backchannels, whereas MiniCPM-o-4.5 yields to only 1.4% of genuine interruptions. These findings establish selective floor control as a distinct, unresolved challenge for reliable multi-party voice interaction.

articles.title_zh: 多党本希:多党言论对话基准底线控制
articles.content_zh: 完全繁复的语音系统必须决定何时进入,持有,或放弃对话层,即使多个演讲者重叠或反通道而不接听. 现有评价研究dyadic转录或端到端代理行为,但缺乏针对多党环境下的不相容非事件,对真正底层过渡的统一,有控制的评价. 我们引入了多方Turn Bench(MPTB),这是240个合成、频道隔开的对话的基准,涉及两到五个发言者和六种互动类型。 MPTB评价两个互补的任务: 最终(EOT)检测区分真转完成与临时搁置,而中断(INT)检测则区分成功地层接管与非地层占用演讲. 精确的事件附加说明允许使用假阳性限制的召回和签名的暂时性进行因果关系评估。 纵观声学、语义学和转弯投影基线,我们发现一个明显的不对称现象:所学的系统以4.3-11.8 %的假阳性率实现了82.5-92.6%的EOT召回率,而INT检测则受到丢失接管或过度的假激活的影响。 这种不对称现象延伸到五个完全复方剂,在转录时达到86.1%至95.8%的平衡精度,但在选择性中断处理时却几乎偶然(46.9至54.7%)。 双子座-3.8-寿命的产率为97.7%,而微型CPM-o-4.5的产率为1.4%。 这些调查结果确定了有选择的底线控制,作为可靠多党派声音互动的独特、未解决的挑战。

articles.title: Gap Detection: Mitigating Homogenization through Demand and Defensibility
articles.content: Language models often produce semantically similar answers to open-ended questions, even when many plausible alternatives exist. Generating useful alternatives requires identifying both what the query calls for and what existing responses already cover. We introduce Gap Detection, a framework that searches for relevant but unoccupied directions in a shared text embedding space. Its objective, GapScore, combines query relevance (Demand) with dissimilarity to the nearest existing item (Defensibility). The framework optimizes this product on the unit sphere, maps candidate directions to concept words with a language model, and uses task-specific filtering and constrained prompting to turn those concepts into text. On five curated topics and 90 INFINITY-CHAT queries, the reported mean relative reductions in output Collision are 12.8% and 10.8%, respectively. We also instantiate the framework for generative engine optimization over four product markets and for iterative synthetic-data augmentation. In the latter setting, with 100 training examples per method, Gap Detection reduces Collision from 0.324 to 0.298 relative to undirected accumulation and increases the Vendi Score from 27.16 to 29.20; the accuracy difference is one example on a 40-example test set. Component ablations expose the trade-off between semantic separation and relevance, while also showing that better direction scores do not uniformly yield better downstream metrics. These results support explicit gap search as a practical mechanism for diversifying content, with task validity checked separately from geometric novelty.

articles.title_zh: 差距检测 : 通过需求和防御减缓同源化
articles.content_zh: 语言模型往往对开放式问题产生极为相似的答案,即使存在许多可行的替代办法。 产生有用的替代方法需要既确定查询要求什么,也确定现有答复已经涵盖哪些内容。 我们引入了漏洞检测,这个框架在共享文本嵌入空间中搜索相关但未使用的方向. 其目标GapScore将查询关联性(Demand)与距离最近的现有项目(defensibility)的异构性结合起来. 框架在单位域上优化了这个产品,用语言模型绘制了概念词的候选方向,并使用特定任务过滤和受约束的提示来将这些概念转化为文字. 关于5个归口专题和90个INFINITY-CHAT查询,所报告的产出碰撞的平均相对减少率分别为12.8%和10.8%。 我们还对四个产品市场进行基因引擎优化和迭代合成数据增强框架进行即时分析。 在后一种情况下,每方法100个培训实例,差距探测将碰撞从0.324降至0.298,并将Vendi分数从27.16增至29.20;准确性差是40个实例测试集的一个实例。 构成部分的叠加暴露了语义分离与相关性之间的权衡,同时也表明,更好的方向分数不能统一产生更好的下游指标。 这些结果支持明确寻找差距,作为内容多样化的实际机制,任务有效性与几何新颖性分开检查。

articles.title: LLM-Based Policy Compliance Verification of Loan Applications
articles.content:
Banks rely on extensive internal policy frameworks to ensure that corporate lending decisions comply with regulatory requirements and internal risk standards. Reviewing loan applications against these policies is a largely manual and knowledge-intensive process, which can lead to overlooked policy violations or exceptions. This report presents a prototype of an LLM-based policy checker that automatically verifies loan applications against internal lending policies.
  The proposed approach follows a two-step architecture. First, compliance-relevant rules are automatically extracted from policy documents and converted into structured, machine-readable representations. Second, loan applications are evaluated against the extracted rules to identify policy exceptions, non-compliant findings, missing information, and cases requiring manual review.
  Evaluation results demonstrate that the rule extraction process is highly stable across multiple runs and consistently captures rules identified as critical by a domain expert. When evaluated on 11 real loan applications with known policy exceptions, the system successfully detected the majority of these exceptions and identified additional compliance issues that had previously been overlooked during manual reviews. While the approach produces false positives and cannot fully replace human judgement, the results indicate that LLM-based policy compliance verification can provide valuable support in the loan application verification process by highlighting potential compliance risks.

articles.title_zh: LLM 贷款申请的政策遵守情况核查
articles.content_zh:
银行依靠广泛的内部政策框架确保公司贷款决定符合监管要求和内部风险标准。 根据这些政策审查贷款申请在很大程度上是一个人工和知识密集型的过程,可能导致忽视的政策违反或例外。 本报告提供了一个基于LLM的政策检查器的原型,自动对照内部借贷政策核实贷款申请。
拟议办法采用两步结构。 首先,与遵守有关的规则自动从政策文件中提取,并转化为结构化的、机器可读的表述。 第二,根据抽取的规则对贷款申请进行评估,以确定政策例外、不符合规定的调查结果、缺少资料以及需要人工审查的案件。
评价结果表明,规则提取过程在多个运行中高度稳定,并始终如一地捕捉到域专家确定为关键的规则。 在对11个实际贷款申请(已知政策例外)进行评价时,该系统成功地发现了大多数例外,并查明了以前在人工审查中被忽视的其他合规问题。 虽然这种方法会产生虚假的阳性,不能完全取代人的判断,但结果表明,基于LLM的政策合规性核查可以通过突出潜在的合规风险,为贷款申请核查进程提供宝贵的支持.

articles.title: Sparse Autoencoders for Mechanistic Interpretability in NLP: A Critical Survey of Recoverability, Interpretability, and Utility
articles.content: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have emerged as a promising approach to mechanistic interpretability by decomposing language-model activations into sparse, potentially interpretable features. However, differences in design assumptions, evaluation objectives, and experimental settings complicate conclusions about their effectiveness. We present a critical survey of 138 studies on SAEs in natural language processing. Our contributions are fourfold: (1) we propose a task-grounded taxonomy connecting dictionary design, feature operations, and NLP functions; (2) we examine how sparsity allocation, geometry, data coverage, and inference affect feature recoverability; (3) we assess evidence for semantic interpretability, mechanistic faithfulness, and behavioral utility; and (4) we synthesize findings across multilingual processing, retrieval, reasoning, classification, and behavioral regulation, highlighting the roles of objectives, baselines, supervision, and intervention pipelines. Through comparative analyses of published results, we reconcile apparent disagreements, identify unresolved questions, and propose directions for more rigorous evaluation. An anonymous research register https://anonymous.4open.science/r/sae-research-register-C331/register.html accompanies the survey.

articles.title_zh: NLP中机械解释的Sparse自动编码器:可回收性、可解释性和实用性的关键调查
articles.content_zh: Sparse 自动编码器(SAEs)已作为一种有希望的方法出现,通过将语言模型激活分解为稀少的、有可能被解释的特性来进行机械解释。 然而,在设计假设、评价目标和实验环境上的差异使其有效性的结论复杂化。 我们提出了对138项自然语言处理中SAE的研究的重要调查。 我们的贡献有四重:(1) 我们提出一个任务分类法,将字典设计,特征操作,和NLP功能联系起来;(2) 我们研究sparsity分配,几何学,数据覆盖,以及推论如何影响特征可恢复性;(3) 我们评估语义解释性,机械忠诚度,行为实用性的证据;(4) 我们综合了跨多语种处理,检索,推理,分类,行为调控的发现,突出了目标,基线,监督和干预管道的作用. 通过对已公布结果的比较分析,我们调和了明显的分歧,确定了尚未解决的问题,并提出了更严格的评估方向。 匿名研究登记册 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/sae-research-register-C331/register.html 随调查.

articles.title: Why Generate a Click? Plug-in Decision Heads for Web Agents
articles.content: Web agents built on vision language models decide every action by generating text such as click(12), although most of that text encodes a choice among a few action types and a few dozen marked elements. We read these choices directly from the hidden states that the generator computes while it reads the goal and the screenshot. Plug-in decision heads on a frozen generator predict the action type, pool the visual tokens inside each numbered box to pick the target, and point at a listed text option or at a WRITE slot that leaves the writing of new text to the generator. A confidence cascade executes the heads' action when they are sure and otherwise lets the generator decode from the KV cache of the same forward pass. With Qwen3-VL 4B and 8B generators trained on 213k web steps, a strict threshold keeps the cascade between 0.3 points below and 1.4 points above the generator on seven offline test sets while the heads decide 12 to 64% of the steps. A looser threshold raises step success on unseen Mind2Web websites by 3.1 and 1.8 points, costs up to 2 points on GUIAct and MiniWoB++, and lifts WebArena task success from 12.5 to 13.8% (4B) and from 13.6 to 14.6% (8B) with less than half of the generated tokens. Training the heads jointly with the generator lowers the generator's own step success by up to 4.9 points; heads on a frozen generator avoid this cost.

articles.title_zh: 为什么产生点击 ? 网络代理的插件决定头
articles.content_zh: 建立在视觉语言模型之上的Web代理通过生成点击(12)等文本来决定每个动作,尽管该文本的大部分编码是在少数动作类型和几十个标记元素中选择的. 我们直接从隐藏的状态读取这些选择, 即生成器在读取目标与截图时计算。 在冷冻的生成器上插入决策头来预测动作类型,将每个编号框内的视觉符号集合起来来选择目标,并指向列出的文本选项或WRITE槽,将新文本的写法留给生成器. 信任级联在头部确定时执行动作,否则让生成器从同一前传的 KV 缓存中解码. 由于Qune3-VL 4B和8B发电机在213k网络台阶上接受训练,一个严格的阈值使得级联在7个离线测试集上保持在0.3点到1.4点之间,而头部则决定12-64%的台阶. 更松散的门槛让未见的Mind2Web网站的步数成功3.1和1.8分,在GUIAct和MiniWoB++上成本高达2分,并将WebArena任务成功率从12.5%提高到13.8%(4B),从13.6%提高到14.6%(8B),生成的令牌不到一半. 与发电机联合训练头部,使发电机本身的步法成功率降低多达4.9分;冷冻发电机上的头部避免了这一成本.

articles.title: Language Exposure Matters: Distribution and Order in Multilingual BabyLM Pre-training
articles.content: We investigate two aspects of multilingual pre-training with limited data, namely how language exposure is distributed across English, Dutch, and Chinese, and how that exposure is ordered during training. In particular, we compare balanced multilingual exposure to language-dominant exposure, where one language is exposed with more training data than the others. We also compare mixed training, where multilingual training data is used throughout training, with curriculum training, where monolingual exposure of the dominant language is followed by balanced multilingual exposure. Our results show that multilingual BabyLM performance varies with both the amount and order of language exposure. Mixed training outperforms curriculum learning across all 15 matched configurations, indicating that simultaneous multilingual exposure is more effective than staged exposure in our setting. Several language-dominant mixed training configurations achieve higher scores than the balanced configuration, suggesting that a balanced distribution is not necessarily the highest-performing configuration in our setting. Interestingly, the Dutch-primary configurations achieve the best overall performance.

articles.title_zh: 语言接触事项:多语言婴儿LM的分布和顺序 培训前
articles.content_zh: 我们以有限的数据调查了多语种预训的两个方面,即语言接触如何在英语、荷兰语和汉语之间分布,以及在培训期间如何下令进行。 特别是,我们比较了多种语文均衡接触主要语言的情况,其中一种语言接触的培训数据多于其他语言。 我们还将混合培训与课程培训进行比较,在混合培训中,多语种培训数据在整个培训过程中都得到使用,在单一语言接触主语后,将均衡地接触多语种。 我们的结果显示,多种语言的婴儿LM性能随语言接触的大小和顺序而不同。 混合培训超越了所有15个匹配配置的课程学习,表明同时进行多语种接触比我们环境中的分阶段接触更有效。 几种语言主导混合训练组合的分数高于平衡组合,这表明均衡分布不一定是我们设定中表现最高的组合. 有趣的是,荷兰-初级组合取得了最佳的整体表现.

articles.title: AFCS: Atomic-Fact-Conditioned Synthesis for Factual Knowledge Pretraining
articles.content: Synthetic data is increasingly used in language-model pretraining. Existing knowledge-corpus synthesis pipelines, including WRAP and Nemotron-CC, usually take a source passage or document segment as input and generate rewritten or QA-style samples from that text. This can improve surface form and prompt diversity, but it does not explicitly require fine-grained source facts -- especially secondary entities, list/table entries, and precise temporal attributes -- to appear in the synthesized corpus. We propose AFCS (Atomic-Fact-Conditioned Synthesis), a pipeline that first extracts source-supported atomic facts and then uses each retained fact to drive generation. AFCS uses structure-aware extraction over the document tree, source-grounded verification, local context expansion, and multi-format generation. In continued-pretraining experiments with OLMo-3-7B and a 32B base on the same FineWiki source corpus, AFCS outperforms WRAP and Nemotron-CC on SimpleQA, SimpleQA Verified, PopQA, and HotpotQA. Granularity ablations show that fact-level synthesis improves over chunk-level, paragraph-level, and entity-level synthesis; and a 100B-token mid-training integration improves factual benchmarks and raises the 12-task general benchmark average by +1.09.

articles.title_zh: 化安论坛:关于事实知识的原子条件综合预训
articles.content_zh: 合成数据越来越多地用于语言模型预训. 现有的知识公司合成管道,包括WRAP和Nemotron-CC,通常采用源通道或文件段作为输入,并从该文本中生成重写或QA式样品. 这可以改善表面形态和迅速的多样性,但它没有明确要求在综合体中出现精细的源事实 -- -- 特别是二级实体、列表/表格条目和准确的时间属性。 我们提出AFCS(原子-事实-条件合成),这个管道首先提取源支持的原子事实,然后利用每个保留的事实驱动生成. 亚化安论坛在文件树上采用结构感知提取,源头验证,局部环境扩展,多格式生成. 在与OLMo-3-7B和基于同一FineWiki源体的32B的继续预训实验中,AFCS在SimpleQA,SimpleQA验证,PopQA,和HotototQA上的表现优于WRAP和Nemotron-CC. 外观分解表明,事实层次的合成在块级、段级和实体层次的合成上有所改进;100B-token中级培训集成改进了事实基准,将12项任务的一般基准平均数提高了1.09。

articles.title: Designing Textual Interfaces To Enhance Llm Reasoning On Audio-Visual Question Answering
articles.content: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) has shown strong effectiveness for text-based LLMs and LLM systems, but its application to audio-visual understanding systems requires suitable textual interfaces through which multimodal reasoning can be exposed to text-based optimizers. We investigate how the design of textual interfaces affects prompt optimization for multimodal reasoning, on the audio-visual question answering task. We compare three interface designs, including a direct inference system consisting of a single omni-modal large language model (OmniLLM), a captioner-reasoner system, and an agentic architecture in which a primary agent orchestrates subagent OmniLLMs. Experiments with Qwen3-Omni and Gemini show that direct prompt optimization provides model-dependent gains; the captioner-reasoner system and the agentic system expose more interpretable optimization interfaces but are harder to optimize, where error analysis of cases affected by optimization is conducted. Our study highlights textual interface design as an important factor in making prompt optimization effective for omni-modal reasoning systems. Our implementation details are specified in GitHub repo.

articles.title_zh: 设计文字界面,以加强视听问答中的逻辑理由
articles.content_zh: 自动即时优化(APO)对基于文本的LLMs和LLM系统表现出强大的效果,但其在视听理解系统的应用需要合适的文本界面,通过这些界面,多式联运推理可以接触到基于文本的优化器. 我们调查文字界面的设计如何影响迅速优化多式联运推理,即视听问答任务。 我们比较了三种界面设计,包括一个直接推论系统,包括一个单一的OMni-模式大型语言模型(OmniLM),一个标题解释器系统,以及一个代理架构,其中主要代理人管弦OmniLLMs子代理. 与Qune3-Omni和双子座的实验显示,直接的即时优化提供了模型依赖的增益;字幕-推理系统和代理系统暴露出更可解释的优化界面,但更难优化,其中对受优化影响的案例进行错误分析. 我们的研究突出强调了文本界面设计是使全模式推理系统能够迅速优化的重要因素。 GitHub Repo详细介绍了我们的执行情况。

articles.title: Which Knowledge Should LLMs Trust? Uncovering a Generalizable Steering Direction Across Knowledge Conflicts
articles.content: Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently encounter conflicts between internal parametric knowledge and external contextual knowledge, yet the mechanisms governing this selection remain unclear. We show that the choice between context and parametric knowledge is linearly represented and can be controlled along a single direction in the model's residual stream. We first demonstrate that this direction generalizes across factual-conflict settings, including context formats, knowledge categories, and datasets, while consistently shifting behavior between parametric and contextual answers. We then transfer a direction learned from simple factual conflicts to three more complex task families: RAG, memory, and rule following, where models must acquire information from retrieved documents, interaction histories, or explicit rules. Across four model families and multiple transfer settings, steering consistently improves the use of prompt-provided information over the unsteered model. These results suggest that the direction captures a transferable preference for external knowledge rather than a mechanism specific to factual conflicts.

articles.title_zh: 哪些知识应该由LLMS信任? 无法涵盖知识冲突的总体方向
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)经常遇到内部参数化知识和外部背景知识之间的冲突,但指导这一选择的机制仍然不明确. 我们显示,上下文和参数化知识之间的选择是线性的,可以沿着模型剩余流的单个方向进行控制. 我们首先表明,这一方向概括了各种事实冲突背景,包括背景格式、知识类别和数据集,同时在参数和背景答案之间不断改变行为。 然后,我们将从简单的事实冲突中吸取的教训转移到三个更复杂的任务领域:RAG、内存和遵循的规则,其中模型必须从检索的文件、互动历史或明确规则中获取信息。 在4个模范家庭和多个转诊设置中,指导不断改进对快速提供信息的使用,而不是未经测试的模型。 这些结果表明,这一方向反映的是外部知识的可转移偏好,而不是针对实际冲突的一种机制。

articles.title: What Is a Clarification? Estimating Model-Dependent Input Ambiguity
articles.content: Ambiguous inputs can admit multiple interpretations, each potentially yielding a different answer. Existing work largely treats this ambiguity as a property of the input, yet for a particular language model, only some alternatives may be known and answerable. We therefore distinguish world ambiguity, capturing all alternatives admitted by an input, from model ambiguity, capturing those accessible to the responding model. To characterize these alternatives, we formalize natural-language clarifications through three desiderata: \emph{uniqueness}, \emph{faithfulness}, and \emph{answer equivalence}. We show that these desiderata induce a one-to-one correspondence between valid answers and equivalence classes of clarifications, implying that any interpretation can be represented either by its answer or by the clarifications that uniquely express it. We leverage this correspondence to introduce \circleclar{}, a black-box method that estimates the set of answers available to a model by checking consistency along an answer--clarification--answer cycle. Across open-domain QA and executable Text-to-SQL, \circleclar{} achieves strong recovery of these answer sets. In QA, the recovered support yields the strongest overall performance in model-dependent ambiguity detection and enables effective selection among answering, clarifying, and abstaining. Together, these results demonstrate the practical value of a model-dependent view of ambiguity and its characterization through an answer-clarification correspondence.

articles.title_zh: 什么是澄清? 估计模型- 依赖性输入
articles.content_zh: 含糊不清的投入可以接受多种解释,每一种都可能产生不同的答案。 现有工作基本上将这种模糊性视为输入的属性,然而对于某一语言模型来说,可能只有一些替代办法可以知道和回答。 因此,我们把世界的模糊性区分开来,把投入所接受的所有替代物与模型的模糊性区分开来,把反应模型所了解的替代物区分开来。 为了描述这些替代品,我们将自然语言的澄清正式化,通过三个desiderata:\emph{unique}、\emph{finity}和\emph{answerquality}。 我们表明,这些 " desiderata " 导致有效答复与等同澄清之间的一对一对应,意味着任何解释都可以通过其答复或独特的说明加以体现。 我们利用这些函文引入\circleclar{},一种黑盒方法,通过在答案-澄清-答案周期中检查一致性来估计模型可用的一组答案. 横跨开放域的QA和可执行的文本对SQL,\circleclar{} 实现这些答案集的强烈恢复. 在质量保证中,恢复的支持在模型依赖的模糊度检测中产生最强的整体性能,并能在回答、澄清和弃权中进行有效的选择。 这些结果共同显示了以模型为依据的模糊性观点及其通过解答-澄清函证的定性的实际价值。

articles.title: FACES: Fine-grained Gated Semantic Alignment for Multimodal Emotional Support Conversation
articles.content: In recent years, with advances in multimodal interaction technologies and the growing demand for intelligent emotional support, Multimodal Emotional Support Conversation (MESC) has emerged as an important task. However, existing systems still suffer from shallow responses and inappropriate support strategies due to weak semantic feedback, cross-dimension reward compensation, and coarse reasoning supervision. To address these challenges, we propose FACES, a fine-grained gated semantic alignment framework for MESC. Specifically, FACES integrates multi-source rewards to construct multidimensional semantic and functional alignment signals, employs a non-compensatory gated fusion mechanism to reduce cross-dimension reward offset, and leverages structured Chain-of-Thought (CoT) anchors to perform token-level credit assignment. Under a controlled response-length protocol, FACES improves the average MLLM-based evaluation score from 3.61 to 4.04 and achieves an 80.22% pairwise win rate over SOTA. Human evaluation under the same protocol yields a 75.3% preference rate. Results on three external datasets further support transferability. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/OCT-ARR/arr.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FACES: 多式情感支持对话精细语义协调
articles.content_zh: 近年来,随着多模式互动技术的进步以及对智能情感支持的需求不断增长,多模式情感支持对话已成为一项重要任务。 然而,由于语义反馈薄弱,交叉分配奖励补偿,以及粗糙的推理监督,现有的系统仍然受到浅答和不适当的支持策略的影响. 为了应付这些挑战,我们提议设立FACES,作为MESC精细的门式语义协调框架。 具体地说,FACES整合了多源奖励,以构建多语义和功能对齐信号,采用非补偿性门式聚变机制以减少交叉分配奖励抵消,并利用结构化的Cain-of-Thought(CoT)主播来完成象征级信用任务. 根据可控响应长度协议,FACES将基于MLLM的平均值评价分数从3.61提高到4.04,并实现80.22%的双向胜率高于SOTA. 根据同一协议进行的人类评价的优惠率为75.3%。 三个外部数据集的结果进一步支持了可转移性。 数据集见https://github.com/OCT-ARR/arr。

articles.title: LintEval: Benchmarking LLMs on Linter-Guided File Refactoring
articles.content: Linters are widely used in code maintenance and real-time IDE editing to surface lint alerts related to performance, style, error-prone, and other patterns in source files. However, existing code benchmarks do not explicitly evaluate linter-guided file refactoring, where models must reduce lint alerts in source files with correct initial functionality while satisfying functionality preservation. We introduce LintEval, a multilingual benchmark for linter-guided file refactoring across C++, Python, and Java, comprising 13,061 programs with correct initial functionality and 171,662 lint alerts extracted using language-specific linters. LintEval jointly evaluates functionality preservation, lint alert reduction, new alert avoidance, and edit minimality. Experiments reveal a persistent trade-off: closed-source commercial models reach up to 90.4% Reduction@P but achieve only 67.1%-68.3% Pass@1, while several open-source small models show low or negative Reduction@P. A controlled fine-tuning study further shows that supervision format matters: refactoring-oriented SFT raises Qwen2.5-Coder-7B Reduction@P from 24.7% to 76.0%. LintEval enables controlled evaluation of models that improve source files under functionality preservation.

articles.title_zh: LintEval: 指导性文件重构的基准 LLMs
articles.content_zh: Linters在代码维护和实时IDE编辑中被广泛用于与性能,风格,容易出错相关的表面lint提醒,以及源文件中的其他模式. 然而,现有的代码基准没有明确评价l-inter-guided文件重构,其中模型必须减少源文件中的lint提示,同时满足功能保存. 我们引入了LintEval,一个跨C++,Python,和Java的linter-guided文件重构的多语言基准,由13,061个程序组成,具有正确的初始功能,以及171,662 lint提醒使用特定语言的linters提取. LintEval联合评价功能保存,lint提醒减少,新的提醒避免,编辑最小化. 实验揭示了持久的权衡:封闭源码商业模型达到90.4%的减少量@ P但仅实现67.1%-68.3%的Pass@1,而多个开源小模型显示低或负还原@P. 一项有控制的微调研究进一步表明,监督格式很重要:重构面向SFT的SFT将Quen2.5-Coder-7B的降幅从24.7%提高到76.0%. LintEval 可以在功能保存下对改进源文件的模型进行有控制的评价.

articles.title: A Strong Harness Narrows the Model Gap: A Comparative Evaluation for Legislative Document-to-XML Conversion
articles.content: Legal-content reproduction requires matching the source exactly in section hierarchy, verbatim text, citations, and amendment spans; a dropped citation or mislabeled amendment carries into the products lawyers rely on. We report an industrial pipeline converting U.S. state legislation into strict, schema-constrained XML, and hypothesize that its accuracy comes from harness engineering, the deterministic tooling built around a model, more than the model itself. Our controlled ablation crosses three harnesses (zero-shot, a single tool-using agent, and a decomposed multi-agent pipeline) with three Claude models on 153 gold bills from two jurisdictions. The harness narrows the model gap: the weakest model in the full pipeline beats the strongest model alone (0.948 versus 0.806, paired bootstrap p less than 0.001). Because the two agentic harnesses share identical tools, their gap comes from orchestration: decomposition plus the persisted state and per-agent context it brings. Across four scored dimensions, the model spread at zero-shot (0.68 to 0.81) narrows to 0.95 at the full pipeline; the residual sits almost entirely in citation normalization, where the canonical identifier is retrieved from an external authority rather than generated from the weights, so a deterministic lookup tool supplies the exactness that a larger model does not.

articles.title_zh: 强大的优势 缩小模式差距:立法文件到XML的比较评价 改划
articles.content_zh: 法律内容的复制要求将来源精确地按照节级、逐字记录、引文和修正的跨度加以匹配;律师所依赖的产品中附带的引文或标签错误的修正。 我们报告一条工业管道 将美国州立法转换成严格的, 受计划约束的XML, 并假设它的准确性来自 利用工程, 决定性的工具 围绕一个模型, 超过模型本身。 我们的受控喷发横跨了三条绳索(零射线,一个单一的工具使用剂,以及一个分解的多剂管道),在两个管辖区153个金币上有三个克劳德模型. 牵引装置缩小了模型间隙:整个输油管中最弱的模型仅比最强的模型(0.948对0.806,配对的靴子圈p小于0.001). 由于两支代理吊带共用相同的工具,它们的空白来自于管弦:分解加它带来的持续状态和每代理上下文. 在四个得分的维度上,模型以零射法(0.68至0.81)在全管上传播到0.95;剩余部分几乎完全坐落在引号正常化中,从外部权威处获取犬科识别剂而不是从权重中生成,所以一个定型的望镜工具提供了更大的模型所没有的准确性.

articles.title: Gray-Box Hallucination Detection in LLMs with Token Identities
articles.content:
Large language models often produce fluent but factually incorrect output. Gray-box detectors identify such hallucinations from the token-probability statistics emitted during generation, avoiding the need for white-box access to hidden states that frontier models do not provide. These detectors, however, typically rely only on probability-derived representations and ignore the identities of the candidate tokens. They can therefore observe how uncertain the model is, but not what it is uncertain about. Consequently, they cannot distinguish between a model that is torn between "big" and "small" and one that is torn between "big" and "huge" when the two pairs receive the same probability distribution.
  We introduce GURI (Gray-box Uncertainty Representations with Identity), a lightweight gray-box hallucination detector that combines candidate-token probabilities with per-token vector identifiers. This exposes which alternatives the model considered while preserving the accessibility and transferability of the gray-box setting. Across three open-weight models and three question-answering benchmarks, GURI increases mean test ROC-AUC from 72.09% to 79.09% over a probability-only baseline. On the closed-source GPT-4.1 model, mean ROC-AUC increases from 67.39% to 71.84%. Among the three open-weight models, GURI outperforms transferred probability-only baseline in 17 of 18 directed cross-model transfers without fine-tuning. For the three open-weight models, cross-dataset transfer between HotpotQA and TriviaQA with the model held fixed improves mean ROC-AUC over transferred LOS-Net by 3.76 points.

articles.title_zh: 带有托肯特征的 LLMS 中灰- 盒幻觉检测
articles.content_zh:
大型语言模型往往产生流利但事实上不正确的输出. 灰盒探测器识别出这些幻觉,这些幻觉来自代代期间发布的征兆概率统计,避免了白盒访问前沿模型不提供的隐藏状态的需要. 然而,这些探测器通常只依靠概率表示,而忽略候选标志的身份。 因此,他们可以观察模型的不确定性,但不能观察模型的不确定性。 因此,它们无法区分一个在"大"和"小"之间被撕裂的模型,以及当两个对子得到相同概率分布时在"大"和"厚"之间被撕裂的模型.
我们引入了GURI(Gray-box不确定表示和身份),这是一种轻量级的灰盒幻觉探测器,将候选概率和每位矢量识别符结合起来. 这揭示了在保留灰色盒设置的可访问性和可转让性的同时采用何种模式。 在三个开放加权模型和三个答题基准中,GURI将平均测试ROC-AUC从72.09%提高到79.09%,高于仅概率基准。 在封闭源代码GPT-4.1模式中,ROC-AUC从67.39%增加到71.84%. 在三种开放量级模型中,GURI在18个定向跨型转移中,17个没有微调,其性能超过了仅转让概率基线. 对于三个开放量级模型,HotpotQA和TriviaQA之间的跨数据集传输与持有的固定模型相比,ROC-AUC比转移的LOS-Net差3.76分.

articles.title: SoK: Grading Open-Text Legal Answers, from Law School Exams to Trustworthy Rubric Judges
articles.content: Law students are examined through open-text answers: case solutions, essays and memos that apply the law to a set of facts. Such answers are expensive to grade, human graders disagree widely on them, and large language models (LLMs) now offer to grade them at scale, both in teaching and in the benchmarks that test legal AI. This paper systematizes how open-text legal answers can be evaluated. We derive eight desiderata from educational measurement and from the law that governs exams, among them validity, reliability, reasons, credit for defensible alternative solutions, robustness to gaming and human oversight. We then compare eight evaluation paradigms against them, from unstructured human grading to LLM judges with instance-specific rubrics and pairwise comparison. Three findings stand out. A rubric written for the task is the strongest lever for agreement between an LLM judge and human graders, but the reported figures answer different questions and rarely come with the human agreement they must be read against. The central validation gap lies where examination law is most demanding: defensible alternative solutions, follow-on errors, and the examiner's correction of model judgments. And rubric-centred grading is the most auditable family, because it makes the standard, its application and the final decision checkable. From this we derive the trustworthy rubric judge: an instance rubric that credits arguments and alternative paths,evidence checked in code, probes, repeated runs, calibration against independent human grades,logging, and an examiner who reads every script. We state what each safeguard rests on, what remains to be tested, and the uses the evidence supports today.

articles.title_zh: SoK:从法学院考试到可信赖的鲁布里克法官的公开文本法律答案
articles.content_zh: 法律学生通过公开的答案来检查:案件解决办法、论文和对一系列事实适用法律的备忘录。 这种答案对于分级来说是昂贵的,人类的分级者对于这些答案有很大的分歧,现在大语言模型(LLMs)在教学和测试法律AI的基准中都提供分级的规模. 本文将如何评价开放文本的法律答案系统化. 我们从教育计量和规范考试的法律中得出了8项 " 脱脂 " ,其中包括有效性、可靠性、理由、可证明的替代解决方案的信用、对游戏的稳健性和人的监督。 然后,我们将8个评价范式加以比较,从非结构化的人力评级到LLM评委与具体案例的标点和对等比较。 三种发现突出. 为这项任务撰写的标语是LLM法官与人类分级者之间达成协议的最强杠杆,但所报告的数字回答了不同的问题,很少与人类的协议相违背。 中央鉴定空白在于考试法要求最高的地方:可论证的替代解决方案,后续错误,以及考生对示范判决的改正. 而以标题为中心的分级是最可审计的家族,因为它使得标准,应用和最终决定可以核查. 我们从中得出了值得信赖的评语:一个可以评分的评语和替代路径的例子, 证据通过代码、探测、重复运行、校准与独立的人类成绩、博客, 我们指出每一项保障措施的基础、有待检验的内容以及今天证据的使用情况。

articles.title: Choosing the Number of Attention Heads from Intrinsic Dimension: A Small-Scale Study
articles.content: The number of attention heads in a transformer is usually set by convention or grid search. We test a simple heuristic for setting it in advance: estimate the intrinsic dimension of token representations without labels, and use roughly that many heads. We estimate intrinsic dimension with a nested-dropout VAE trained on DistilBERT embeddings of WikiText-2, choosing the KL weight at the knee of the VAE's rate-distortion curve rather than by hand. This gives $k^*=9.2$ (95% CI [8.6, 9.8]). In a small 4-layer transformer trained from scratch, 10 heads and 32 heads are statistically equivalent on SST-2 and on MRPC (paired TOST over 10 seeds, $\pm1$ point margin), with 69% fewer attention parameters for the 10-head model. Training 10 heads from the start also slightly outperforms training 32 heads and pruning to 10 (0.6 points, $p=0.008$). The evidence is narrow: two classification tasks, one small architecture, no pretrained models, and no formal link between intrinsic dimension and head count. We present the result as a practical heuristic worth testing at larger scale, not as a general principle.

articles.title_zh: 选择内在层面的注意力头数:小规模研究
articles.content_zh: 变压器中的注意头数通常通过常规或网格搜索设定. 我们测试一种简单的heuristic 预先设置它: 估计象征表示的内在维度 没有标签, 并使用大致那么多的头。 我们用一个嵌入WikiText 2 的嵌入式嵌入式嵌入式嵌入式嵌入式嵌入式嵌入式嵌入式嵌入式嵌入式VAE来估计内在维基维度,选择VAE的速率扭曲曲线膝盖上的KL重量,而不是用手. 这相当于9.2 美元(95%CI [8.6, 9.8])。 在从零开始训练的4层小型变压器中,在SST-2和MRPC上,10头和32头在统计学上等同(在10个种子上标注TOST,$\pm1美元点差值),10头模型的注意参数减少69%. 从一开始就培训10名负责人,培训32名负责人的工作也略胜于培训10名负责人(0.6分,0.08美元)。 证据是狭义的:两个分类任务,一个小架构,没有经过事先训练的模型,内在维度和头数之间没有正式的联系. 我们提出这一结果是一种实际的、值得在更大范围内进行测试的热力测试,而不是一项一般原则。

articles.title: AtomSearch: Evidence-Grounded Tree Search for Agent Skill Optimization
articles.content: Agent skills adapt frozen models through editable external instructions. Revising several rules at once makes changes difficult to inspect, while judging each local edit only by its immediate score can discard useful intermediate states. We introduce AtomSearch, which keeps revision actions local while using subsequent skill states to guide search. Contrastive atomic editing links each primitive rule edit to failed and successful executions, a behavioral hypothesis, and an intended scope. Skill-State Tree Search (STS) evaluates short edit compositions and selectively retains them as executable states that can be revisited and extended. Outcome memory supplies later proposals with observed repair and regression statistics. We evaluate AtomSearch across four tasks and five target models. With deepseek-v4-flash, it exceeds SkillOpt on three of four tasks, including a 9.68-percentage-point gain on LiveMathematicianBench, and SkillOpt's final skills contain 2.3-19.7 times as many characters. In 67% of completed searches, the best validation state passes through an ancestor that was not highest-scoring at its depth. These results show how local rule edits can support the exploration of useful revision paths and yield compact skills, with additional offline evaluations used to explore alternative states.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AtomSearch: 证据环绕树搜索代理技能优化
articles.content_zh: 代理技能通过可编辑的外部指令来适应冷冻模型. 立即修改若干规则使得修改难以检查,而仅根据其即时得分判断每个本地编辑就可以丢弃有用的中间状态. 我们引入了AtomSearch,它使修改动作保持局部,同时使用后续的技能状态来指导搜索. 矛盾的原子编辑将每一个原始规则编辑链接到失败和成功的处决,一个行为假设,以及一个预定的范围. Skill-State Tree Search(STS)评价短版编辑组成,并有选择地将其保留为可执行状态,可以重新审视和扩展. 结果记忆为后来的建议提供了可观察到的修复和回归统计。 我们评价AtomSearch的四项任务和五个目标模型。 随着深层Seek-v4-flash,它在四个任务中的三个任务超过了SkillOpt,其中包括在LiveMathematician Bench上9.68的百分点增益,SkillOpt的最终技能包含2.3-19.7倍的人物. 在67%完成的搜索中,最好的验证状态通过一个在深度没有达到最高分的祖先. 这些结果显示,地方规则编辑如何能支持探索有用的修订路径,并产生紧凑的技能,同时使用额外的离线评价来探索替代状态.

articles.title: Does Machine Translation Retain Media Bias?
articles.content:
Within the most recent two decades, machine translation (MT) has been advanced from a research area to a mature, deployed technology for prose text and most language pairs. However, language has different dimensions of meaning, and the alluded progress has primarily been demonstrated for propositional meaning.
  In this small exploratory study, we investigate whether one type of affective meaning, namely different types of linguistically expressed media bias, are retained under automatic translation for two language pairs, English and German as the source languages, and Bulgarian as the target language. We evaluate four state-of-the-art translation methods to answer the question whether and to what degree a loss of non-neutral language (specifically, 27 types of media bias) can occur as a result of applying MT.
  Our empirical findings are consistent with the claim that MT does not fully retain existing news bias of its input source text, but also may add extra bias of its own. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first experimental study of MT media bias retention.

articles.title_zh: 机器翻译是否保留媒体比亚斯?
articles.content_zh:
在最近20年里,机器翻译(MT)已从一个研究领域发展到一个成熟的、应用的传言文本和大多数语言对等技术。 然而,语言具有不同的意义层面,而间接的进展主要表现为命题意义.
在这项小规模的探索性研究中,我们调查一种情感含义,即不同类型的语言表达的媒体偏见,是否保留在两种语言的自动翻译之下,英语和德语是源语言,保加利亚语是目标语言。 我们评价四种最先进的翻译方法,以回答一个问题,即由于应用MT,是否以及在多大程度上可以发生失去非中性语言(具体来说是27种媒体偏见)的情况.
我们的经验发现与MT没有完全保留其输入源文本的现有新闻偏差的说法一致,但也可能会增加其自身的额外偏差. 据我们所知,这是对MT媒体偏差的保留的第一次实验研究。

articles.title: To Reason but Not to Stop: Understanding and Recovering Pruned Large Reasoning Models
articles.content: Weight pruning can degrade the accuracy of large reasoning models (LRMs), yet it remains unclear whether it damages reasoning itself. We find that much of this degradation stems from a failure to stop rather than to reason. As sparsity increases, pruned LRMs increasingly fail to terminate within the token budget, often after the correct answer has appeared in their reasoning, instead falling into repetitive loops, even though they still recognize where the dense model would stop. We further find that the hidden-state difference between terminating and looping continuations is consistent across pruned checkpoints, suggesting a shared direction associated with committing to an answer. Building on this, we propose Termination-Guided Activation Steering (TGAS), a training-free method that adds this direction to the residual stream at inference time. Across six LRMs, three pruning pipelines, and math and code benchmarks, TGAS improves termination and overall accuracy while reducing repetitive reasoning and generation length, showing that this failure is actionable.
