articles.title_zh: 致理性但不停止:理解和回收已运行的大型理性模型
articles.content_zh: 重量推算可以降低大型推理模型(LRMs)的准确性,但尚不清楚它是否损害推理本身. 我们认为,这种退化在很大程度上是由于未能停止而不是理智。 随着螺旋性增强,被挤压的LRM在符號預算中越来越不能终止,常常是在他们的推理中出现了正确的答案后,反而陷入了重复循环,尽管他们仍然认识到密集模型会停止在哪里. 我们进一步发现,终止和环绕持续之间的隐蔽状态差异在被查封的检查站之间是一致的,这表明与承诺解决问题有关的共同方向。 在此基础上,我们提出 " 终止指导启动指导 " (TGAS),这是一种无培训方法,在推断时将这一方向添加到剩余流中。 通过6个LRM,3个螺旋管,以及数学和代码基准,TGAS改进了终止和整体准确性,同时减少了重复推理和生成长度,表明这种失败是可以行动的.

articles.title: MemDuet: Learning Dual-Process Memory for Long-Context Reasoning
articles.content: Reasoning over infinitely long documents is becoming a reality with recurrent memory agents. However, increasing context length exacerbates the trade-off between reasoning performance and inference efficiency. Inspired by Kahneman's account of fast and slow thinking, we propose MemDuet, a dual-process memory framework that learns to coordinate a small language model for fast, parallel evidence selection from raw context chunks (System 1) with a large language model for memory-update verification and memory updates in document order (System 2). We train MemDuet in three stages: supervised fine-tuning of System 1 for evidence selection, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) of System 2 for verification and memory rewriting, and joint optimization of both policies to coordinate selection and updating for long-context reasoning. Experiments on diverse long-context reasoning benchmarks (RULER-HQA, LongBench v2, and 2WikiMultiHopQA) demonstrate a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off as context length grows. Averaged across evaluation settings on the three datasets, MemDuet achieves an end-to-end inference speedup of 9.74x and an output-token reduction of 73.91% relative to RL-MemAgent.

articles.title_zh: MemDuet: 学习双进程内存用于长文解析
articles.content_zh: 由于文件篇幅过长,经常出现内存代理商,正成为现实。 然而,上下文长度的增加加剧了推理性能与推论效率之间的权衡. 受Kahneman关于快速和慢思维的描述的启发,我们提出MemDuet,这是一个双进程内存框架,学习协调一个小语言模型,用于从原始上下文块(System 1)中快速,平行地选择证据,同时按照文档顺序(System 2)使用一个大型语言模型进行内存更新验证和内存更新. 我们分三个阶段对MemDuet进行训练:对系统1进行监督微调,以进行证据选择;对系统2进行小组相对政策优化,以进行核查和内存重写;对两个政策进行联合优化,以协调选择和更新,以进行长文推理。 关于各种长文本推理基准(RULER-HQA,LongBench v2,和2Wiki MultiHopQA)的实验表明,随着上下文长度的增大,精确效率的权衡是有利的。 平均在三个数据集的评价设置中,MemDuet实现端到端推论速度为9.74x,相对于RL-MemAgent,输出端推算减少73.91%.

articles.title: MolHop: Scaffold-Hopping Molecular Design with Agentic Reinforcement Learning
articles.content: Molecular design is often formulated as an optimization problem over existing molecular spaces. However, molecular optimization and the discovery of structurally distinct replacement molecules represent two fundamentally different search problems. LLM-based molecular design agents typically perform the former, conducting local refinement within the neighborhood of existing structures to improve target properties through structural modifications. In contrast, the latter requires exploration of a broader chemical space to discover molecules with entirely different scaffolds while preserving the functional characteristics of reference molecules. We propose MolHop, an agentic framework for cross-scaffold molecular discovery that enables models to navigate and edit within a pre-organized chemical space. MolHop organizes approximately 1.6 million molecular scaffolds from commercial molecules into a coarse-to-fine hierarchical action space. The agent selects new exploration regions through scaffold navigation actions and adjusts candidate properties through molecular editing. The framework maintains historical trajectory memory to support long-horizon search processes. On drug molecule and commercial compound tasks, connecting Grok-4.6 and DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1 to the MolHop framework substantially improves their cross-scaffold joint success rates. We develop MolHop-9B through agentic reinforcement learning, and MolHop-9B outperforms generative baselines including GPT-5.6-sol, Claude-5-Opus, and Gemini-3.1-Pro, while generating candidate molecules with larger scaffold differences from the reference molecules. These results demonstrate that effective molecular discovery beyond the traditional optimization paradigm requires structured chemical and action spaces, enabling agents to explore new structural regions rather than merely refine existing molecules.

articles.title_zh: MolHop: 带剂强化学习的脚手架-霍平分子设计
articles.content_zh: 分子设计常被表述为在现有分子空间之上的优化问题. 然而,分子优化和结构差异替代分子的发现代表了两个根本不同的搜索问题. 基于LLM的分子设计剂一般执行前者,在现有结构的邻里进行局部修饰,通过结构修饰改善目标特性. 相比之下,后者要求探索更广泛的化学空间来发现具有完全不同脚手架的分子,同时保留参考分子的功能特征. 我们提出MolHop, 一个跨脚手架分子发现的代理框架, 使模型能够在预先组织的化学空间中导航和编辑。 MolHop从商业分子中组织大约160万个分子脚手架,形成粗细的分级动作空间. 该剂通过脚手架导航动作选择新的勘探区域,并通过分子编辑调整候选属性. 该框架保持历史轨迹记忆,以支持长视距搜索进程. 在药物分子和商业复合物任务方面,将Grok-4.6和DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1与MolHop框架连接起来,大大提高了它们的跨脚手架联合成功率. 我们通过代理强化学习来开发MolHop-9B,MolHop-9B超越基因基线,包括GPT-5.6-sol,Claude-5-Opus,和双子座-3.1-Pro,同时产生与参考分子具有较大脚手架差异的候选分子. 这些结果表明,超越传统优化范式的有效分子发现需要结构化的化学和行动空间,使物剂能够探索新的结构区域,而不仅仅是完善现有的分子.

articles.title: Not All Criteria Matter: Importance-Aware Criteria Weighting for Rubric-Based LLM Evaluation
articles.content: Rubric-based evaluation assesses the responses of large language models (LLMs) by aggregating the verification results of explicit criteria, yet not all criteria matter equally. However, existing methods commonly aggregate the verification results with uniform weighting, which assigns minor and overlapping criteria the same weight as essential ones and thus produces misleading evaluation scores. Although some methods prompt an LLM to directly assign weights, direct weighting requires a holistic judgment over all criteria that LLMs struggle to make reliably. To address these limitations, we propose Importance-Aware Criteria Weighting (ICW), which derives the weights of criteria from pairwise importance comparisons made by an LLM. Specifically, ICW transforms the holistic judgment over all criteria into a series of pairwise importance comparisons, checks and revises inconsistent comparisons, and derives the weights from the principal eigenvector of the comparison matrix. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ICW consistently outperforms uniform weighting and competitive weighting methods, and translates into better policy models in downstream reinforcement learning.

articles.title_zh: 并非所有标准都很重要:基于Rubric的LLM的重要性-了解标准加权 评价
articles.content_zh: 基于Rubric的评价通过汇总明确标准的核查结果来评估大语言模型的反应,但并非所有标准都同等重要。 然而,现有方法通常以统一的加权方式汇总核查结果,将次要和重叠的标准与基本标准相同,从而产生误导性评价分数。 虽然有些方法促使LLM直接分配权重,但直接权重需要从整体上判断LLMs难以可靠地作出的所有标准. 为了消除这些局限性,我们提议采用重视的加权标准(ICW),这种标准权重来自LLM进行的对等重要性比较。 具体地说,国际妇女理事会将对所有标准的整体判断转化为一系列对等重要性的比较、检查和修改不一致的比较,并从比较矩阵的主要要素中得出加权。 广泛的实验表明,国际妇女理事会的业绩始终高于统一的加权和竞争性加权方法,并在下游强化学习中转化为更好的政策模式。

articles.title: Beyond Benchmark Accuracy: A Diagnostic Test for LLM Chemical Prediction
articles.content: LLMs have achieved strong performance on chemical prediction benchmarks. However, existing evaluation methods typically provide target entity identity information directly, making it difficult to determine whether model predictions arise from transferable structure-property reasoning capabilities or rely on target-related contextual information or memory retrieval. We propose the Identity-Blinded Reasoning Diagnostic framework to evaluate chemical prediction models when target entity identity information is hidden. In this framework, the target is no longer directly defined by its entity identity, but instead by a known source entity and an explicit structural edit operation. This setting preserves the information required to determine the target while reducing the opportunity for models to access target identity cues. We evaluate this framework across six tasks spanning odor prediction, molecular property prediction, retrosynthesis, and reaction yield prediction. The results show that models generally achieve better prediction performance when source and target entity properties are consistent. Providing explicit source entity labels further strengthens this dependence. Moreover, while keeping the target entity, structural change, and ground-truth label unchanged, replacing only the source entity label causes some model predictions to systematically shift toward the substituted source labels. These results indicate that high benchmark accuracy in chemical prediction tasks does not necessarily imply that LLMs possess reliable structure-property reasoning capabilities. Our diagnostic framework provides a controlled evaluation approach for testing whether models can genuinely update predictions according to entity changes. The framework can be extended to other AI for Science tasks, particularly those where targets can be defined through transformations of known entities.

articles.title_zh: 超越基准 准确性:LLM化学预测的诊断试验
articles.content_zh: 在化学品预测基准方面,LLMs取得了强劲的业绩。 然而,现有的评价方法通常直接提供目标实体的身份信息,因此很难确定模型预测是来自于可转移的结构财产推理能力,还是依赖于与目标相关的背景信息或内存检索. 我们提议采用 " 识别-Blinded 合理诊断框架 " ,以便在隐藏目标实体身份信息时评价化学预测模型。 在这个框架中,目标不再由其实体身份直接定义,而是由一个已知的源实体和一个明确的结构编辑操作来定义. 这种设置保存了确定目标所需的信息,同时减少了模型访问目标身份提示的机会. 我们通过6项任务来评价这个框架, 包括气味预测、分子属性预测、再合成和反应产量预测。 结果显示,当源性和目标实体属性一致时,模型一般能实现更好的预测性能. 提供明确的源实体标签进一步加强了这种依赖性。 此外,虽然目标实体、结构变化和地面真实标签保持不变,但仅取代源实体标签导致一些模型预测系统转向替代源标签。 这些结果表明,化学预测任务中的基准精度较高并不一定意味着LLMs拥有可靠的结构属性推理能力. 我们的诊断框架为测试模型是否能够根据实体变化真正更新预测提供了一个有控制的评价方法. 该框架可以扩展到其他科学AI任务,尤其是那些通过已知实体的转型可以确定目标的任务.

articles.title: Frustratingly Easy Majority Voting Using Length Conditioning
articles.content: Majority Voting (MV) is a simple and widely used strategy which improves the reasoning accuracy of Large Language Models (LLMs) by allocating additional inference-time computation. Specifically, in MV multiple Chain-of-Thoughts (CoTs) are independently sampled and the most frequent final answer is selected. In this work, we propose Length-Conditioned Majority Voting (LCMV), a Test-Time Training approach which improves MV leveraging an empirical observation that has recently been established in several studies: longer CoTs tend to be associated with a lower probability of correctness. We formulate this inductive bias as a length-conditioned prior probability, which is modeled by a simple logistic function. Moreover, we adapt this prior at test time using only unlabeled testing data and without fine-tuning the LLM. Finally, the adapted prior is used to weight the vote of each sampled answer. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs and reasoning benchmarks show that LCMV consistently improves over both standard MV and existing length-based and confidence-based aggregation strategies, while retaining the simplicity and model-agnostic nature of MV. Our code is available at: https://github.com/aimagelab/LCMV.

articles.title_zh: 使用长度条件的简单多数表决
articles.content_zh: 多数投票(MV)是一种简单且广泛使用的战略,它通过分配额外的推论时间计算来提高大语言模型(LLMs)的推理精度. 具体地说,在MV多条思维链(COTs)中是独立采样的,并选择了最频繁的最终答案. 在这项工作中,我们提议采用长限期多数投票(LCMV),这是一种试验时间培训方法,它利用最近在若干研究中确立的实证观察改进了MV:较长的COT往往与不太准确的可能性有关。 我们把这种诱导性偏差表述为一种长的附加条件的先发概率,这种概率以简单的后勤功能为模型. 此外,我们在试验时间之前仅使用无标签的测试数据来调整这个数据,而没有微调LLM。 最后,调整后的前面用来加权每个抽样答复的投票。 跨越多个LLMs和推理基准的广泛实验表明,LCMV在标准MV和现有的基于长度和信心的汇总战略上不断改进,同时保留了MV的简单性和模型不可知性. 我们的代码见:https://github.com/aimagelab/LCMV。
